title: Ground Sand Operator
description:
The Grand Sand Operator assists in the operation of grinding mills and material handling equipment to support safe, efficient, and high-quality production. Learns milling processes, equipment operation, preventative maintenance, and quality control procedures while working under close supervision. Performs inspections, operates processing equipment, completes production documentation, and supports environmental and safety compliance.

  • Operate grinding mills, material handling, and processing equipment safely and efficiently.
  • Perform pre-shift inspections and document workplace examinations.
  • Monitor equipment performance and report maintenance or operational issues.
  • Conduct product sampling and testing in accordance with quality standards.
  • Perform minor maintenance on milling and processing equipment using proper Lockout/Tagout procedures.
  • Complete daily production reports, including equipment settings, silo levels, product grades, and downtime documentation.
  • Use computer software to monitor equipment performance and record production data.
  • Load live-feed railcars and tanker trucks.
  • Operate a forklift as needed.
  • Maintain clean, organized work areas and support housekeeping standards.
  • Follow all company safety, health, and environmental policies and report unsafe conditions, incidents, or environmental events immediately.
  • Wear required personal protective equipment (PPE) at all times.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • High school diploma or General Education Degree (GED) required.
  • 1+ years of industrial process equipment experience preferred.
  • Mine Safety and Health (MSHA) knowledge preferred.
  • Forklift experience preferred.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, WonderWare (or similar process software), and JD Edwards (JDE) preferred.
  • Warehouse or manufacturing experience preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced industrial environment while maintaining a high level of safety and quality.
  • Ability to work outdoors in all weather conditions, climb stairs and ladders, work from elevated platforms, use hand tools, and wear required PPE, including a hard hat, steel-toe boots, safety glasses, hearing protection, and gloves, for extended periods.

title: Senior Social Editor - LAD
description:
LBG Media plc is one of the world’s fastest-growing and most influential digital media companies. Our brands, including LADbible, reach over 1 billion people globally and generate more than 13.9 billion social views every month. With a following of over 520 million, we are the world’s most engaged publisher on social and shape the way Millennials and Gen Z consume content - across the UK, the US, and beyond.

At LADbible, we’re not just reporting the news - we’re defining culture. Our team moves fast, embraces trends, and creates content that resonates with millions of people every day.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Social Editor to be at the heart of LADbible’s audience growth strategy. You’ll be responsible for distributing trending and breaking news to our global audience, ensuring our journalism reaches the right people, on the right platforms, at the right time.

You’ll work closely with journalists and editors to shape a daily publishing schedule, using your editorial judgement and data insight to maximise reach and engagement across social platforms and beyond.

This is a fast-paced, social-led editorial role with real impact on the performance of the brand.

What You’ll Do

  • Stay ahead of competitors by proactively researching trending news, stories, and viral videos.

  • Identify and champion content that our audience will want to read, watch, or share.

  • Take a 360° approach to sourcing and distributing content across multiple platforms and referrers.

  • Collaborate with social editors, writers, and journalists to develop ideas and improve content performance.

  • Schedule and post content, primarily across Facebook and Twitter.

  • Package articles by writing compelling headlines, captions, and selecting attention-grabbing thumbnails.

  • Monitor performance using social and audience analytics tools, optimising content to maximise reach.

  • Explore and adopt new methods for audience growth across search and other referrers.

  • Bring creativity, initiative, and fresh ideas to the team, contributing to ongoing improvements.

  • Work across a seven-day rota and cover live events as they happen.

Who You Are

  • At least 5 years’ experience in a newsroom or digital publishing environment.

  • Strong knowledge of social media platforms and Google Search.

  • Deep interest in the UK and US news agenda, especially pop culture, trends, and viral stories.

  • Degree in Journalism, Broadcasting, Media, or equivalent experience.

  • Experience selecting content and writing headlines for a digital audience.

  • Clear understanding of trending news and how to turn it into original, engaging stories.

  • Working knowledge of analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Trends, Chartbeat, and NewsWhip.

  • Proven ability to work collaboratively within editorial teams and mentor junior colleagues.

  • Clear examples of successful social campaigns, posts, or articles that drove audience growth.

  • Strong proofreading skills and understanding of journalism law and ethics.

At LADbible Group we've rolled out blended working which means the majority of departments across the business (including London, Manchester and International offices) work in the office 3 days per week.

LADbible Group is an equal opportunities employer. We are determined to create a diverse group at all levels of our company and we welcome all members of the community to apply for openings with us. As the leading social youth publisher, we have a powerful global platform to better represent our audience and enable those that do not have equal opportunities to have their voices heard. As a business, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce, in an environment where everyone feels comfortable to be themselves.

title: Bilingual Help Desk & Client Support Specialist
description:
NeoWork is seeking a Bilingual Help Desk & Client Support Specialist to support a growing restaurant-focused operation in the US. This teammate will help onboard clients to ordering platforms, provide Tier-1 technical support, and handle bilingual communication between restaurant owners and vendors. The role requires strong customer service, clear communication in both English and Spanish, and the ability to manage multiple small tasks throughout the day.

You will act as the founder’s right hand by taking over support, administrative tasks, and client-facing responsibilities. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys problem-solving, has a service-driven mindset, and feels comfortable working in fast-moving environments. As the company grows, this role can evolve into a Team Lead position.

Responsibilities

Primary Support Tasks

  • Onboard restaurant clients to ordering and delivery platforms (UberEats, DoorDash, and similar).
  • Guide clients through settings, integrations, and basic troubleshooting.
  • Provide Tier-1 help desk support and answer technical questions.
  • Conduct B2B interpretation between English and Spanish during vendor conversations.
  • Offer light customer success support to ensure smooth adoption of the platforms.

Secondary Administrative Tasks

  • Manage scheduling, follow-ups, and information organization.
  • Assist with general operational tasks that free up the founder's time.
  • Help coordinate communication between clients and vendors when needed.

Requirements

Must-Have Skills

  • Fluent English and Fluent Spanish, able to switch between both languages comfortably.
  • Ability to understand multiple Spanish dialects and US accents.
  • Experience in help desk, support, customer service, or virtual assistant–type roles.
  • Strong client-facing communication and active listening.
  • Tech-savvy and quick to learn new restaurant or ordering software.
  • Highly empathetic, customer-centric, and patient.
  • Organized, able to juggle many small tasks and follow through.
  • Proactive mindset and comfortable working with ambiguity.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with UberEats, DoorDash, or other restaurant tech systems.
  • Experience supporting small businesses.
  • Leadership potential with interest in growing into a Team Lead role.

Benefits

  • We offer health insurance for contractors
  • Holiday Extra Pay
  • The work hours generally align with standard business hours in the US, with some potential flexibility depending on the client's needs.
  • This is a 100% home-based position
  • We prioritize the mental health of our team members and offer mental health days to support their well-being.
  • In addition to the base salary, performance-based incentives are provided.
  • There is an annual review and appraisal process in place.
  • There are ample opportunities for professional growth and advancement within the company.

title: Applied Machine Learning and AI Engineering Intern
description:
Applied Machine Learning and AI Engineering Intern

Come Create at Ricoh

If you are seeking a team driven by passion and purpose, come create with us at Ricoh. We are a team of information seekers and customer-obsessed collaborators who aspire to deliver the services, solutions, and technologies that empower business success. We are looking for talented, inspired individuals to join us during the summer of 2027 to help drive high-performance teams and our commitment to excellence.

Ricoh is an integrated solutions provider and partner that connects people and technology, creates outstanding customer experiences, and delivers innovation for businesses worldwide. We empower digital workplaces by enabling individuals to work smarter from any location and harness the power of information—how it is collected, stored, managed, and shared—to unlock the potential in every organization. We deliver services and technologies that inspire our customers’ success and guide them toward a better and more sustainable future. If you are seeking a purpose-driven and passionate team, come create with us, and help drive our high-performance culture of excellence into tomorrow.

Position Profile

Ricoh is seeking a highly motivated summer intern to help build an AI-powered globalization platform that translates our product documentation and software into eleven languages. Our translation process has already moved from fully manual to hybrid automation, and the next step is to bring translation fully in-house: an automated, AI-driven pipeline that reduces turnaround from weeks to a single day while raising translation quality and consistency.

The intern will join this project during its validation and pilot phases, working on the machine learning and engineering problems that determine whether an automated translation can be trusted enough to ship to customers. This is applied work on a system with real users, measurable cost impact, and a clear path to production.

Examples of summer projects:

  • Build and run evaluation methods that measure machine translation quality across multiple languages, and help define what “good enough to ship” means for customer-facing content.
  • Develop a terminology checker that enforces Ricoh product terminology and brand language consistently across every supported language.
  • Implement delta translation—detecting and translating only changed content—to cut token cost and processing time on document updates.
  • Work with large language models to improve translation accuracy on structured technical content, including XML-based documentation, tagging, and formatting preservation.
  • Help automate the end-to-end pipeline that receives translation packages from development teams, processes them, and checks completed translations back into source control.
  • Analyze and refine AI outputs to improve accuracy and usability, and present findings to cross-functional development, documentation, and localization teams.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

  • Contribute working code to an active engineering project alongside full-time engineers.
  • Design and execute experiments to evaluate model and pipeline performance, and document the results.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across documentation, software development, and infrastructure.
  • Present progress and final results to technical stakeholders and department leadership.

Qualifications (Education, Experience, and Certifications)

  • Working towards an M.S. or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Linguistics/Computational Linguistics, or a related field
  • Student must be currently enrolled in an accredited graduate program, or completing an undergraduate degree and enrolled to continue their education in an accredited graduate program
  • Students must have a cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher
  • Students are to successfully complete all required screenings prior to hire

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Required Skills

  • Excellent programming skills in Python, with a good understanding of data structures, software design principles, and algorithms
  • Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, natural language processing, and data processing
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to design a fair evaluation of a system’s output
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate with a team
  • Interest in language technology, AI-driven automation, and process optimization

Preferred Skills

  • Hands-on experience working with large language models or generative AI APIs, including prompt design and output evaluation
  • Experience using Claude and AI-assisted development workflows in Visual Studio Code, or comparable AI developer tooling
  • Experience with machine translation, internationalization/localization, or multilingual datasets
  • Familiarity with structured document formats (XML, DITA, JSON, YAML) and text parsing
  • Experience with cloud services (AWS) and building or consuming REST APIs
  • Working knowledge of Git and standard software development workflows
  • Reading or speaking proficiency in a second language, particularly Japanese, German, French, Spanish, Chinese, or Korean
  • Skilled in explaining and presenting analyses and machine learning concepts to a broad technical audience

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, skills, efforts or working conditions associated with a job.

Ricoh is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer -- Minorities/Women/Protected Veterans/Disabled.

title: Information Technology Engineer
description:
Position Summary

The IT Engineer is responsible for the day-to-day operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of Northway Biotech's IT infrastructure and technology systems. This role provides technical support to employees while ensuring the reliability, security, and performance of business, laboratory, manufacturing, and facility-related computerized systems. The IT Engineer will serve as the primary on-site IT resource, will report to the Head of Maintenance and Engineering and work closely with Maintenance and Engineering group, Quality group, and external vendors to support a GMP-regulated biotech environment.

Position Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot desktops, laptops, mobile devices, printers, and peripherals.

  • Provide technical support and training to end users on hardware, software, and IT systems.

  • Maintain and administer Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, and user access management.

  • Manage and support servers, storage, virtualization platforms, backups, and cybersecurity measures.

  • Maintain and administer local and wireless network infrastructure, internet connectivity, firewalls, and VPN access.

  • Support computerized laboratory and manufacturing equipment, including associated software and network connectivity.

  • Maintain and administer Building Management Systems (BMS), environmental monitoring systems, access control systems, CCTV/video surveillance, and other operational technology systems.

  • Coordinate with equipment and software vendors for installation, maintenance, upgrades, and troubleshooting.

  • Support data integrity, system security, disaster recovery, and business continuity initiatives.

  • Participate in qualification, validation, change control, and compliance activities for computerized systems within a GMP-regulated environment.

  • Maintain accurate IT documentation, inventories, procedures, and system records.

  • Support implementation of new technologies and continuous improvement projects across the site.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field; equivalent experience may be considered.

  • 3+ years of experience in IT engineering, systems administration, or technical support.

  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Windows operating systems and Microsoft 365 administration.

  • Experience with server administration, networking, cybersecurity, and virtualization platforms (VMware preferred).

  • Knowledge of database systems and SQL.

  • Experience supporting Building Management Systems (BMS), access control, CCTV, or other facility automation systems preferred.

  • Familiarity with laboratory, manufacturing, or GMP-regulated environments is highly desirable.

  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and organizational skills.

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or life sciences industries.

  • Knowledge of Linux operating systems.

  • Understanding of GxP, data integrity, and computerized system validation principles.

title: IT Operations Specialist - 6 Month FTC
description:
About the role

We’re looking for an IT Operations Specialist to join Superscript on a 6 month fixed-term contract to take ownership of the day-to-day operation, reliability and continuous improvement of our IT environment.

This is a hands-on role sitting between traditional IT support and IT operations. You’ll help ensure our people have the technology, systems, access and infrastructure they need to do their jobs effectively, while also taking responsibility for the underlying operational processes that keep our IT environment secure, compliant and well maintained.

You’ll work closely with colleagues across Technology, People, Compliance and the wider business, supporting our London, Glasgow and Rotterdam teams and our hybrid workforce.

The role will suit someone who enjoys being both hands-on and proactive, solving problems when they arise, but also looking for ways to prevent them happening in the first place.

What you'll get up to:

  • Manage and maintain company Mac devices throughout their lifecycle, from deployment through to repair, replacement and disposal.

  • Manage Mac endpoint configuration ensuring devices remain appropriately configured and compliant.

  • Manage Apple Business Manager enrolment and device assignment.

  • Maintain accurate IT asset and device inventories.

  • Support device patching, operating system compliance and endpoint security requirements.

  • Maintain appropriate levels of IT equipment, peripherals and replacement devices.

  • Support damaged, lost or stolen device processes.

  • Coordinate device returns and ensure devices are securely wiped before reassignment or disposal.

  • Support the ongoing improvement of our endpoint management and device lifecycle processes.

  • Manage and maintain appropriate user access across core systems and applications.

  • Support SSO, SAML and identity integrations where appropriate.

  • Support MFA standards and authentication controls.

  • Maintain secure emergency / break-glass administrator access.

  • Carry out periodic user access reviews and help ensure access remains appropriate as people move roles or leave the business.

  • Support IT security incidents and coordinate the technical response where required.

  • Support phishing protection, email security and security awareness activity.

  • Triage and respond to technical security issues raised by colleagues

  • Support the business in maintaining appropriate security controls across its IT environment.

  • Administer and maintain office networking, Wi-Fi and UniFi infrastructure.

  • Manage ISP and connectivity suppliers and escalate issues where required.

  • Monitor IT systems, alerts and operational dashboards to identify and resolve issues proactively.

  • Support connectivity across our London, Glasgow, Rotterdam and wider hybrid workforce.

  • Help maintain reliable and secure meeting-room technology and room-resource integrations.

  • Provide escalation support for more complex IT issues beyond first-line troubleshooting.

  • Investigate recurring technical issues and identify opportunities for permanent fixes.

  • Work with external vendors and support providers to resolve technical problems.

  • Provide technical support for business-critical issues when required.

  • Help maintain clear ownership of IT systems, services and suppliers.

  • Provide practical guidance to colleagues on the use of company technology and systems.

  • Ensure IT issues are documented and appropriately tracked through to resolution.

  • Support and, where appropriate, lead IT projects, migrations and platform changes.

  • Help introduce new technology and improve existing systems and processes.

  • Identify opportunities to simplify, automate and improve IT operations.

  • Work collaboratively with stakeholders across the business to understand requirements and deliver practical technology solutions.

  • Provide IT operational reporting and updates to management.

  • Maintain clear technical documentation and ensure operational knowledge is not dependent on individual team members.

About you:

We’re looking for someone who combines strong technical fundamentals with excellent operational judgement.

You’ll ideally have experience in a similar IT Operations, IT Infrastructure, IT Support or Systems Administration role and be comfortable working across both end-user technology and the underlying IT environment.

  • Experience supporting Apple / Mac environments in a business setting.

  • Experience with endpoint management tools such as Jamf.

  • Experience administering SaaS applications and user access.

  • Understanding of SSO, SAML, MFA and identity/access management.

  • Experience supporting networking, Wi-Fi and connectivity infrastructure.

  • An understanding of endpoint security and device compliance.

  • Experience working with IT vendors and third-party technology providers.

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

  • Experience maintaining technical documentation, processes and runbooks.

  • An understanding of information security and IT compliance frameworks.

  • Ideally, exposure to Cyber Essentials / Cyber Essentials Plus and/or ISO 27001.

  • A proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues before they become business problems.

  • The ability to communicate technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

In return, we offer you:

  • A competitive salary and the ability to learn & develop your career

  • 25 days holiday (Pro rata)

  • Hybrid way of working for the perfect work / life balance

  • Vitality private health and dental insurance

  • Added benefits including competitive pension and salary sacrifice

  • Full access to Spill, our mental health platform

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Fun and modern office environment with regular team social events

  • City of London location

title: Area Manager
description:
Overview: CYM Living - Where caring meets innovation. We are a national real estate firm with corporate headquarters in Chicago, IL, and just outside of New York City. Our mission is to provide our residents with an exceptional living experience, nurture a culture of community, and empower growth from within. As a vertically integrated firm, we lead with operations by taking a hands-on approach to real estate investment and property management, accomplishing our mission by incorporating data and technology with hyperlocal customer service to all units.

Position Summary:
The Area Manager (AM) is the full P&L owner for an assigned zone or portfolio, accountable for financial performance, rent strategy, operational alignment, and risk management. This role provides senior leadership across multiple properties, ensuring that onsite execution and management decisions directly support revenue growth, expense control, compliance, and long-term asset performance.

The AM leads Property Managers (PM), sets strategy, approves key financial and operational decisions, and serves as the escalation point for high-risk, tenant, regulatory, and external matters.

Key Responsibilities:

  • P&L Ownership & Financial Leadership:
    • Own full financial performance for the zone, including NOI, revenue growth, and expense control
    • Monitor unit turn progress, maintenance spending, and operational expense trends
    • Review delinquency and vacancy loss on a monthly basis and direct corrective action
    • Review monthly financial statements and analyze variance drivers against budget and forecast
    • Approve annual budgets and ensure execution aligns with financial targets

Success in this position requires strong ownership, strategic thinking, and proactive collaboration across properties, departments, and leadership teams. We expect team members in this role to go beyond day-to-day oversight—anticipating risks, identifying growth opportunities, driving operational alignment, and coaching SPMs and PMs to excel. An entrepreneurial mindset, initiative, and a commitment to both financial and operational excellence are essential.

Requirements

Salary: $70K-$90K

Benefits

title: Traveling Construction Engineer Student Intern & Co-Op
description:
Overview

At JP Cullen, an internship or co-op means getting off the sidelines and into the action. As a Traveling Construction Site Engineer Intern/Co-op, you'll become part of a project team and gain firsthand experience with what it takes to build complex projects in the field. You'll learn from experienced construction professionals, take on real project responsibilities, solve problems alongside the team, and see the impact of your work firsthand. And because this position travels nation-wide, your experience isn't limited to one location. You'll have the opportunity to work on projects in different areas, meet new teams, and experience the variety that comes with a career in construction. We want you to finish your internship or co-op having accomplished something you're proud of, with a much stronger understanding of the industry and where you could see yourself growing within JP Cullen.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities for any intern and co-op position will depend on the actual assignment, but will include:

  • Field Assignments and Assistant Project Management Assignments: If your assignment is with a Project Manager or on a jobsite with a Superintendent, we will give you as much responsibility as you can show us you will handle. Work in this position varies depending on the specific needs of whomever you are working for but will expose you to almost all aspects of work in the field. Specific work assignments may include:
  • Shop Drawings – You may be assigned to expedite, review, and coordinate shop drawings and submittals for projects under construction.
  • Drawing Updates - You will incorporate revisions to contract documents as necessary to keep jobsite or office copies “up to date”. This will involve “posting” of construction change bulletins on blueprints and in specifications.
  • Change Orders – You may assist in organizing and estimating change order work for projects under construction. This will include contacting subcontractors to get their pricing, estimating quantities for Cullen’s work, comparing changed work to original takeoff, and helping the Project Manager put together a complete cost proposal.
  • RFIs (Requests for Information) – You may be asked to evaluate problems in the field, or discrepancies and problems with the drawings. You would determine the cause of the problem, document it, produce sketches for clarification, and submit RFI’s to the designer. Then you would follow through to make sure the issue is resolved, and the answer gets to the field to not delay construction.
  • Scheduling – Using Primavera’s P6 scheduling program (or similar), you may be assigned to update, print, and distribute schedules for project. This would involve direct conversation with the responsible superintendent and with subcontractors for data input.
  • Drawings - You will produce miscellaneous sketches and drawings as requested by the Project Manager or Superintendent. These may include formwork, embed locations, miscellaneous metal items, site layouts, etc. Drawings are usually done for the field and are intended to translate difficult drawing information into something the field can use to build. May be done with paper and pencil or with a CAD program.
  • Project Closeout - You will prepare project closeout documents, which will include updating “asbuilt” information on the contract drawings and organization of record documents and warranties. You will expedite warranty and O&M manual submissions from subcontractors.h) Coordination Meetings – The Superintendent may want you to prepare an agenda for and participate in weekly jobsite meetings where schedule is discussed in detail and subcontractors coordinate their work. You would produce minutes from those meetings and follow up that subcontractors meet their commitments
  • Monitoring Subcontractors - You may work with subcontractors to monitor their work, ensure they will make their schedules, monitor their manpower, and monitor/inspect the quality of their work and compliance with specifications and drawings.
  • Deliveries – You may be procuring materials for the project. With direction from the Project Manager or Superintendent, you would set up a log, prepare a delivery schedule, find problems, visit suppliers, track shipments, check materials, and make sure they are labeled and stored properly.
  • Backcharge Tickets and Extra Work Tickets – You may prepare summaries of labor and material costs for backcharge or extra work, provide appropriate explanations and get agreements and signatures from subcontractors and owners.

Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architectural Engineering, or related field
  • Strong communication and teamwork abilities
  • Attention to detail
  • Willingness to learn

Why JP Cullen?

JP Cullen is a fifth-generation, family-owned, full-service construction management firm that specializes in budgeting, planning and constructing the tough jobs. Our clients recognize JP Cullen as experts at working within active construction sites where safety is of the utmost importance, discovering solutions for something that was said could not be done, and delivering projects on time, on budget, the right way, the first time. By tackling the toughest projects JP Cullen has created an expertise that is unrivaled.While many things have changed over the course of 130+ years, the JP Cullen values, which guide our decision making and create a sense of community, have not. We believe that our team and values are the greatest assets to our company culture. Our company is powered by individuals whose personal values drive to make a difference. The company has offices in Janesville, Milwaukee and Madison areas.

Compensation & Benefits

This is a paid internship. Interns will receive hourly compensation, PPE, and professional development opportunities.

EEO

JP Cullen is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action (EEO/AA) Employer. We promote diversity by proactively recruiting, hiring, and promoting women, minorities, disabled individuals, and veterans. JP Cullen provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to workin the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

title: Manufacturing Information Security Lead
description:
We are looking for a Manufacturing Information Security Lead to join the global IT Manufacturing Enablement Platform working from Bayer Supply Center Turku (Finland) in a permanent position located on site. You will collaborate across IT and business clusters, take ownership of complex security topics and turn global requirements into practical solutions for our Turku site.

YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Serve as the Information Security Manager (ISM) for manufacturing and R&D operations at Bayer’s Turku facilities

• Take responsibility for the Manufacturing IT Infrastructure QA role at Bayer Turku

• Act as the key local contact for information security matters related to manufacturing and R&D

• Contribute to and define information security architectures for Manufacturing IT and OT environments

• Deliver information security demonstrations, training and awareness sessions

• Assess global information security programs, projects, solutions and tools for the Turku manufacturing environment and lead their effective local implementation

• Maintain user requirement specifications (URS) related to Manufacturing and R&D IT infrastructure and information security

• Own GMP standard operating procedures related to information security, including physical security for local IT facilities and remote access

• Develop and maintain local security-hardening baselines for Manufacturing IT, OT and R&D environments

• Ensure that physical security systems provide an appropriate level of information security protection for Bayer’s Turku facilities

• Work closely with production, engineering, QHSE and support functions to maintain the required information security standards

• Represent local Manufacturing IT and Information Security in the Bayer Turku Exceptional Incident (EXIN/ERTI) process

• Represent local Manufacturing IT and Information Security in the Bayer Security Team Finland

• Represent local Information Security in internal and external audits and assessments

• Represent Bayer Turku in the Finnish Cyber Security Centre’s Chemistry ISAC team; this responsibility requires Finnish-language proficiency

WHO YOU ARE

• You hold at least a Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, information security, networking or a comparable field

• You have proven experience defining and implementing information security requirements in environments with long technology lifecycles and diverse OT assets

• You understand pharmaceutical manufacturing and R&D processes, requirements and technologies

• You bring broad technical, operational and architectural expertise across IT and OT

• You communicate effectively with business stakeholders, shop-floor users, IT and OT professionals, automation engineers and other specialists

• You have experience working in highly regulated environments, such as GMP-regulated operations

• You can engage diverse internal and external stakeholders, assess business objectives from an information security perspective and translate them into implementable processes, architectures and tools

• You constructively challenge existing and emerging requirements, processes, systems and tools, and you are willing to test better approaches where appropriate

• You take ownership of your priorities and manage your workload independently while collaborating openly across organizational boundaries

• You are fluent in both Finnish and English, in writing and in speaking

WE CONSIDER AN ASSET

• Experience in OT information security

• Experience in automation and OT environments, such as SCADA, HMIs and PLCs

• Experience supporting manufacturing or R&D environments with Microsoft technologies and tools, such as Active Directory; wired and wireless networks; application and infrastructure virtualization platforms, such as Citrix and VMware; backup solutions, such as Avamar and Acronis; firewalls; VPNs; and other remote-access solutions

• Professional experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing

• Proved performance on business leadership impact assignments

YOUR APPLICATION

For more information about the position, please contact Unit Lead Digital Plant Operations, Swami Balasubramaniam, available Thursday Oct 15th from 2.30 pm to 4.30 pm (Eastern European Time), phone: +1 724-553-8345.

We welcome applicants who are motivated to protect critical operations, collaborate across disciplines and turn complex challenges into practical solutions that create value for our customers and patients. While you may not tick every box above, you are motivated to expand your expertise and committed to developing any skills needed to succeed in the role.

Please submit your application by October 25, 2026 at the latest.

Seniority level: Professional

title: Data Center Infrastructure Technician
description:
Why E2 Optics?

🚀 Join E2 Optics as a Data Center Infrastructure Technician! 🚀

Are you ready to elevate your career with an award-winning, Woman-Owned technology integrator that's leading the charge in the data center revolution? E2 Optics is one of the fastest-growing and most stable companies at the core of the tech industry—powering the infrastructure behind AI, cloud computing, and the innovations of tomorrow.

At E2 Optics, you will work with cutting-edge systems in some of the most advanced environments in the world. We invest in your growth through hands-on experience, industry certifications, and leadership opportunities that put you in charge of teams and outcomes. Collaboration is in our DNA—we believe in lifting each other up, mentoring with purpose, and celebrating every win.

If you’re looking to be part of something meaningful, fast-moving, and future-focused, your next opportunity is here. Join one of America’s largest and fastest-growing tech integrators and help us shape what’s next.

What You'll Do

  • Basic understanding of RJ45 terminations and punch-downs

The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds and frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. The employee must regularly carry and climb ladders to 20 feet. title: Sommerjobb 2027
description:
Hos oss i NGI – Norges Geotekniske Institutt – har vi mange fagfolk med spisskompetanse innenfor geoteknikk og geofag. Samfunnsoppgaven vår er å drive innovasjon og utvikle kunnskap og ekspertise som er til nytte for samfunnet. Vi har et veldig godt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø og hos blir du kjent med trivelige kollegaer.

Hvem er du?

Vi ser etter deg som liker utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver og ønsker utvikling. Det er fint om du liker å jobbe med andre, men også har evnen til å jobbe selvstendig. Du tar ansvar, viser initiativ og engasjement. Vi tror du vil trives hos oss hvis du er nysgjerrig og sulten på å lære. I tillegg har du gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter på engelsk og norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig. Gode akademiske resultater er en fordel, og vi ser gjerne at du har et karaktersnitt på A eller B.

Hva kan vi tilby?

Hos oss får du muligheten til å jobbe med internasjonalt anerkjente eksperter, og mulighet til å opparbeide deg unik innsikt og forståelse for faget, fra kontor og til feltarbeid. En sommerjobb er ofte en god mulighet til å finne aktuelle problemstillinger og gode faglige veiledere for både prosjekt- og masteroppgaver. NGI har lang erfaring med veiledning av studenter og tilbyr hvert år relevante oppgaver med tilhørende veiledning.


Vi har ledig sommerjobb innen våre fire markedsområder Offshore Energi, Geodata og Teknologi, Naturfare, og Geomiljø. Vi tilbyr sommerjobb på våre splitter nye lokaler på Campus Ullevål i Oslo og i Teknostallen i Trondheim.

I tillegg tilbyr vi gunstige betingelser og to ukers ferie i løpet av arbeidsperioden. En sommerjobb hos varer vanligvis i en periode fra 7-9 uker fra midten av juni til midten av august, og avtales nærmere.

Oslo - Offshore Energi

Vi er internasjonalt ledende innen offshore geoteknikk og en etterspurt rådgiver for offshorenæringen knyttet til offshore utbygging. NGI er meget aktive innen utviklingen av offshore vindenergi og samarbeider nært med ledende internasjonale aktører og forskningsinstitusjoner. Vi har også ledet en rekke internasjonale forskningsprogrammer for industrien. Vi jobber bl.a. med karakterisering og vurdering av havbunnen, fundamentering og forankring, vurdering av naturfarer, og CO2-lagring.


Hvem ser vi etter?
Du er 3. eller 4. års student innenfor:

  • geoteknikk, geologi og geofysikk

  • datateknikk og programmering

  • geofysikk (near-surface)

  • numerisk modellering

Oslo - Geodata og Teknologi

NGIs tverrfaglige teknologimiljø i GeoData og Teknologi har prosjekter innen klima, miljø, energi og samfunnssikkerhet. Vi bidrar med rådgivning, installasjon, laboratoriearbeid, design, softwareutvikling og forskning. I tillegg disponerer vi mye moderne feltutstyr for prøvetaking og forskjellige sonderinger i grunnen. Vi jobber kontinuerlig for å videreutvikle teknologien og nye metoder for grunnundersøkelser. Den store bredden i aktivitetene våre gjør Geodata og Teknologi til en spennende mulighet for studenter.

Hvem ser vi etter?
Du er 3. eller 4. års student innenfor:

  • bygg- og miljøteknikk innenfor geoteknikk, konstruksjon eller andre geofag

  • sivilingeniør innenfor kybernetikk, elektronikk og automasjon

  • tekniske geofag

  • matematikk og fysikk

  • datakommunikasjon og datateknologi

  • programmering og utvikling

Oslo - Naturfare

Klimaendringer fører til mer ekstremvær og et økende antall uønskede naturhendelser. NGIs markedsområde Naturfare utvikler tjenester for kommuner og andre som vil undersøke skråningsstabilitet eller kartlegge lokal effekt av forventede klimaendringer. Vi utforsker muligheter for å bruke naturen selv som løsning (naturbaserte løsninger) for å håndtere flom, overvann og skred, og setter sammen risiko- og sårbarhetsanalyser. Ikke minst utvikler vi ny teknologi som for eksempel bruk av droner og maskinlæring for skredkartlegging. Vi driver forskning og rådgivning, og jobber mye både i felt og på kontor. Arbeidsoppgavene hos oss er varierte og vi ønsker din kunnskap anvendt på vårt fagfelt.

Hvem ser vi etter?
Du er 3. eller 4. års student med spesialisering innenfor:

  • geoteknikk, geologi og geofysikk

  • geomatikk og GIS

  • fjernanalyse

  • maskinlæring og kunstig intelligens

  • utvikling og programmering

  • datakommunikasjon og visualisering

Oslo - Geomiljø

NGI er en verdifull bidragsyter innen bygg- og anleggssektoren. Vår ekspertise omfatter grunnundersøkelser, numeriske beregninger og analyse, geoteknisk prosjektering av grunnarbeider og fundamentering, og håndtering av forurenset grunn. NGI løser et bredt spekter av oppdrag innen industri, samferdsel og byggeprosjekter. Digitale løsninger og 3D-modellering er en naturlig del av våre tjenester, og vi fokuserer på optimale og bærekraftige løsninger i samarbeid med kundene. NGI er også engasjert i forskning og samfunnsutfordringer knyttet til miljø og bærekraft.

Hvem ser vi etter?
Du er 3. eller 4. års student innenfor:

  • bygg- og miljøteknikk innenfor geoteknikk

  • tekniske geofag

  • miljøgeofag

  • geologi og geofysikk

Trondheim - Geomiljø og Naturfare

NGIs avdelinger Miljø og ingeniørgeologi, Landgeoteknikk og Naturfare i Trondheim er en del av markedsområdene Geomiljø og Naturfare, og har et solid fagmiljø som jobber med geologiske og geoteknisk rådgivning og forskning. Vi jobber innenfor tradisjonell geoteknikk på land, med skred- og stabilitetsvurderinger i løsmasser, og vi hjelper kunder med løsninger knyttet til forurensning i grunn, sediment og grunnvann. Avdelingene har spesialkompetanse på løsmassers materialegenskaper, fundamenteringsløsninger, grunnforsterkning, byggegropssikring og vurdering av skred, og bidrar samtidig til løsninger for miljøutfordringer som forurensning fra gruver, deponi og forurenset grunn, sediment og grunnvann.

Hvem ser vi etter?
Du er 3. eller 4. års student innenfor:

  • bygg- og miljøteknikk innenfor geoteknikk eller konstruksjon

  • geomatikk og GIS

  • geologi, hydrogeologi, biologi eller kjemi

  • maskinlæring og kunstig intelligens

  • utvikling og programmering

  • datakommunikasjon og visualisering

Søknad sendes gjennom vår digitale søknadsportal med følgende dokumenter:

  • søknadsbrev

  • CV

  • vitnemål fra høyere utdanning

  • andre relevante dokumenter

Vi behandler søknader fortløpende frem til søknadsfristen 1. februar 2027, og oppfordrer derfor til å sende inn din søknad så snart som mulig.

Vi jobber for å fremme et mangfoldig, rettferdig og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø. Som en del av vår rekrutteringsprosess gjør vi oppmerksom på at det kan bli gjennomført bakgrunnssjekk av aktuelle kandidater, noe som kun skjer med kandidatens samtykke.

title: Customer Experience & Automation Specialist
description:
Position Details

Location: Healthy Kids Programs, 2 Summit Court, Fishkill, NY 12524

About the Role

You'll be a primary point of contact for prospective families, helping them navigate registration, enrollment, and childcare assistance programs. Experience with childcare subsidy programs, CRM systems, automation, or AI tools is helpful, but you don't need to have experience in all of these areas to be successful in the role.


What You'll Do

Family Registration, Enrollment & Support

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for prospective and enrolled families through phone and email.
  • Guide families through registration, enrollment, scheduling, and required documentation.
  • Process registrations accurately, including billing, scheduling, and account setup.
  • Follow up with prospective families to help them complete enrollment and stay engaged throughout the process.
  • Develop expertise in childcare subsidy and tuition assistance programs across Healthy Kids service areas.
  • Help families understand subsidy eligibility, application, recertification, and documentation requirements.
  • Support families in completing enrollment steps that coordinate with childcare assistance and subsidy programs.
  • Track subsidy-related registration progress and proactively communicate next steps to families.
  • Maintain current knowledge of changing subsidy policies, deadlines, and family requirements.
  • Track registration activity and generate reports using CRM and registration systems.

Automation & Process Improvement

  • Identify repetitive, time-consuming, or inefficient tasks that could be simplified or automated.
  • Build and maintain automated communications, reminders, and follow-up sequences using approved systems and platforms.
  • Support CRM optimization, data cleanup, and process standardization.
  • Assist with implementation and testing of workflow automation tools and AI-enabled administrative processes.
  • Monitor automation performance and recommend improvements.
  • Create standard operating procedures (SOPs), templates, and training materials for registration and enrollment workflows.
  • Help reduce manual administrative work while maintaining a high-touch, family-centered experience.

title: Pre-K Site Director – Before & After School
description:
LOCATION: Arlington Central School District in Lagrangeville, NY

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Why E2 Optics?

🚀 Join Our Team and Shape the Future of Connectivity! We're Hiring: Senior Project Manager at E2 Optics 🚀

Are you ready to elevate your career with an award-winning, Woman-Owned technology integrator that's leading the charge in the data center revolution? E2 Optics is one of the fastest-growing and most stable companies at the core of the tech industry—powering the infrastructure behind AI, cloud computing, and the innovations of tomorrow.

At E2 Optics, you will work with cutting-edge systems in some of the most advanced environments in the world. We invest in your growth through hands-on experience, industry certifications, and leadership opportunities that put you in charge of teams and outcomes. Collaboration is in our DNA—we believe in lifting each other up, mentoring with purpose, and celebrating every win.

If you’re looking to be part of something meaningful, fast-moving, and future-focused, your next opportunity is here. Join one of America’s largest and fastest-growing tech integrators and help us shape what’s next.

What You'll Do

The role of the Senior Project Manager is to serve as an ambassador for E2 Optics and is responsible for overseeing all aspects of assigned projects from initiation to closing. The Senior Project Manager supervises and directs project resources to deliver value effectively and consistently to the customer. Responsible and accountable for strategic alignment and the execution of corporate operational processes to drive the timely delivery of safely completed project work that exceeds quality expectations and is compliant with contract documents, schedule, and budget.

  • Safety is E2 Optics' number one Core Value. All employees are expected to follow safe work practices, as well as adhere to company and client worksite safety policies and procedures.
  • Promote company Core Values to foster and safeguard a family-centric culture.
  • Align business objectives, strategically plan, and proactively allocate appropriate resources to partner with and support the customer within a holistic risk and safety management program.
  • Promote and foster a culture of employee empowerment to proactively prevent hazards in the workplace and enable coworkers to perform their duties in a safe and efficient manner.
  • Manage assigned projects in accordance with a schedule that supports favorable performance indexing that meets or exceeds the expectations of the project plan.
  • Effectively manage subcontractor/vendor performance to ensure compliant project delivery.
  • Manage installation strategies to ensure the most effective industry best practices and means and methods are leveraged to complete the project on schedule and within budget.
  • Travel: This position generally requires overnight travel. The individual in this role should be able and willing to travel as required by E2 Optics.

What We Are Looking For

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • BS in Project Management or Construction Management. Relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree
  • Minimum 7-10 years of experience managing structured cabling and integrated systems projects
  • Experienced in the management of multiple contractual types and vehicles-lump sum, cost plus/GMP, unit price, design-build/design-assist, time, and material
  • BICSI RCDD, BICSI RTPM, or PMP preferred
  • Other BICSI Certifications are a plus(Installer, Technician, etc.)
  • Ability to identify change events and implement change management best practices.
  • Knowledge of various construction technology platforms, quality, and safety standards

What We Offer

  • Competitive pay
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth
  • BICSI training facilities
  • A supportive and inclusive work environment
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Paid time off and holidays

Work Environment and Physical Demands

The standard work environment for this position is an indoors business office and construction environment. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. This role requires sitting, use of hands and arms, verbal communication, and occasional physical movement such as stooping or kneeling. The employee is frequently required to stand and walk. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds and frequently lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. The employee must regularly carry and climb ladders to 20 feet. Must be able to operate equipment such as scissor lifts, telehandlers, boom lifts, and UTVs (buggies) if required to do so. The employee may also be required to work in tight and confined spaces. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. When possible, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Disclaimer

The above job definition information has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. Job duties and responsibilities are subject to change based on changing business needs and conditions.

title: Compliance Business Partner
description:
About the role

We are looking for a Compliance Business Partner to join our Risk and Compliance function here at Superscript.

You will play a key role in supporting the business to maintain strong regulatory standards while enabling sustainable commercial growth. You will work closely with senior stakeholders across broking, underwriting, partnerships, product, and operations, providing clear, pragmatic regulatory advice and ensuring that compliance frameworks are effectively embedded across the organisation.

Reporting directly into the Fractional Compliance Leader, this role is suited to someone with between 3-6 years’ experience in a compliance, risk, or regulatory role within a regulated financial services environment, ideally within an insurance broker.

This is a hands-on second line role, requiring strong technical knowledge of Financial Conduct Authority requirements and the ability to influence and partner with the business in a fast-paced, digital insurance environment.

What you'll get up to:

  • Act as a trusted compliance advisor to business units, providing clear and practical guidance on regulatory obligations and best practice.

  • Build strong working relationships with underwriting, partnerships, product, and claims teams to support compliant decision-making.

  • Provide independent challenge on:

    • Product governance and fair value assessments

    • Distribution arrangements, including agency approvals and partner due diligence

    • Customer journeys, communications, and customer outcome

  • Monitor regulatory developments (e.g. FCA publications, thematic reviews, enforcement activity) and assess their impact on the business.

  • Interpret and advise on FCA rules and guidance, including ICOBS, SYSC, and Consumer Duty.

  • Conduct gap analysis against new or evolving regulatory requirements.

  • Provide second line oversight and challenge on the implementation of regulatory change across the business.

  • Support the development, implementation, and ongoing enhancement of compliance frameworks, policies, and procedures.

  • Own and coordinate the review and update of compliance policies, ensuring appropriate governance, version control, and approval processes are followed.

  • Oversee the documentation of key compliance processes and controls.

  • Support the design and execution of a risk-based Compliance Monitoring Plan (CMP).

  • Conduct thematic reviews and control testing across key regulatory areas, including financial promotions, product governance, vulnerable customers, and distribution.

  • Track and validate remediation actions to ensure issues are effectively addressed.

  • Maintain oversight of financial promotions approval processes, and agency and Appointed Representative frameworks.

  • Support with breach identification, escalation, and remediation, as well as complaints and conduct risk outputs, including root cause analysis.

  • Support the delivery and ongoing embedding of key regulatory initiatives, including Consumer Duty, fair value assessment, and conduct risk frameworks.

  • Ensure regulatory expectations are reflected in day-to-day business activities and decision-making.

  • Support regulatory reporting and submissions, including FCA returns and SUP 15 notifications.

  • Prepare and review compliance Management Information for governance forums, including the Risk & Compliance Committee and Conduct Risk Committee.

  • Support the production of Consumer Duty Board reporting.

  • Escalate material regulatory risks and issues to senior management and governance forums where appropriate.

About you:

  • 3-6 years’ experience in a compliance, risk, or regulatory role within an FCA-regulated financial services environment.

  • Experience working for an insurance broker is essential.

  • Strong understanding of FCA regulatory requirements, including consumer duty, conduct risk principles, ICOBS and SYSC

  • Experience supporting governance structures, regulatory reporting, and compliance frameworks.

  • Experience in compliance monitoring, thematic reviews, and oversight activities.

  • Ability to interpret regulation and translate it into practical, business-focused guidance.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

In return, we offer you:

  • A competitive salary and the ability to grow your career

  • 25 days holiday - so there’s plenty of time for work, rest and play

  • Hybrid way of working for the perfect work / life balance

  • Vitality private health and dental insurance

  • Added benefits including competitive pension and salary sacrifice

  • Access to financial wellbeing platform Mintago

  • Full access to Spill, our mental health platform

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Fun and modern office environment with regular team social events

  • City of London location

title: News Editor - SPORTbible

The role

  • Commission, edit and publish accurate, engaging, legally sound journalism

LBG Media plc is one of the world's fastest-growing digital media companies. Our brands, including LADbible, reach over 1 billion people and generate 13.9 billion social views every month. title: DevOps Engineer (Saudi)
description:
About Lucidya

Lucidya is an AI-native Customer Experience Intelligence platform enabling enterprises to understand, engage, and retain customers at scale. Unlike tools that just surface insights, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary AI capabilities, helping teams take action and improve customer experiences across marketing, support, and research.

As we scale globally, building reliable, scalable, and automated infrastructure is a top priority. DevOps is a core pillar of our engineering strategy, and we are investing heavily in deployment pipelines, observability, and operational efficiency across all products.

Why This Role Matters

Our engineering teams deliver fast-moving, AI-driven products, and the backbone of their speed and reliability is solid infrastructure and automation. As a DevOps Engineer, you’ll ensure our systems scale seamlessly, deployments happen without friction, and incidents are caught before they impact users. You’ll enable our teams to move faster, focus on building features, and trust that the platform is rock-solid.

You’ll be part of shaping the operational culture at Lucidya, where automation, reliability, and proactive problem solving aren’t just buzzwords, they’re outcomes we obsess over every day.

What You’ll Do

  • Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines to support reliable and efficient software delivery.
  • Deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Support cloud infrastructure management and automation using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.
  • Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions using tools such as Grafana.
  • Automate repetitive operational tasks and support development teams with infrastructure and deployment needs.
  • Troubleshoot deployment, application, and infrastructure issues, identifying root causes and implementing solutions.
  • Collaborate with engineers to improve system performance, reliability, and release processes.
  • Follow security best practices across deployment pipelines, applications, and infrastructure.
  • Participate in incident investigation and resolution, escalating complex issues when necessary.
  • Contribute to documentation and continuous improvement of infrastructure workflows and operational processes.

Day-to-Day You’ll:

  • Deploy applications and support routine operations within Kubernetes environments.
  • Build, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines for new and existing services.
  • Monitor system health, investigate alerts, and resolve common deployment and infrastructure issues.
  • Support developers with application deployments, environment configurations, and infrastructure requests.
  • Write and maintain scripts to automate repetitive operational tasks.
  • Assist with infrastructure provisioning and configuration management.
  • Collaborate with senior engineers to investigate complex incidents and improve system reliability.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve automation, observability, and operational efficiency.

Success Looks Like:

  • Reliable CI/CD pipelines with fewer deployment failures and smoother releases.
  • Successful deployment and operation of containerized applications in Kubernetes.
  • Faster identification and resolution of common infrastructure and deployment issues.
  • Reduced manual operational effort through automation.
  • Improved monitoring, logging, and visibility into application health.
  • Effective collaboration with engineering teams and clear documentation of operational processes.

First 90 Days

  • 0–30 Days: Understand Lucidya’s infrastructure, architecture, deployment workflows, tools, and operational practices. Become familiar with existing cloud environments and Kubernetes deployments.
  • 30–60 Days: Contribute to CI/CD pipeline improvements, support routine deployments, troubleshoot common issues, and take ownership of smaller infrastructure tasks with guidance from senior engineers.
  • 60–90 Days: Successfully onboard 2–3 services onto the existing Kubernetes environment, with appropriate CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and health checks, collaborating with senior engineers where needed.

Requirements

Who You Are

  • Experienced: You have 1–3 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, or a related role.
  • Hands-On: You have practical experience with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Proactive Problem Solver: You can investigate common technical issues, identify root causes, and implement solutions while knowing when to escalate complex problems.
  • Collaborative: You work closely with developers and other engineers to support deployments and improve infrastructure reliability.
  • Curious & Growth-Oriented: You are eager to learn, improve existing systems, and develop your expertise in cloud infrastructure, automation, and observability.
  • Quality-Focused: You understand the importance of reliable deployments, infrastructure security, monitoring, and operational documentation.

Technical Skills You’ll Bring

  • CI/CD: Hands-on experience building, maintaining, or improving CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or similar.
  • Containers & Orchestration: Practical experience with Docker and working knowledge of Kubernetes, including application deployments, configurations, and troubleshooting.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Familiarity with Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar tools for provisioning and managing infrastructure.
  • Cloud Platforms: Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider, such as AWS or GCP.
  • Scripting & Automation: Ability to write basic automation scripts using Bash or Python.
  • Monitoring & Observability: Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and alerting tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, or similar.
  • Configuration Management: Basic knowledge of tools such as Ansible, Puppet, or Chef.
  • Linux & Networking: Working knowledge of Linux systems, networking fundamentals, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, and troubleshooting connectivity issues.
  • Version Control: Experience using Git and working with collaborative software development workflows.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience working in a SaaS, product-based, or AI-driven environment.
  • Exposure to production Kubernetes environments and container orchestration.
  • Familiarity with advanced monitoring, observability, and incident management practices.
  • Understanding of cloud security, secrets management, and infrastructure access controls.
  • Experience optimizing deployment workflows and improving infrastructure reliability.

title: Drug Product Group Lead
description:
Position Summary

The Drug Product Group Lead is responsible for the day-to-day leadership, technical oversight, and compliant execution of Drug Product (DP) manufacturing at Northway Biotech's Waltham site. The role oversees clinical fill-finish operations, process implementation, technology transfers, validation activities, and continuous improvement in accordance with cGMP, regulatory requirements, and customer expectations.

This is a hands-on technical leadership position within a small manufacturing team. In addition to coordinating and supervising DP activities, the DP Lead is expected to personally perform routine manufacturing operations within the production suite and actively participate in the execution of manufacturing processes.

The DP Lead works closely with Quality, MS&T, Engineering, Supply Chain, Program Management, and other functions to ensure manufacturing readiness and successful execution of client programs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and actively participate in day-to-day Drug Product manufacturing operations, including aseptic filling, formulation, final filtration, filling line operations, visual inspection, labeling, and packaging.

  • Personally perform routine Drug Product manufacturing activities within the production suite, including equipment setup, operation, aseptic processing, filling operations, and associated manufacturing tasks.

  • Provide direct supervision, technical guidance, and hands-on support to a small team of DP manufacturing personnel while remaining actively involved in daily production activities.

  • Coordinate manufacturing priorities, staffing, resources, and readiness of processes, equipment, and documentation to support scheduled manufacturing campaigns.

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership during manufacturing execution, equipment troubleshooting, deviation investigations, and resolution of operational issues.

  • Lead and actively support customer Drug Product process implementation and technology transfers from development through clinical manufacturing, including engineering runs, PPQ, process validation, and continued process verification.

  • Ensure compliance with cGMP, FDA, EMA, ICH, and internal quality systems; partner with Quality Assurance and maintain audit and inspection readiness.

  • Prepare, review, and approve relevant SOPs, batch records, change controls, deviations, CAPAs, investigations, and validation documentation within delegated authority.

  • Drive right-first-time performance, schedule adherence, operational KPIs, productivity, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Train, coach, and develop Drug Product staff through direct technical instruction, hands-on demonstrations, and participation in manufacturing activities.

  • Serve as the Drug Product technical point of contact for cross-functional teams and clients; support technical discussions, project scoping, and customer meetings as needed.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Biotechnology, Chemical Engineering, Biochemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biology, or a related scientific discipline; advanced degree preferred.

  • 8+ years of experience in biopharmaceutical manufacturing or pharmaceutical operations, including 3+ years in a leadership or supervisory role; CDMO experience strongly preferred.

title: Deltidsjobb – Statistisk modellering, data og kraftmarked
description:
NTE Energi søker en student som ønsker å bidra til kvalitetssikring og videreutvikling av MCPN – en egenutviklet modell for simulering av kraftpriser og vindkraftproduksjon. Stillingen er på 20 prosent og passer for deg som ønsker å kombinere studier med en faglig relevant problemstilling i et profesjonelt fagmiljø.

Om stillingen

Dette er en unik mulighet til å arbeide med statistisk modellering og tidsseriedata på en konkret problemstilling med direkte relevans for kraftmarkedet.

Kraftforvaltning i NTE har utviklet MCPN (Monte Carlo Power Nordic), som kombinerer en Bayesiansk VAR-modell (BVAR) med Monte Carlo-simulering. Modellen brukes blant annet som støtte ved prising av kraftkontrakter, analyse av porteføljerisiko og vurdering av forretningsmuligheter i det nordiske kraftmarkedet.

Som student vil du få et faglig utenfrablikk på modellen og jobbe med en konkret problemstilling knyttet til hvordan ukentlige prisbaner kombineres med variasjon mellom timene i uken. Hovedleveransen vil være reproduserbare analyser og testkode, en sammenligning av dagens metode og utvalgte alternativer, samt en kortfattet vurdering av funn og anbefalt videre retning.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidet vil blant annet innebære å:

  • sette deg inn i dagens metode for å kombinere ukespris og timesvariasjon

  • etablere kriterier og tester for å vurdere hvor realistiske timesprisscenarioene er

  • analysere modellresultater på tvers av ulike prisnivåer og årstider

  • teste et avgrenset utvalg alternative metoder

  • vurdere konsekvenser for utvalgte prisings- og risikoberegninger

  • dokumentere funn og anbefale videre metodevalg

Du vil jobbe med historiske spotpriser og vinddata, samt prisdata fra markedet. Arbeidet gjennomføres i tett dialog med fagpersoner i Kraftforvaltning, med en tydelig avgrenset problemstilling og regelmessig faglig sparring.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som går fjerde året i et relevant masterløp innen for eksempel:

  • statistikk

  • matematikk

  • data science

  • samfunnsøkonomi

  • finansiell økonomi

  • industriell økonomi

  • energi

  • eller andre kvantitative fagområder

Av erfaring og personlige egenskaper, ser vi etter deg som:

  • har interesse for statistisk modellering, tidsserier og usikkerhet

  • har erfaring med, eller gode forutsetninger for å arbeide i Python

  • arbeider strukturert og etterprøvbart

  • evner å sette deg inn i en eksisterende modell og utfordre antakelser på en konstruktiv måte

  • kan formidle tekniske funn på en enkel og forståelig måte

Kjennskap til BVAR, bayesiansk statistikk eller kraftmarkedet er en fordel, men ikke et absolutt krav.

Videre muligheter

Stillingen er på 20%, normalt én arbeidsdag i uken, og har en varighet på seks måneder, med mulighet for forlengelse.

For deg som ønsker å gå videre med problemstillingen, kan stillingen også danne grunnlag for en relevant masteroppgave i samarbeid med NTE. Ved god faglig match kan det også være muligheter for videre samarbeid etter studiene.

Interessert?

Synes du dette høres spennende ut? Da håper vi du sender oss en søknad. Fortell gjerne litt om hva du studerer, hvilke fagområder du interesserer deg for, og hvordan du liker å jobbe med kvantitative problemstillinger.

Vi vurderer kandidater fortløpende, og målet er å ha gjennomført rekrutteringen før nyttår. Ved eventuelle spørsmål er du velkommen til å ta kontakt med Trygve Sørås på e-post (trygve.soras@nte.no).

title: Distributionschaufför - Extra / vid behov
description:
Distributionschaufför

Som distributionschaufför har du en viktig roll i logistikkedjan och ansvarar för att paket och varor når privatpersoner och företag på ett säkert, effektivt och professionellt sätt.

Vi söker just nu framför allt extra personal som kan arbeta vid behov och hoppa in när verksamheten kräver förstärkning. Rollen passar dig som har möjlighet att vara flexibel och arbeta både planerade pass och, efter överenskommelse, med kortare framförhållning.

De arbetspass som bokas och överenskommes med dig planeras in enligt överenskommelse. Omfattningen kan variera beroende på verksamhetens behov och din tillgänglighet.

För dig som visar god kvalitet, pålitlighet och tillgänglighet kan det även finnas möjlighet till fler och mer regelbundna arbetspass över tid.

Arbetet är aktivt, självständigt och varierande. Du utgår vanligtvis från en terminal där du förbereder dagens rutt, sorterar och lastar försändelser i fordonet innan du påbörjar dina leveranser. Under arbetsdagen använder du förarapp och navigationssystem för att genomföra rutten och registrera leveranser.

Som chaufför är du företagets ansikte utåt och har daglig kontakt med kunder och mottagare. Rollen ställer därför höga krav på service, ansvarstagande och ett professionellt bemötande.

Arbetet sker ofta i ett högt tempo där du behöver kunna planera din tid, arbeta effektivt och självständigt lösa situationer som kan uppstå under arbetsdagen.

Arbetsuppgifter

  • Leverera paket och varor till privatpersoner och företag

  • Köra skåpbil eller lätt lastbil

  • Sortera, lasta och lossa försändelser

  • Planera och genomföra tilldelade leveransrutter

  • Hantera och registrera leveranser via förarapp

  • Säkerställa att leveranser genomförs korrekt och inom utsatt tid

  • Ge ett professionellt och serviceinriktat bemötande

  • Hantera avvikelser och problem som uppstår under rutten

  • Ansvara för fordon, utrustning och gods under arbetspasset

  • Rapportera skador, avvikelser och andra händelser enligt gällande rutiner

  • Bidra till hög leveranskvalitet och kundnöjdhet

Vi söker dig som

  • Har giltigt B-körkort

  • Talar och förstår svenska

  • Är punktlig, pålitlig och ansvarstagande

  • Trivs med ett aktivt arbete och högt tempo

  • Kan arbeta självständigt och strukturerat

  • Är lösningsorienterad och kan fatta egna beslut

  • Har ett trevligt och professionellt kundbemötande

  • Är noggrann och kvalitetsmedveten

  • Tar ansvar för både leveranser, fordon och utrustning

Meriterande

  • Erfarenhet av bud-, transport- eller distributionskörning

  • Erfarenhet av att köra skåpbil eller lätt lastbil

  • Erfarenhet från lager eller terminal

  • Truckkort A och/eller B

  • God digital vana och erfarenhet av förarappar eller liknande system

Tidigare erfarenhet är meriterande men inte alltid ett krav. För rollen är ansvarstagande, punktlighet, arbetsmoral och förmågan att leverera med hög kvalitet särskilt viktigt.

title: Senior Creative
description:
About LADbible Group

LADbible Group is one of the world’s most engaged digital entertainment businesses, reaching over a billion people globally and amassing more than 13.9 billion social views each month. With a powerhouse portfolio across general lifestyle, entertainment, sport, gaming, and tech, our brands: - including LADbible, UNILAD, GAMINGbible, and UNILAD Tech, are some of the most recognised and culturally relevant on the internet.

Due to continued business growth and wins, we are expanding the Creative team even further!

We’re looking for a conceptual Senior Creative to lead the creative ideation, strategy and execution for our branded pitches and campaigns. It’s an opportunity that requires excellent creative skills and an in-depth understanding of youth culture to be able to run the process from end to end, whilst also demonstrating commercial awareness and our ways of working at LADbible Group.

We've got incredible briefs and clients we work with, including the growth of Betches UK so this role suits someone who is culture and social obsessed!

What the opportunity looks like

  • Develop strong social-first ideas and challenge briefs and strategies where necessary

  • Be a content specialist, understanding the roles and production constraints of different content types (especially video) on social platforms

  • Specialise in social-led activations but be familiar with creating integrated campaigns, with an understanding of how to use everything from OOH to experiential in your campaign strategies

  • Communicate and champion creative thinking and technical execution to clients throughout each project

  • Oversee junior project teams to help them deliver their best work

Skills and experience we’d like you to have

  • Experience in a fast-paced, quick turnaround environment

  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

  • Understanding of how budgets work, scope of work and realistic deliverables

  • Proven track record delivering creatively and commercially successful projects

At LADbible Group we've rolled out blended working which means the majority of departments across the business (including London, Manchester and International offices) work from home and the offices on a weekly basis.

LADbible Group is an equal opportunities employer. We are determined to create a diverse group at all levels of our company and we welcome all members of the community to apply for openings with us.
