As a business, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce, in an environment where everyone feels comfortable to be themselves.

title: Entreprenadingenjör till RO-Gruppen i Malmö
description:
Entreprenadingenjör till Malmö

På RO-Gruppen vill vi fortsätta bygga framtiden med människor som vill mer än att genomföra projekt. Människor som vågar utmana det självklara, vill utvecklas, påverka och ta ansvar. Som drivs av att skapa värde, både i projekten och för människorna omkring sig.

Nu söker vi en Entreprenadingenjör till Malmö.

Malmö är ett av RO-Gruppens yngsta kontor och etablerade oss här i slutet av 2025 av Amanda Modig och Magnus Jarebrant. Vi befinner oss fortfarande i en spännande uppbyggnadsfas, men samtidigt kliver du inte in i en nystartad verksamhet. Du blir en del av RO-Gruppen, ett etablerat byggföretag med verksamhet på flera orter i Sverige och en tydlig ambition för framtiden.

Som koncern har vi ett uttalat mål att bli ett av Sveriges tio största byggföretag. Det innebär att du får det bästa av två världar: möjligheten att påverka och forma något lokalt, med styrkan och erfarenheten från en etablerad organisation i ryggen.

Om rollen

Som entreprenadingenjör blir du en viktig del av våra projekt från anbud till projektöverlämnande. Du arbetar med kalkyl, inköp, projektekonomi och kostnadsuppföljning och bidrar med struktur, affärsmässighet och framdrift genom hela projektet.

Vi arbetar i hög grad med samverkansprojekt där vi kommer in tidigt och får möjlighet att påverka lösningar innan allt är satt. Tillsammans med våra kunder utforskar vi smartare, mer resurseffektiva och hållbara sätt att bygga.

Rollen erbjuder goda utvecklingsmöjligheter och för dig som vill finns på sikt möjlighet att växa inom exempelvis projekteringsledning.

Vi tror att du:

  • Har några års erfarenhet från byggbranschen och byggproduktion.

  • Har arbetat med kalkyl och/eller projektekonomi.

  • Har erfarenhet av inköp, förhandling och har ett affärsmässigt arbetssätt.

  • Är van att ta eget ansvar och driva flera frågor parallellt.

  • Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift.

Erfarenhet av samverkansprojekt, ombyggnadsprojekt, projektering eller tidiga skeden är meriterande. Vi ser också positivt på om du använder AI-baserade verktyg för att effektivisera och utveckla ditt arbete.

För att trivas hos oss behöver du känna igen dig i vår värdegrund FENA: Förtroende, Engagemang, Nytänkande och Arbetsglädje. Det är grunden för vår kultur och hur vi arbetar tillsammans.

Vi tror också på vårt Challenger Mindset, ett förhållningssätt som handlar om att förstå behov på djupet, utmana det som inte skapar värde och tillsammans hitta bättre lösningar för kunder, projekt och kollegor. Därför söker vi dig som är nyfiken, relationsskapande och lösningsorienterad.

På RO-Gruppen vill vi skapa Sveriges bästa vardag. En arbetsplats där alla medarbetare får utvecklas, må bra, lära av varandra och ha roligt tillsammans. Det gör vi genom nära ledarskap, korta beslutsvägar, stort förtroende och möjligheten att påverka, men också genom utbildningar, kick-offer, trivselresor, RO Wellness och attraktiva förmåner.

Vill du vara med och forma framtiden med oss?

Då vill vi gärna höra från dig. Skicka in din ansökan så tar vi dialogen därifrån.

Stay Curious.

You’re comfortable being accountable and owning our production system, you care about the quality, long-term maintainability, reliability, cost efficiency, and security of the software you and your agents deliver.

  • Experience with distributed systems design and development in similar professional environments (fast growth start-ups, SaaS/logitics/e-commerce/payment domains)

  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and modern CI/CD, IaaC (Terraform, k8s, gh actions)

  • Fundamentals in Linux/Unix systems and networking

  • Fluency working with AI in engineering and in a software development lifecycle that harnesses AI

  • Full-stack engineering skills is a plus (a good taste in building products that customers love)

Responsibilities

  • Be part of our core engineering team with company-wide, high-leverage initiatives impact

  • Navigate through high-ambiguity, mission-critical projects and define execution paths that balance speed, quality, and long-term sustainability

  • Great written skills - reviewing and writing architecture reviews, RFCs, and design documents is our daily work!

  • Bring in unique perspective, voice and maintain high engineering bar

title: Open Application
description:

title: Specialist Debiteurenbeheer
description:
Complexe debiteurendossiers, financiële risico’s en processen die beter kunnen: jij krijgt er grip op.

Hoe jij het verschil maakt

Als Specialist Debiteurenbeheer zorg jij ervoor dat openstaande vorderingen zorgvuldig en effectief worden opgevolgd. Je pakt complexe dossiers op, doorgrondt waar problemen ontstaan en komt tot oplossingen die zowel financieel als klantgericht verantwoord zijn.

Naast je werk in de dagelijkse operatie kijk je kritisch naar onze processen, systemen en werkwijzen. Je herkent terugkerende knelpunten, vertaalt analyses naar concrete verbeteringen en helpt het team om slimmer en efficiënter te werken. Met jouw ervaring ben je een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor collega’s en een belangrijke sparringpartner voor de teamleider.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je behandelt complexe debiteurendossiers en zorgt voor een zorgvuldige opvolging van openstaande vorderingen;

  • Je analyseert betalingsachterstanden, afwijkingen en terugkerende oorzaken en zet de juiste vervolgacties uit;

  • Je maakt en bewaakt betalingsafspraken en schakelt waar nodig met incassopartners of andere betrokken partijen;

  • Je controleert financiële gegevens en zorgt ervoor dat dossiers volledig en correct zijn vastgelegd;

  • Je signaleert risico’s en knelpunten in processen, systemen en werkwijzen en doet concrete verbetervoorstellen;

  • Je neemt deel aan verbeterprojecten en kunt hierin een coördinerende of voortrekkersrol vervullen;

  • Je ondersteunt de teamleider bij het bewaken van de werkvoorraad, voortgang en kwaliteit;

  • Je deelt jouw kennis met collega’s en draagt bij aan een professionele, gestructureerde manier van werken;

  • Je werkt nauw samen met onder andere Finance, Customer Operations, Sales en externe partners.

Hier laad jij van op!

Bij NieuweStroom geloven we dat werk en welzijn hand in hand gaan. Daarom bieden we:

  • Een salaris tussen € 3.500,- en € 4.200,- bruto per maand op fulltime basis, afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • Volledige betaling van de pensioenpremie door NieuweStroom;

  • In totaal 34 verlof- en ADV-dagen op fulltime basis;

  • Korting op je energierekening als klant bij NieuweStroom;

  • Een persoonlijk vitaliteitsbudget van bruto € 1.100,- per jaar;

  • De ruimte om jouw expertise in te zetten en zichtbaar bij te dragen aan de verdere professionalisering van het debiteurenbeheer.

Wat breng je mee?

Je bent analytisch, zorgvuldig en gewend om zelfstandig beslissingen te nemen binnen jouw vakgebied. Je houdt overzicht in complexe dossiers, stelt de juiste prioriteiten en durft kritisch te zijn wanneer processen beter kunnen. Tegelijkertijd verlies je de klant en de commerciële belangen van NieuweStroom niet uit het oog.

Daarnaast heb je:

  • Hbo-werk- en -denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een financiële of bedrijfseconomische richting;

  • Meerdere jaren ervaring binnen debiteurenbeheer, creditmanagement of een vergelijkbare financiële omgeving;

  • Ervaring met het behandelen van complexe debiteurendossiers en betalingsvraagstukken;

  • Ervaring met het analyseren en verbeteren van financiële processen;

  • Een goede beheersing van Excel en bij voorkeur ervaring met financiële software;

  • Het vermogen om analyses en bevindingen te vertalen naar duidelijke acties en adviezen;

  • Een stevige en professionele communicatiestijl, zowel richting klanten als collega’s;

  • Beschikbaarheid van minimaal 32 uur per week.

description:
Overview

Hexagon’s Autonomous Solutions division is looking for a Product Cybersecurity Specialist to join our team in Calgary, Alberta. Reporting to the Functional Safety and Product Cybersecurity Manager, this role will support the development and implementation of product cybersecurity activities across the product lifecycle, ensuring compliance with internal processes and applicable cybersecurity standards while collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams.

Our technologies are shaping the production and people-related ecosystems to become increasingly connected and autonomous, ensuring a scalable, sustainable future.

  • Develop cybersecurity plans for product development activities.
  • Perform cybersecurity activities, such as threat modelling, incident and vulnerability monitoring, penetration testing
  • Review and approve work products from a product cybersecurity perspective.
  • Support and conduct product cybersecurity internal audits, assessments, and third-party audits.
  • Contribute to engineering process development and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Provide technical guidance to team members and stakeholders.
  • Facilitate technical discussions and collaboration across multidisciplinary teams.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to work cooperatively and productively with colleagues and cross-functional teams.

Nice To Have:

Key Success Factors:

title: Applicatiebeheerder
description:
Jij zorgt ervoor dat onze applicaties vandaag én morgen het verschil maken.

Hoe jij het verschil maakt!

Bij NieuweStroom zijn applicaties veel meer dan systemen. Ze ondersteunen onze collega's, klanten en processen en zijn onmisbaar voor onze dagelijkse dienstverlening. Als Applicatiebeheerder zorg jij ervoor dat deze applicaties niet alleen stabiel draaien, maar ook slim zijn ingericht, veilig blijven en klaar zijn voor de toekomst.

Je bent de schakel tussen gebruikers, techniek en leveranciers. Je kijkt verder dan de storing of wijziging van vandaag en denkt actief mee over hoe applicaties beter, slimmer en efficiënter kunnen worden ingericht. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van onze applicaties, voorkomt problemen voordat ze ontstaan en zorgt ervoor dat veranderingen gecontroleerd worden doorgevoerd.

Afhankelijk van jouw expertise richt je je meer op de technische of juist de functionele kant van applicatiebeheer. Werk je graag aan complexe integraties, API-koppelingen en datamodellen? Of krijg je juist energie van het optimaal inrichten van SaaS-platformen en het ondersteunen van gebruikers? In beide gevallen krijg je de ruimte om eigenaarschap te nemen over jouw applicaties en mee te bouwen aan een toekomstbestendig applicatielandschap.

Jouw rol in de praktijk

Als Applicatiebeheerder ben je verantwoordelijk voor de continuïteit én de doorontwikkeling van één of meerdere applicaties. Je werkt nauw samen met gebruikers, Product Owners, Operations, Security, Development en externe leveranciers om ervoor te zorgen dat onze applicaties optimaal blijven presteren.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Beheren, configureren en optimaliseren van één of meerdere applicaties;

  • Bewaken van koppelingen, integraties en datastromen tussen applicaties;

  • Oplossen van complexe tweede- en derdelijnsincidenten en uitvoeren van root cause analyses;

  • Analyseren van terugkerende incidenten en deze vertalen naar structurele verbeteringen;

  • Definiëren en verbeteren van monitoring, alerting en health checks zodat problemen vroegtijdig worden gesignaleerd;

  • Begeleiden, testen en valideren van changes en releases volgens het changeproces;

  • Beheren van autorisaties, rollen en Segregation of Duties (SoD);

  • Onderhouden van applicatie-informatie binnen de CMDB (Jira Assets, AdoIT);

  • Ondersteunen van gebruikers en key users bij nieuwe functionaliteiten en wijzigingen;

  • Bewaken van de lifecycle van applicaties en signaleren van technische schuld, risico's en verbetermogelijkheden;

  • Fungeren als inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor leveranciers en interne stakeholders.

Hier laad jij van op!

Bij NieuweStroom geloven we dat werk en welzijn hand in hand gaan. Daarom bieden we:

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris tussen € 4.000,- en € 5.200,- bruto per maand (bij fulltime), afhankelijk van je profiel;

  • Daarnaast betalen wij ook jouw deel van de pensioenpremie;

  • Ruimte om te genieten van andere dingen met in totaal 34 verlof- en ADV dagen op fulltime basis;

  • Korting op je energierekening als klant bij NieuweStroom;

  • Een persoonlijk vitaliteitsbudget van bruto € 1.100,- per jaar.

De energie die jij meebrengt!

Je bent nieuwsgierig en wilt begrijpen hoe applicaties werken en hoe processen slimmer kunnen worden ingericht. Je kijkt verder dan de vraag van vandaag en zoekt naar oplossingen die ook morgen nog waarde toevoegen.

Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen gebruikers, leveranciers en technische collega's, neemt eigenaarschap over jouw applicaties en weet complexe vraagstukken terug te brengen tot praktische oplossingen. Je houdt overzicht, durft beslissingen te nemen en bent continu op zoek naar manieren om onze dienstverlening te verbeteren.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding richting ICT of vergelijkbaar;

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met functioneel en/of technisch applicatiebeheer;

  • Ervaring met ITIL-processen, incident-, change- en problemmanagement;

  • Ervaring met SaaS-applicaties, integraties, API's of Microsoft Dynamics 365 is een pré;

  • Affiniteit met autorisatiebeheer, monitoring en lifecycle management;

  • Sterke analytische vaardigheden en een gestructureerde manier van werken;

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om techniek begrijpelijk te maken voor gebruikers;

  • Eigenaarschap, initiatief en de drive om applicaties én processen continu te verbeteren.

title: Compliance Coordinator
description:

About Healthy Kids

Healthy Kids Extended Day Programs is a rapidly growing childcare organization providing before- and after-school programs, summer programs, Early Learning Centers, and Universal Pre-Kindergarten programs to children and families across approximately 15 states.


Our core values are Growth with Quality, Results with Heart and Integrity, and Prosperity with Purpose. As a Certified Benefit Corporation, we believe we have a responsibility to the children, families, schools, and communities we serve.

Healthy Kids is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Compliance Coordinator to support documentation, licensing, and compliance activities across our growing, multi-state organization.


Reporting directly to the CEO and working closely with Operations, Registration, HR, and other departments, this role will help ensure that required documentation, licensing information, and compliance records are accurate, organized, and up to date.


A primary focus will be tracking children's required medical and health documentation, identifying missing or expiring records, and coordinating follow-up to help ensure requirements are met.


This is a hands-on administrative role for someone who enjoys organization, documentation, tracking, follow-up, and problem-solving. The position does not involve providing medical advice or making clinical determinations.

title: Operations & Marketing Project Coordinator
description:
About the Role

We're hiring an Ops & Marketing Project Manager to be the organization backbone of a small, fast-moving team. Plans get made in Slack, work gets briefed in Notion, and the gap between those two is where things quietly die. You're the person who closes that gap.

This role sits primarily on the operations side of our home fragrance brand. You'll own wholesale operations end to end, and you'll be the one keeping product development, inventory, and production moving: chasing suppliers, holding timelines, building the project boards, and making sure nothing sits waiting on an answer nobody asked for.

You'll also own the marketing calendar and the project flow behind it. Our marketing team moves fast across website, paid, email, and creator work, and it needs someone who makes sure that once something is decided it has an owner, a date, a dependency map, and someone chasing it. You're not deciding what we launch. You're the person who knows the status of everything, without being asked.

We're an AI-forward company, and this is an AI-forward role. Claude is part of how this team works every day, not a side experiment. We expect you to build your systems, SOPs, trackers, and reporting with AI in the loop, and to keep finding the places where it takes busywork off your plate and off the plates of the people around you. You don't need a technical background. You do need real curiosity and the willingness to make it part of how you work.

What You'll Do

  • Own wholesale day to day: processing orders, charging payments, creating shipments and inbounds, and the customer service that comes with it
  • Create 3PL orders for suppliers, samples, and anything else needed
  • Write the SOPs as you go, so the function can be handed to a dedicated coordinator over time. Designing your own replacement here is part of the job, not a threat to it

Product Development, Inventory, and Production

  • Supplier follow-up, cost comparisons, timelines, and project boards across new products and packaging
  • Stay closely on top of production status and timelines, and flag slippage early enough that we can do something about it
  • Support inventory operations and learn the fundamentals of production from the team, with room to take on more here over time

The Marketing Calendar

  • Own a single calendar across brands and channels: website, paid creative, email and SMS, creator and UGC, promotions, and product launches
  • Hold the dates. Work backwards from the launch date rather than forwards from today, so creative, approvals, and builds land in the right order
  • Turn strategy into briefed work. When a plan arrives as ten line items with five names attached, you break it into owned tasks with real dates and confirm who has what
  • Catch collisions before they cost a day: duplicate briefs, two designers on the same asset, work blocked on an approval nobody requested
  • Run the weekly cadence. What shipped, what slipped and why, and what's at risk next week, published without being asked for it

Systems, Notion, and AI

  • Own Notion as the system of record for these areas: structure, templates, status hygiene, and getting people to actually use it
  • Build real systems where only informal structure exists today, then keep them alive. A board nobody updates is worse than no board
  • Use AI to build and run those systems, from drafting SOPs and briefs to pulling together reporting and tracking what's outstanding
  • Keep creator and partnership records, contracts, and payments accurate and moving, in step with finance and the partnerships team

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • Exceptional organization. This is the single most important quality for this role
  • 3+ years managing multiple concurrent projects across teams
  • Operations experience in e-commerce, consumer brands, wholesale, or supply chain
  • Direct marketing experience, ideally owning or running a marketing calendar across channels
  • You already use AI seriously in your own work, and you can show us how. We care more about how you think with it than which tools you've touched
  • Hands-on Notion experience. You've built databases and views that other people relied on, not just filled in someone else's
  • Experience working inside a CRM and keeping it clean and current (Folk, HubSpot, Salesforce, Klaviyo, or similar)
  • Strong follow-through. You're persistent with suppliers, vendors, and teammates until you get an answer
  • The instinct to surface problems early, with a recommendation attached
  • Strong written communication. Most of this job happens in writing, across time zones
  • Strong English communication skills
  • Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills, and comfort across Word, PowerPoint, and Google's suite of tools

Nice to Have

  • Wholesale or B2B operations experience, including basic customer service
  • Familiarity with Shopify, Cin7, Klaviyo, or Figma
  • Experience with product development or packaging timelines

Benefits

    • 💰 Competitive salary in USD
    • 🕒 Flexible working schedule
    • 🌎 100% remote, long-term career opportunity

title: Social Journalist - UNILAD
description:
Founded in 2012, LADbible Group is redefining entertainment and news for a social generation. Our global community engages with our content–spanning editorial, video, documentary and live – we reach 1 billion people each and every month. Our mission is to give the youth generation a voice by building communities that laugh, think and act. Using all major platforms, we’ve rapidly risen to become one of the world's largest publishers.

About the Role

We are looking for a Social Journalist to join the UNILAD editorial team in Manchester.

This is a hybrid journalism and social publishing role for someone who lives and breathes US viral news and pop culture, can spot trends before anyone else and knows how to turn a strong story into content that performs across different platforms.

You will source, pitch, write, package and publish content across the UNILAD website and social channels. You will cover breaking news at speed, while also developing original angles, exclusive lines, interviews, explainers, features and repeatable social-first formats.

You will take ownership of the full publishing journey, from identifying the story and writing the article to creating effective headlines, captions, thumbnails and social treatments. You will also use audience data to improve performance and identify follow-up opportunities.

What the Opportunity Looks Like

  • Source, pitch, write and publish engaging stories for UNILAD’s website and social platforms.

  • Monitor breaking news, social platforms, fan communities, forums and Google Trends to identify emerging stories and viral moments.

  • Cover live and breaking news quickly, accurately and confidently.

  • Develop original journalism, including exclusive lines, interviews, explainers, features, first-person stories and distinctive follow-up angles.

  • Take ownership of stories from initial research through to writing, publishing, social packaging and optimisation.

  • Create compelling headlines, captions, thumbnails and visual treatments that drive engagement and referral traffic without compromising accuracy or trust.

  • Package and publish content across Facebook, Instagram, X and other relevant platforms.

  • Create social-first and platform-native content where an article is not the best format.

  • Contribute to daily publishing plans shaped by live news agenda, trending topics, original stories and performance data.

  • Support coverage of major cultural events and awards shows.

  • Develop repeatable formats including rankings, debates, explainers.

  • Use audience data and social insights to identify what is working and inform future coverage.

  • Optimise content for social referral, search, Google Discover and other relevant traffic sources.

  • Work closely with editors, journalists, social teams, channel managers and video teams to create content that can travel across multiple platforms.

  • Maintain UNILAD’s tone of voice and editorial standards, ensuring all content is accurate, legally sound and properly sourced.

  • Contribute proactively to team meetings, forward planning and coverage around major events.

Skills and Experience We’d Like You to Have

  • Experience working as a journalist, social journalist, audience journalist or content creator in a digital publisher, newsroom or fast-paced media environment.

  • Passionate about UK and US news, pop culture, and viral trends.

  • A sharp instinct for the stories, personalities, debates and cultural moments sports fans care about.

  • Proven ability to source and pitch strong ideas, including original angles and exclusive lines.

  • Excellent writing, research and fact-checking skills, with a high standard of written English.

  • The ability to write quickly and accurately across breaking news, trending stories, features and social formats.

  • A strong understanding of Facebook, Instagram and X, with awareness of TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, WhatsApp and emerging platforms.

  • Strong headline, caption and visual packaging skills.

  • An understanding of SEO, Google Trends and search audience behaviour, or the ability to develop these skills quickly.

  • Understanding of analytics tools such as Google Analytics, NewsWhip, Chartbeat, or Trends.

  • Sound editorial judgement, including an understanding of accuracy, verification, copyright and media law.

  • The ability to remain calm, organised and decisive during live and breaking news.

  • A proactive, creative and collaborative approach.

  • Flexibility to work across a seven-day rota, including evenings and weekends when required.

What Success Looks Like

  • UNILAD is faster, sharper and more distinctive on the stories its audience cares about.

  • More stories originate from proactive sourcing, original ideas and exclusive journalism.

  • Content is consistently packaged effectively for social, search and other platforms.

  • Social output drives stronger engagement and referral traffic.

  • UNILAD produces a strong balance of breaking news, trending content, original journalism and repeatable formats.

  • The brand builds greater authority and audience habits across sports beyond football.

Working at LADbible Group

LADbible Group operates a blended working model, with colleagues working between home and our Manchester office.

This role works across a seven-day editorial rota and includes some evening and weekend shifts to support live sport and breaking news coverage.

Equal Opportunities

LADbible Group is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce where everyone feels comfortable being themselves and where different voices and perspectives are represented at every level of the business.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Overview

Job Summary

The Senior Data Scientist I investigates and resolves complex healthcare data issues across client implementations, regulatory reporting, operational processes, and data integration workflows. This role analyzes healthcare data, SQL code, ETL processes, technical specifications, and business rules to identify root causes, validate processing results, and recommend solutions that support data accuracy, client deliverables, operational processes, and encounter submission capabilities. The Senior Data Scientist I collaborates with technical, operational, client service, and business teams, documents findings and recommendations, and communicates analytical results to technical and non-technical audiences.

Responsibilities

Work Performed and Job Requirements

  • Healthcare Data Analysis
    • Investigates and resolves complex healthcare data issues, discrepancies, and operational questions.
    • Performs root-cause analysis by reviewing source data, SQL code, ETL processes, business rules, and processing workflows.
    • Analyzes claims, encounter, enrollment, eligibility, provider, and financial data to identify trends and data issues that affect client deliverables and operational processes.
  • Data Quality and Technical Review
    • Writes and maintains complex SQL queries for data validation, analysis, troubleshooting, reconciliation, and reporting.
    • Reviews data transformations, ETL processes, technical specifications, and business rules to identify data quality and processing issues.
    • Validates processing results and recommends corrective actions to improve data accuracy and reporting.
  • Collaboration and Solution Development
    • Collaborates with developers, analysts, operations teams, client service teams, and business stakeholders to define problems, evaluate impacts, and implement solutions.
    • Translates analytical findings into recommendations that support data integration, reporting, operational processes, and encounter submission capabilities.
    • Serves as a subject matter resource for assigned clients, data domains, business rules, and processing methodologies.
  • Documentation and Communication
    • Documents findings, recommendations, data issues, business rules, and resolutions.
    • Communicates technical and analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
    • Prepares analysis and supporting documentation for internal stakeholders, clients, and project teams.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education/Training

Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in data science, biostatistics, epidemiology, computer science, mathematics, statistics, information systems, healthcare informatics, or a related field is required.

Experience

Minimum of 5 years of experience working with healthcare data, analytics, data investigation, data quality, reporting, or data integration processes is required. Minimum of 3 years of experience developing and analyzing SQL queries is required. Experience with healthcare claims, encounter, enrollment, eligibility, provider, financial, or regulatory-reporting data is preferred.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Advanced SQL query development and data analysis skills.
  • Ability to review and understand complex SQL code, ETL processes, data transformations, and business rule implementations.
  • Knowledge of healthcare claims, encounter, enrollment, eligibility, provider, financial, and regulatory-reporting data.
  • Ability to perform root-cause analysis and resolve complex data and processing issues.
  • Ability to interpret technical specifications, business requirements, data structures, and processing workflows.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong project management, organization, and time management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, investigations, and priorities concurrently.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering accurate, high-quality work.
  • Ability to learn new business domains, systems, and data structures quickly.
  • Self-motivated with a commitment to continuous learning and process improvement.
  • Ability to use technology and AI tools ethically and effectively to improve efficiency, quality, and processes while protecting confidential information and applying sound judgment.

EEO

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities

The contractor will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information. 41 CFR 60-1.35(c)

Additional Info

Salary:

The posted salary range for this role at HMA includes a range of factors that we consider when making compensation decisions. These factors include but are not limited to experience, education, training, skills, licensures, and certifications, along with other business and organizational needs. HMA may adjust the posted salary range estimate for applicable geographic differentials associated with the location where we may fill the position. At HMA, we generally do not hire an individual at or near the top of the range for their role. All compensation decisions are dependent on the variables of each case. A reasonable estimate of the existing salary range for this position is $120,000 to $145,000.

HMA offers a robust benefits package for full-time colleagues. Benefits include health, dental, vision, group life/AD&D, voluntary life/AD&D, short-term disability, long-term disability, paid parental leave, paid time off, paid holidays, 401(k) employer match and safe harbor contribution, and our long-term equity incentive plan.

title: Internship at Landfolk
description:
Internship · Aarhus · Starting 1 February 2027

Are you a curious student ready to turn what you have learned into practice and help create meaningful experiences?

At Landfolk we help people search for the exceptional and find the unforgettable. We are building Europe's most ambitious platform for handpicked holiday homes, creating exceptional experiences for both guests and hosts.

We are always interested in meeting talented students who want to grow with us. You can join us through an internship across multiple teams.

Start your career with us

An internship can be the beginning of an exciting and educational career. An internship at Landfolk is your opportunity to explore how a fast-growing company works from the inside.

Which team is the right fit for you?

Where do your strengths fit best?

No matter the team, we share a hands-on approach and a curiosity to improve how we work, build, and create experiences at Landfolk.

You can apply for an internship in one of our teams:

  • Brand & Marketing
    Join our Brand & Marketing team and help bring our story to life across channels. You will get hands-on experience working with campaigns and social media from developing creative concepts and personas to producing and optimizing content.

    You might help plan and execute campaigns, create and optimize ads for Meta, Pinterest, and TikTok, and design content in Figma. You will also write newsletters and articles for our Stories universe, support the coordination of events and shoots, and analyze performance to strengthen our impact.

  • Supply
    Join our Supply team and help grow the heart of our platform, our collection of handpicked homes. You will work across the full funnel, from identifying and qualifying new hosts to onboarding them, building unique listings, and supporting them as they go live on our platform.

    You will help generate leads, support outreach to potential hosts, and work with CRM tools to keep processes running smoothly. You may also help improve existing homes by analyzing performance and optimizing pricing and availability to ensure every home lives up to the Landfolk experience.

  • Guest & Host Care
    Join our Guest & Host Care team and help support guests, hosts, and service partners across our platform and services. We are ambitious in everything we do when it comes to delivering service to our users.

    You will work with phone, chat, and email support as part of everyday operations, ensuring high-quality service and smooth experiences for our users. At the same time, you will help collect user insights, identify patterns, and contribute to improving how we scale support while maintaining the personal, premium experience Landfolk is known for.

  • Finance
    Join our Finance team and gain hands‑on experience in the daily financial operations that keep the business running smoothly. You will work closely with our accounting staff and support essential routines across bookkeeping, payments, and financial administration.

    You will help manage invoices, reconcile accounts, prepare payments, and maintain accurate financial records across vendors and customers. Your work will contribute directly to the reliability of our financial processes and give you valuable insight into how everyday financial tasks create stability and efficiency across Landfolk.

  • Data
    Join our Data team and help turn data into insights and solutions that make a real difference across Landfolk. You will get hands-on experience with SQL, Python, and dbt while working across analytics engineering, data engineering, and analysis.

    You might help build reliable data models and pipelines, make trusted data easier for teams to use, and explore how machine learning and AI can solve real business and product challenges. This is a good fit if you have hands-on data experience, enjoy digging into data, building practical solutions, and turning an initial idea into something people can use every day.

Your role and background

As an intern at Landfolk, you will not just observe, you will contribute.

You will:

  • Take ownership of tasks and small projects

  • Collaborate with experienced colleagues across teams

  • Be curious, ask questions, challenge ideas, and share your perspectives

  • Gain hands-on experience in a fast-growing scale-up

You will be a fully integrated part of the team and join planning, meetings, and social gatherings.

We imagine that you are enrolled in a relevant higher education program and bring a curious mindset and loads of eagerness to learn.

Who is Landfolk?

Landfolk is a fast-growing, venture-backed marketplace for handpicked holiday homes across Europe.

We believe in getting closer to nature, culture, and each other, offering guests beautiful surroundings and hosts a delightful, flexible platform.

With more than 100 colleagues across Europe, we are building a company where quality, curiosity, and collaboration drive everything we do.

We are based in Aarhus, where we balance flexibility with time together at the office.

What is an internship at Landfolk?

Together with your mentor, you will shape a relevant and meaningful internship.

The practical information:

  • Internship period: Spring, starting 1 February 2027

  • Duration: Minimum 10 weeks (depending on your studies)

  • Location: Aarhus office

  • Benefits: Free lunch and a monthly allowance of 3,770 DKK

What to send us

We would love to hear who you are and what your ideal internship looks like.

When you apply, please include:

  • A short CV

  • A short text explaining which team you are interested in and why

  • Your perspective on what you are curious to learn and how you would like to contribute

  • What period are you looking to be an intern for?

We look forward to reading about you and your thoughts.

Please send us your application no later than 25 October 2026.
After the deadline we will review all applications and contact the candidates we would like to invite to the next step.

title: Platschef till RO-Gruppen
description:
Vill du ta ansvar för att driva byggprojekt framåt i en miljö där kvalitet, struktur och samarbete är avgörande? Som platschef hos RO-Gruppen i Göteborg får du en central roll i våra projekt och är med och skapar resultat från start till mål.

Om RO-Gruppen
RO-Gruppen är en etablerad byggkoncern med över 40 års erfarenhet. Vi är cirka 350 medarbetare och omsätter runt 2 miljarder kronor, med kontor i Stockholm, Göteborg, Linköping, Örebro, Helsingborg, Borås, Malmö, Vetlanda och Alingsås. Vi utvecklar och bygger kommersiella lokaler, samhällsfastigheter och bostäder – alltid med fokus på kvalitet, långsiktighet och starka relationer.

Hos oss kombineras spännande projekt med kontinuerlig utveckling, en stark företagskultur och kollegor som stöttar varandra på riktigt.

Rollen som platschef
Som platschef hos oss ansvarar du för hela projektets genomförande, från byggstart till överlämnande. Du leder projektet med ansvar för kvalitet, tid och ekonomi och säkerställer att rätt resurser finns på plats.

Du leder och utvecklar arbetsledare och teamet på arbetsplatsen, skapar struktur och fattar beslut som tar projektet framåt. I många av våra projekt arbetar du dessutom nära kund och verksamhet som pågår parallellt med byggnationen, vilket ställer krav på god kommunikation, flexibilitet och förmåga att hitta lösningar.

Din bakgrund
Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av att leda och driva byggproduktion, gärna i rollen som platschef. Du har god förståelse för projektekonomi, planering och produktion och är trygg i att leda arbetsledare och bygga välfungerande team.

Har du en akademisk utbildning inom bygg är det meriterande, men vi värdesätter framför allt din erfarenhet, ditt ledarskap och din förmåga att driva projekt framåt.

Som person är du strukturerad och lösningsorienterad med ett tryggt och tydligt ledarskap. Du trivs i en roll med många kontaktytor, är serviceinriktad och har alltid ett starkt fokus på kundens behov och upplevelse.

Därför ska du välja RO-Gruppen
Hos oss är kulturen och människorna avgörande. Vi arbetar utifrån vår värdegrund FENA – Förtroende, Engagemang, Nytänkande och Arbetsglädje, vilket genomsyrar både projekt och arbetsvardag.

Här får du:

  • arbeta med utmanande och varierande ombyggnadsprojekt

  • stort ansvar och möjlighet att påverka dina projekt

  • ett stabilt och växande bolag i ryggen

  • engagerade kollegor och en stark lagkänsla

  • goda möjligheter till utveckling

Vill du veta mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss? Lyssna gärna på vår podcast där våra medarbetare berättar om sin vardag på RO-Gruppen:

Podcast - mer än bara kollegor

Podcast - Här kan du växa

Ansökan

Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen önskar vi att du kan ange tre referenser (t.ex. beställare, tidigare arbetsgivare eller underentreprenör).

title: ICT Infrastructure Engineer REQ151
description:
We are seeking an experienced Windows ICT Infrastructure Engineer with strong hands-on experience in Windows infrastructure, Microsoft Active Directory, technical automation and the practical application of AI tools to infrastructure operations. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, managing and supporting Windows server infrastructure, while actively driving operational efficiency through automation and AI-assisted engineering. The engineer will identify repetitive operational activities that can be automated, develop and maintain automation scripts and runbooks, and apply AI tools to support troubleshooting, analysis and operational improvement. This role requires a hands-on engineer who can translate business and operational requirements into robust Windows infrastructure solutions while ensuring compliance with applicable technical standards, security requirements and IT policies. The position involves close collaboration with service providers, application teams and operations staff to deliver resilient and supportable Windows infrastructure for critical business applications.
Key Responsibilities:
Windows Infrastructure Engineering
  • Design, implement and manage Windows infrastructure to meet availability, continuity, security and capacity requirements.
  • Translate business and application requirements into appropriate Windows infrastructure solutions.
  • Provision, configure and maintain Windows virtual machines and supporting services.
  • Support infrastructure architecture reviews, implementation planning, testing and operational readiness.
  • Perform capacity planning, lifecycle management, maintenance, performance monitoring and troubleshooting.
  • Act as the primary Windows infrastructure technical point of contact for new application and infrastructure initiatives.
  • Work closely with application teams, infrastructure teams and service providers to resolve technical issues and support production operations.
AI & Technical Automation
  • Drive Windows infrastructure operations and day-to-day task efficiencies through technical automation, with a focus on reducing repetitive manual activities and improving operational consistency.
  • Design, develop, test and maintain PowerShell scripts and automation runbooks for Windows infrastructure administration and operations.
  • Automate operational activities such as server provisioning and configuration, Active Directory administration, configuration and hardening checks, health checks, log collection, troubleshooting, reporting and remediation.
  • Experience in deploying and working with AI tools applied to Windows infrastructure operations, including AI-assisted scripting and troubleshooting, log and event analysis, anomaly detection and operational automation.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate the development, testing and documentation of scripts and automation, while ensuring outputs are technically validated before production use.
  • Identify suitable operational use cases and progressively convert manual procedures into controlled, repeatable and supportable automation runbooks.
  • Develop automation with appropriate validation, logging, exception handling, security controls and rollback considerations.
  • Maintain automation scripts and configuration artefacts using appropriate version-control and change-management practices.
  • Continuously identify opportunities where AI and automation can improve infrastructure reliability, troubleshooting effectiveness and operational efficiency.
Microsoft Active Directory & Windows Platform
Strong hands-on knowledge and experience are required in:
  • Microsoft Active Directory administration and troubleshooting.
  • Active Directory backup and recovery.
  • Group Policy creation, implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Active Directory migration and upgrade planning.
  • Windows authentication and authorization mechanisms.
  • Active Directory Sites and Services design and configuration.
  • Enterprise Active Directory and Remote Desktop Services integration.
  • Windows Server roles and features including DNS, DHCP and Certificate Services.
  • Windows clustering and high-availability configurations.
  • PowerShell scripting and automation.
  • Windows security hardening and configuration management.
  • Troubleshooting complex Windows Server and Active Directory issues.
Security, Governance & Operational Readiness
  • Ensure Windows infrastructure solutions comply with applicable technical architecture standards, government ICT frameworks and relevant IT policies.
  • Ensure automation is appropriately tested, documented and implemented through established change-management processes.
  • Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures and automation runbooks.
  • Support operational readiness and knowledge transfer to operations teams and service providers.
  • Ensure Windows infrastructure configurations remain secure, controlled and supportable throughout their lifecycle.
Desired Skills and Experience
  • Strong hands-on experience in Windows Server and Microsoft Active Directory engineering.
  • Strong PowerShell scripting and technical automation capabilities.
  • Demonstrated experience automating Windows infrastructure administration and operational activities.
  • Practical experience using AI tools in infrastructure operations, including AI-assisted troubleshooting, scripting, analysis or anomaly detection.
  • Experience with AIOps, infrastructure automation or configuration automation platforms would be advantageous.
  • Ability to identify manual operational processes and translate them into reliable and maintainable automation.
  • Strong infrastructure troubleshooting and root-cause-analysis skills.
  • Experience supporting infrastructure with high availability, security and governance requirements.
  • Ability to work effectively with internal teams and external service providers.

title: Lead Creative Producer
description:
LADbible Group is one of the world’s most engaged digital entertainment businesses, reaching over a billion people globally and amassing more than 13.9 billion social views each month. With a powerhouse portfolio across general lifestyle, entertainment, sport, gaming, and tech, our brands: - including LADbible, UNILAD, GAMINGbible, and UNILAD Tech, are some of the most recognised and culturally relevant on the internet.

LADbible’s Commercial Team, LAD360, is a powerhouse of creativity, strategy, and innovation - partnering with the world’s most iconic brands, from Google and Nike to Disney and Tesco. With a headcount of 150 and growing, LAD360 has rapidly become one of the most formidable forces in media, delivering culture-shaping campaigns. Our work has earned us top industry accolades, including Commercial Team of the Year at the 2025 Campaign UK Awards and Media Brand of the Year at the 2024 MediaWeek Awards. At the heart of it all is a relentless drive to push boundaries, tell bold stories, and connect brands to youth culture like no one else can.

About the Role

LADbible Group has launched a brand-new, dedicated content team for one of the world’s biggest tech brands, creating bold, culturally relevant content across social platforms.

This is a hands-on creative leadership role. As Lead Creative Producer, you’ll take ideas from spark to screen, directing talent, and producing highly talkable, social-first content that brings one of the world’s most innovative companies to life through a series of vertical formats.

The role demands a master of platform-native storytelling, who is confident in getting the best from a broad range of talent, executing at pace and at scale to create engaging videos that drive conversations.

You’ll work closely with Creatives, translating concepts into standout content that makes AI-powered tech accessible and entertaining.

What the opportunity looks like

  • Lead and own the creative execution of branded content for a high-profile tech partner, ensuring ideas feel native to platforms and true to LADbible’s voice.

  • Build topline concepts into compelling videos that you lead through the entire production cycle, from outline, to pitch, development, pre-production, directing and edit producing. You will ensure creative excellence and client confidence throughout.

  • Apply and evolve LADbible’s most successful formats into branded content, making them work harder and travel further.

  • Become an expert in the client’s product, learning and championing the abilities of the AI-powered technology, to build these into entertaining stories that will drive consumers to use and purchase.

  • Lead, mentor, and inspire the wider creative video team, providing clear direction and elevating the quality of ideas and execution.

  • Act as the senior creative voice in client conversations, communicating the vision of the content and adapting it based on client feedback and social performance.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure ideas are both ambitious and deliverable within fast-paced production timelines.

  • Stay tapped into culture, platform trends, and audience behaviour to ensure all output feels current and competitive.

Skills and experience we'd like you to have

  • Significant experience in every stage of social video production, from development, direction and edit production, operating at a senior leadership level.

  • Proven track record of developing standout branded content that is socially native.

  • A clear understanding of how to balance a brand’s message in content that feels entertaining and editorial, rather than advertorial in tone.

  • Strong leadership skills, with experience guiding multidisciplinary teams and improving creative output.

  • Desired experience working with established content formats and evolving them for different brands or audiences.

  • Experience of getting the absolute best from directing a range of talent, from the world of TV, film, music and creators.

  • Confidence working with and influencing senior stakeholders, both internally and client-side.

  • Experience (or strong interest) in generative AI tools and how they can unlock new creative opportunities.

  • Ideally, a track record of making content featuring tech products and consumer AI tools, humanising them through entertainment.

  • Deep understanding of content performance and what drives engagement across key social platforms.

  • Strong organisational skills, managing multiple projects at different stages simultaneously

🔥 Why is this role exciting? 🔥

You’ll be shaping high-profile brand partnership work for one of the most innovative companies in the world, using LADbible’s most recognisable formats to create content that cuts through.

From always-on output to campaign moments, you’ll set the standard for how branded content shows up on social, combining entertainment, culture, and technology in a way that feels genuinely native.

At LADbible Group we've rolled out blended working which means the majority of departments across the business (including London, Manchester and International offices) work in the office 3 days per week.

LADbible Group is an equal opportunities employer. We are determined to create a diverse group at all levels of our company and we welcome all members of the community to apply for openings with us. As the leading social youth publisher, we have a powerful global platform to better represent our audience and enable those that do not have equal opportunities to have their voices heard. As a business, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce, in an environment where everyone feels comfortable to be themselves.

title: Designer, RTW - Joe's Jeans
description:
Specific Responsibilities Would Include:

We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented designer with an expert eye for garment construction and a strong organizational skillset. In this role, you will act as a vital bridge between initial design concepts and production. Your focus will be a hybrid of translating creative ideas into clear, executable technical flats and managing the essential administrative backend of the design process.

Key Responsibilities:

Seasonal Concept & Trend Development

  • Research and identify trend direction in women's contemporary ready-to-wear, including silhouettes, fabrications, colors, details, and market shifts.
  • Create elevated, fashion-forward concepts aligned with the brand's aesthetic and positioning within the premium contemporary market.
  • Build seasonal mood boards, color stories, fabric direction, and design concepts for internal and external presentations.
  • Collaborate with the Creative Director to define seasonal woven RTW narratives and key seasonal must-haves.

Design & Product Creation

  • Design and develop women's hard woven assortments, including jackets, tops, dresses, skirts, pants, and other woven categories, as well as cut & sew and sweaters/fully fashioned knits from initial concept through pre-production.
  • Create detailed technical sketches in Illustrator and initiate specification packages as the first step in the cross-functional workflow.
  • Partner with Technical Design on prototype reviews, fit sessions, construction details, and product refinements.
  • Oversee sample development and collaborate with mills, trim vendors, and factories to achieve the desired aesthetic, quality, and fit.
  • Ensure all designs balance creativity, quality, cost, and commercial viability while supporting margin goals and assortment architecture.
  • Maintain fabric, trim, and color libraries; partner with suppliers to source innovative materials and development opportunities.

Cross Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Production and vendors to achieve price, lead time, and quality goals.
  • Collaborate with Merchandising to ensure line sheets and assortments are accurate and aligned with seasonal line plans.
  • Maintain strong vendor relationships to drive product feasibility, sample execution, and ontime development.
  • Manage all design boards, digital archives, and PLM entries to ensure the accuracy and organization of the design pipeline.

Calendar & Process Management

  • Ensure timely execution of all design deliverables against the development calendar.
  • Manage workflow for woven product development, ensuring samples, tech packs, approvals, and revisions meet key milestones.
  • Prepare and present seasonal collections, concepts, and key categories for leadership, sales, and showroom meetings.

Our Best Fit Candidate Would Have:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Fashion Design or a related field.
  • 5+ years experience in women's ready-to-wear design, with experience in all categories.
  • Strong understanding of woven fabrics, garment construction, patternmaking principles, and fit across Knits. Wovens, Tailoring & Outerwear.
  • Bonus: Previous experience with sweater design and knitwear construction is a major plus.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, PLM systems, and Microsoft Office.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for product, attention to detail, and a strong eye for color, proportion, fabrication, and styling.

In return, we provide an industry-competitive salary, along with a comprehensive benefits plan (medical, dental, vision) that includes a matching 401(k), Summer Fridays, generous PTO, merchandise discounts, excellent career development opportunities, and a work environment that reflects our industry leadership. Our social impact program, Centric Cares, focuses on volunteerism to make a difference in communities we live and work in and our D&I committee is shaping the future of diversity, equity and inclusion at Centric Brands though workshops, resources and inspiring conversation.

Salary Range: $80,000-100,000

Be part of our growing community by getting involved with groups, teams and initiatives like Be Green, Be Giving, and Be Celebrated.

Centric Brands is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Please note that Centric Brands will only reach out to interview, make an offer of employment or conduct onboarding activities for candidates who have applied through our careers site. When interviewing for a position, the candidate experience will include live interaction, such as a video conference or telephone call, with a Recruiter and/or company employee(s). We will never ask for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process. Be aware of suspicious recruitment activity. If you think you are a victim of an employment scam, you may contact your local law enforcement agency and/or visit the Federal Trade Commission website here: https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams.

title: Working Student | Medical Annotator & Validator
description:
About kaiko

is building a next-generation agentic clinical AI assistant that helps clinicians reason across patient data, guidelines, and diagnostics.

Healthcare decisions are rarely made by a single person or from a single data source. kaiko’s assistant maintains longitudinal patient context across encounters, clinicians, and institutions, enabling collaboration, second opinions, and complex diagnostic workflows. The system is designed to operate safely in real clinical environments, with human oversight, auditability, and regulatory alignment at its core.

Our assistant core supports broadly applicable clinical tasks such as patient data navigation, guideline interaction, multimodal interaction (chat and voice), and care coordination. On top of this foundation, we are developing specialized diagnostic agents in areas such as oncology, radiology, and pathology.

We build in close collaboration with leading hospitals and research centers, including the Netherlands Cancer Institute (NKI). kaiko is a well-funded company with a growing international team, operating from Zurich and Amsterdam.

About the role

We are looking for a working student who is excited to contribute to building high-performance AI models in the medical field.

You'll be responsible for helping us build trustworthy, high-quality datasets that serve as the foundation for training and evaluating medical AI systems. Your work will directly impact the development and validation of large language models (LLMs) designed to understand and support clinical decision-making. You will work closely with medical professionals, AI engineers, and data engineers.

You will be based in the Netherlands with the expectation to work remotely after the onboarding stage. The hourly rate for this role is set to EUR 20 gross per hour.

Some areas of responsibility

  • You’ll perform manual medical summarization of clinical documents according to evolving specifications

  • You’ll review and evaluate AI generated summaries for accuracy, completeness, and clinical relevance

  • You’ll collaborate with the team to improve task definitions, edge case handling, and annotation consistency

  • You’ll support our anonymization efforts and validate performance of our AI models by annotating medical data

If you are a Dutch-speaking medical student with a strong attention to detail, are excited about working hands-on with real clinical texts to improve AI models and want to help build safe and reliable technology for the healthcare system, we think you will love this job.

About you

  • You are a master's student (or beyond) in medicine with an affinity for technology

  • You have experience working in a hospital (e.g. through internships)

  • You are detail-oriented and take pride in producing accurate, high-quality work

  • You’re comfortable working with evolving task guidelines and clinical ambiguity

  • You are proactive and able to work independently, even when instructions aren’t exhaustive

  • You are available for a minimum of 10 hour per week

Nice to have:

  • Experience with medical records or referral letters

  • Familiarity with annotation tools or structured data extraction

  • Interest in medical AI or clinical NLP

We are excited to gather a broad range of perspectives in our team, as we believe it will help us build better products to support a broader set of people. If you’re excited about us but don’t fit every single qualification, we still encourage you to apply: we’ve had incredible team members join us who didn’t check every box!

Why kaiko
At kaiko, we believe the best ideas come from collaboration, ownership and ambition. We’ve built a team of international experts where your work has direct impact. Here’s what we value:

  • Ownership: You’ll have the autonomy to set your own goals, make critical decisions, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Collaboration: You’ll have to approach disagreement with curiosity, build on common ground and create solutions together.

  • Ambition: You’ll be surrounded by people who set high standards for themselves and others, who see obstacles as opportunities, and who are relentless in their work to create better outcomes for patients.


In addition, we offer:

  • An attractive and competitive salary of EUR 20 gross per hour and a good pension plan

  • A 7-month contract with the intention to extend

  • A flexible-hour contract with enough work to keep you busy full-time if you like

  • Great team events to strengthen the team and celebrate successes together.

  • Autonomy to do your work the way that works best for you, whether you have a kid or prefer early mornings.

title: Android Developer
description:
Join us at Kivra! We are looking for people with passion for software development, love solving problems, and thrive in agile development environments. We have grown tremendously and are looking for an Android developer that, together with a team of motivated developers, will make the app more valuable for all Kivra users.

At Kivra, we are building services that connect over 6 million people by providing a safe and accessible digital infrastructure that everyone in Sweden can trust and use. At the same time, we are saving trees - reducing the paper that is printed and transported - by providing a better digital alternative to physical paper communication.

Are you our next Android Developer?

We are looking for a skilled Android developer with a strong sense of both usability and design to help build our native Android app. You will be part of a cross-functional product team of developers, designers, and a product owner, while working closely with our 6 Android developers to continuously improve the app. With around 2.1 million users engaging with our app daily, your work will have real and immediate impact.

About the role

You will work closely with all parts of our mobile application lifecycle. This includes designing, implementing, testing and deploying our Android application with focus on performance and scalability. Together with the team you will be focusing on improving existing services and features, as well as creating new ones.

You will be part of one of our product teams and report to the Engineering Manager. Fluency in English is required and fluency in Swedish is a plus but not required. We are unfortunately not able to sponsor new work permits, but are able to sponsor/renew existing work permits.

If you want to be part of an innovative team, this is it!

We think that you:

  • Are skilled in Android, Kotlin, Kotlin for Gradle, Multiple module projects, Dagger/Hilt and Espresso.

  • Are interested in building Android applications with Compose. Our app is in Compose and using primarily Compose navigation.

  • Are experienced in software development and agile methodology.

  • Enjoy working within all aspects of agile development focusing on writing, reading and talking about the code.

Moreover, we value previous experience in agile methodology and that you enjoy working within all aspects of agile development. To solve problems we strive to collaborate and we think that you have the same mindset. Just like us, you are passionate about your craft and take ownership over your own development. At Kivra, we believe in automation and staying ahead by embracing emerging technology, and AI is no exception. We're looking for people who take a proactive approach to AI, actively exploring how it can sharpen their work and help you and the team work smarter.

We offer

Kivra offers a place in a committed team with the opportunity for a high degree of innovation. You will be involved in influencing Kivra's exciting business and product development of a service that is currently used by more than half of Sweden's population. We offer the flexibility that life sometimes requires, but we believe that collaboration and value creation happens best when we sit and work together from our office in central Stockholm.

We offer competitive remuneration and great benefits. Read more about our core values and benefits here:!

How to apply

Easy peasy, just send in your CV and cover letter as soon as possible and the recruitment process will begin during week 33. If you have any questions regarding the role or the recruitment process don’t hesitate to contact Sarah Ohlsson, Talent Acquisition Lead at sarah.ohlsson@kivra.com.

title: Plant Maintenance Lead
description:
Job Summary
The Plant Maintenance Lead is a highly skilled individual contributor responsible for troubleshooting, tearing down, and rebuilding all equipment on-site. With a strong mechanical aptitude, this role involves using advanced tools, welding, and cutting to maintain and repair plant machinery. The technician plays a critical role in ensuring site reliability and operational efficiency.

Essential Functions
• Conduct pre-shift and post-shift equipment inspections, lubricate moving parts, and complete scheduled preventative maintenance tasks to prevent component failures.
• Troubleshoot and replace basic mechanical components, including conveyor belts, idlers, pulleys, and water pumps.
• Perform structural repairs, hard facing, and replace heavy wear-parts (such as crusher liners and shaker screens) using welding, cutting, and grinding equipment.
• Rebuild and fabricate parts.
• Order parts from approved vendors and drive Company pick-up/repair truck to pick up parts.
• Strictly adhere to MSHA (Mine Safety and Health Administration) and OSHA regulations, execute Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) protocols, and maintain a hazard-free work area.
• Observe aggregate crushing, washing, and screening areas during operation to identify anomalies by sight or sound and perform minor adjustments.
• Record and maintain service logs, lubrication reports, and maintenance records for plant equipment.
• Assist in the maintenance and repair of mobile equipment.
• Perform other duties as directed by supervisor.

Critical Competencies
• Communication - Ability to clearly and effectively convey information, ideas, and messages to others in both written and verbal formats; can express one's thoughts clearly but also demonstrate active listening, understands the needs of the audience, and adapts the message to ensure it is understood.
• Safety Awareness - Ability to recognize, understand, and adhere to safety protocols and procedures in the workplace; proactive in identifying potential hazards, taking steps to mitigate risks, and ensuring that both personal and collective safety are maintained in all tasks and environments.
• Work Ethic - Demonstrates commitment and dedication toward completing tasks with high standards of quality, responsibility, and diligence; demonstrates reliability, professionalism, and a strong sense of personal responsibility in fulfilling job duties.
• Attention to Detail- Ability to thoroughly and accurately complete tasks, ensuring that no aspects or elements are overlooked; meticulous and precise when handling information, performing tasks, or delivering work, and is critical in ensuring the quality, accuracy, and integrity of the results.
• Collaboration - Ability to work effectively with others to achieve common goals by fostering teamwork, open communication, and mutual respect. It involves actively listening, sharing ideas, problem-solving collectively, and leveraging diverse skills and perspectives. title: Department Lead Retail & eCom Outbound (m/f/d)
description:
Are you a team player who brings a solution-oriented, open-minded approach and takes responsibility seriously—reliable, proactive, and ready to make an impact? Then this role at Fenix Outdoor Logistics (FOL) might be just the right next step in your career!

We’re looking for a Department Lead Retail & eCom Outbound for a full-time, permanent position based onsite at our logistics center in Ludwigslust.

In this role, you will lead and develop a team of 20 to 50 employees at our modern logistics site in Ludwigslust. Your main responsibility is to ensure stable, safe and efficient outbound operations and the reliable, on-time processing of all shipments in line with our service level agreements.

Working closely with your team and internal Fenix stakeholders, you will monitor and continuously improve operational performance, using KPIs to identify opportunities and drive sustainable improvements. You will play an active role in optimizing processes and contributing to the further automation and digital development of our warehouse operations.

As part of the site management team, you will help shape the future of our logistics organization, ensuring efficient operations while fostering a strong, collaborative and performance-oriented team culture.

ABOUT US

Fenix Outdoor Logistics GmbH is the central logistics service provider for Fenix Outdoor International AG. From our modern logistics center in Ludwigslust, we supply all Globetrotter stores and e-commerce customers with goods on a daily basis, and we handle global B2B and B2C shipments for the group’s brands. As a dynamic team, we continuously drive the development and automation of our site forward.

YOUR JOB

  • You lead and coordinate the Outbound department with a team of around 20–50 employees, including staffing, capacity planning and recruitment.

  • You ensure stable, safe and efficient day-to-day operations and make sure all shipments are processed within the agreed SLAs.

  • You monitor relevant KPIs and performance indicators, identify improvement potential and actively drive the performance of your area.

  • You continuously optimize processes and contribute to the further development and automation of our warehouse operations.

  • As an active member of the management team, you help shape solutions that ensure efficient and sustainable warehouse operations.

  • You work closely with internal Fenix stakeholders, warehouse management and our brands, ensuring transparent and effective communication.

  • You regularly report on operational performance, KPIs and relevant developments.

  • You recruit, onboard, provide feedback to and develop your team members, fostering a strong and collaborative team environment.

  • You ensure compliance with safety regulations, process guidelines and other relevant standards.

YOUR PROFILE

  • You have a degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management or a comparable qualification, e.g. Bachelor Professional of Logistics / Meister Lagerlogistik.

  • You have 5+ years of experience in a leadership position, ideally within logistics.

  • You have solid experience in retail logistics and a good understanding of warehouse and outbound processes.

  • You have a strong track record in monitoring and improving operational performance, including KPIs and SLAs.

  • Experience in an international working environment is a plus.

  • You are fluent in German and have good business-level English skills.

  • You communicate clearly and effectively and enjoy working with different internal stakeholders.

  • You are responsible, reliable, proactive and a team player with a hands-on approach.

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

  • An exciting and challenging job in a forward-looking company culture

  • A varied and interesting role as member in a dynamic team and modern location

  • A family-friendly workplace

  • Company pension plan, bike leasing, Globetrotter discounts, and access to a mental health provider

  • An international working environment where openness is a must

  • A company that cares deeply about success—not only for the business, but also for society and our planet

We are looking forward to receiving your application!

#FenixOutdoor #Globetrotter

title: Senior FP&A Analyst
description:
LADbible Group is one of the world’s most engaged digital entertainment businesses, reaching over a billion people globally and amassing more than 13.9 billion social views each month. With a powerhouse portfolio across general lifestyle, entertainment, sport, gaming, and tech, our brands: - including LADbible, UNILAD, GAMINGbible, and UNILAD Tech, are some of the most recognised and culturally relevant on the internet.

We’re looking for a Senior FP&A Analyst to join the Commercial Finance team in a newly created permanent role. This role will work closely with senior stakeholders within the Finance team and across the wider business to help drive the financial performance of the Group.

This role offers a unique opportunity to take ownership of the forecast model for the Group. You will work with large and complex data sets translating operational information into meaningful insights that support business decision-making. The role will report to the Head of Commercial Finance but will have a high degree of exposure to both the Director of Commercial Finance and CFO.

About the Role

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning the rolling forecast model for the Group

  • Working closely with the divisional Finance Business Partners to ensure forecast assumptions are accurate and up-to-date, providing challenge as required

  • Producing weekly and monthly variance analysis against forecast with clear explanations on the key drivers of change

  • Building and stress-testing scenarios across revenue and cost plans to support decision- making

  • Tracking and interpreting key commercial KPIs by division / brand and translating trends into financial impacts

  • Collaborating with the HR team to quantify cost impacts across the employee lifecycle

  • Driving process improvement across planning, budgeting and forecasting cycles by utilising automation and AI

Skills and experience we'd like you to have

We’re looking for someone with strong financial modelling skills and the right mindset to thrive in a fast-paced, commercial environment. You are analytical, commercially-minded and have a strong attention to detail but can also zoom out and see the big picture. Above all, you genuinely enjoy working with numbers and are energised by turning them into a clear story.

• ACA, ACCA or CIMA qualified (or equivalent)

• Prior experience in an FP&A or Commercial Finance role and/or Advisory experience (e.g. Transaction Services / Management Consulting)

• Exceptional excel and financial modelling skills

• Experience with data visualisation tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker etc), SQL skills are a plus

• Confident communicator, able to clearly summarise information for senior stakeholders

• Proactive and forward thinking with a passion for driving improvement

• Adaptable and comfortable working in a dynamic, ever-changing environment

At LADbible Group we've rolled out blended working which means the majority of departments across the business (including London, Manchester and International offices) work in the office 4 days per week.

LADbible Group is an equal opportunities employer. We are determined to create a diverse group at all levels of our company and we welcome all members of the community to apply for openings with us. As the leading social youth publisher, we have a powerful global platform to better represent our audience and enable those that do not have equal opportunities to have their voices heard. As a business, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce, in an environment where everyone feels comfortable to be themselves.

title: Product Manager
