  • Drive product adoption and growth through customer-centric improvements, onboarding optimization, and initiatives that improve user experience, acquisition, and operational efficiency.
  • Monitor product performance and programme outcomes using relevant KPIs, reporting, and stakeholder feedback to identify improvement opportunities and support data-informed decisions.
  • Manage programme operations and governance, including risks, budgets, vendors, dependencies, documentation, and stakeholder communications across multiple initiatives.
  • Improve operational processes and workflows by standardizing documentation, streamlining manual activities, and implementing scalable solutions that improve productivity and consistency.
  • Support change management and user enablement through training programmes, process documentation, and stakeholder engagement to facilitate implementation and adoption.
  • Support other PMO priorities and assignments as reasonably required by the reporting officer, including emerging initiatives and cross-functional activities, in alignment with evolving programme priorities and organisational needs.
Requirements & Qualifications
A. Educational Qualification & Experience
Education
  • Degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline is preferred.
  • Relevant professional certifications, such as Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), are an advantage.
Experience
  • Experience in product management, product operations, programme management, or digital project delivery, with a track record of delivering measurable business and operational outcomes.
  • Experience managing the product lifecycle, including product discovery, requirements gathering, backlog prioritization, Agile delivery, UAT, production releases, and post-launch improvements.
  • Experience working with Engineering, Operations, and business teams to deliver customer-centric digital products and process improvements.
B. Technical & Professional Competencies
  • Strong programme coordination and execution skills, including risk management, budget tracking, vendor coordination, dependency management, and milestone tracking.
  • Ability to identify operational inefficiencies, redesign workflows, and implement process improvements that reduce manual effort and improve service delivery.
  • Experience tracking KPIs, analyzing performance and feedback, and using insights to guide prioritization and continuous improvement.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business needs and user feedback into product requirements, actionable initiatives, and practical solutions.
C. Soft Skills & Communication Attributes
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to facilitate workshops, align cross-functional teams, and manage senior stakeholders across business and technology functions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare documentation, facilitate discussions, and communicate complex requirements clearly.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment, manage competing priorities, and deliver outcomes within tight timelines.

title: Midweight Creative
description:
About LADbible Group

LADbible’s Commercial Team, LAD360, is a powerhouse of creativity, strategy, and innovation - partnering with the world’s most iconic brands, from Google and Nike to Disney and Tesco. With a headcount of 150 and growing, LAD360 has rapidly become one of the most formidable forces in media, delivering culture-shaping campaigns. Our work has earned us top industry accolades, including Media Company of the Year for Branded Content at the 2026 Campaign UK Awards, alongside Commercial Team of the Year at the 2025 Campaign UK Awards.

About the Role

Due to continued business wins and growth, we're bringing in more talent! We’re now looking for a Midweight Creative who can bring a new generation of thinking into the creative department.

Someone who knows what’s happening on the internet because they’re actually part of it. You know the creators before they’re on every brand deck, understand why a meme is funny before a brand kills it, and have a sharp instinct for what Gen Z will watch, share, skip or call bullshit on.

But cultural fluency is only half of it. You need to be a brilliant ideas person. Someone who can take all that knowledge and turn it into simple, surprising, social-first ideas for some of the world’s biggest brands. From a reactive post made in an afternoon to a talent format, cultural stunt or major campaign, we want someone who can find the idea that makes people care.

What the opportunity looks like

  • Come up with big, original, social-first ideas for some of the world’s biggest brands, from initial brief through to execution.

  • Bring a fresh Gen Z perspective to the work, spotting the creators, conversations, behaviours and cultural shifts that brands can credibly be part of.

  • Create across everything from reactive social and short-form video to talent-led entertainment, stunts, activations and bigger integrated campaigns.

  • Work independently and collaboratively, turning briefs and strategies into simple, compelling creative ideas and presenting them with confidence.

  • Collaborate with producers, designers, directors, creators and talent to bring your ideas to life, staying involved from pitch through to final edit.

  • Challenge briefs, push the work and proactively bring new ideas, references and opportunities into the creative team.

Skills and experience we’d like you to have

  • Experience as a Midweight Creative within a social-first, advertising, content or creative environment, with a portfolio full of strong, original ideas.

  • Deep Gen Z and internet culture fluency, with an instinctive understanding of social platforms, creators, entertainment, memes and emerging behaviours.

  • Strong conceptual and writing skills, with the ability to turn a rough thought into a simple, compelling creative proposition.

  • Practical creative craft skills, from writing scripts and treatments to building compelling pitch decks and presentations.

  • Confidence working independently, presenting your thinking and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams.

  • Comfortable working at pace across multiple briefs, with enough commercial awareness to understand budgets, scope and what’s realistically deliverable.

At LADbible Group we've rolled out hybrid working, 4 days in the office (Monday - Thursday).

As a business, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce, in an environment where everyone feels comfortable to be themselves.

title: Kokk
description:
Vil du være med på å skape unike matopplevelser i et av Norges mest ikoniske bygg? Vi søker flere engasjerte og faglig sterke kokker til Skipet, med oppstart tidlig i 2027.

Konseptet Skipet i Vikingskipet skal forene smakene fra regionen som ligger «midt i matfatet» med områdets rike historie og kulturarven fra OL. Her vil lokalmat, håndverk og gode gjesteopplevelser stå i sentrum.

Som kokk hos oss blir du en viktig del av kjøkkenteamet og bidrar til at gjestene våre får matopplevelser av høy kvalitet, enten det er i forbindelse med lunsjservering, selskaper, banketter eller større arrangementer. Du vil delta i all daglig produksjon, tilberedning og servering, og være med på å utvikle menyer og konsepter basert på sesongens råvarer.

Arbeidshverdagen vil variere i takt med arrangementer, sesong og aktivitet i Vikingskipet. I perioder må du være forberedt på skiftarbeid og høyt tempo, spesielt i forbindelse med større eventer, banketter og arrangementer. Alle aktiviteter planlegges godt i forkant, og erfaring fra lignende drift vil være en fordel.

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Har fagbrev som kokk, men relevant erfaring kan kompensere for dette.

  • Brenner for matfaget og setter pris på å servere mat du selv har laget.

  • Har en bakerspire i deg. Det er ekstra hyggelig om du liker å bake selv.

  • Trives med en variert hverdag og varierende tempo, for ingen dager eller perioder vil være like.

Hos oss får du muligheten til å arbeide med og i et spennende konsept på en helt unik arena. Arbeidsmiljøet er faglig utfordrende og spennende, for vi ønsker å fokusere på lokale og kortreiste råvarer der det er mulig. Sammen med kollegene dine blir du en viktig brikke i planleggingen og gjennomføringen av arrangementer og eventer i Vikingskipet.

Høres dette ut som din neste utfordring? Send inn søknaden din allerede i dag! Søknader behandles fortløpende, og oppstart er satt til begynnelsen av januar 2027 eller etter avtale.

Our mission is to give the youth generation a voice by building communities that laugh, think and act. Using all major platforms, we’ve rapidly risen to become one of the world's largest publishers.

About the Opportunity

Due to continued growth, we're looking to connect with talented audience-focused specialists at all levels — from Audience Engagement Editors to SEO, Discover and Growth experts looking for their next challenge.

Our Audience Team is the engine behind our scale. They make sure the content our Editorial and Social teams create finds the biggest possible audience - across search, Google Discover, social platforms and emerging channels.

The team spans SEO Specialists, Audience Engagement Editors and Growth Editors, working at the intersection of content and data. From optimising headlines for search and Discover, to identifying the trends and formats driving traffic, to shaping publishing strategy with insight - this is where editorial instinct meets analytics

You'll work with some of the largest audience datasets in publishing, with real influence over what gets made and how it reaches over a billion people a month.

What we typically look for:

• Experience in audience development, SEO, or growth roles within publishing, media or digital content

• Expert knowledge on Google Discover, search trends and how content performs across platforms

• Confidence with analytics tools (GA4, Search Console, social insights) and turning data into editorial recommendations

• A strong feel for headlines, framing and what makes a youth audience click

• Confident with algorithm changes and emerging platforms - and how to stay ahead of them

• Ability to collaborate closely with Editorial and Social teams in a fast-moving environment

The bar we set:

We're proud of the talent we've built at LADbible Group - and we're intentional about keeping that bar high. We hire people who are exceptional at their craft, hungry to grow, and raise the standard of everyone around them. Whatever the role, we look for the same core qualities:

• Ownership - you take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks

• Pace - you move quickly, make decisions and learn from what happens next

• Audience obsession - you instinctively think about what our community wants

• Collaboration - you make teams better, share openly and leave ego at the door

• Curiosity - you're always learning: new platforms, formats, trends and tools, specifically AI.

At LADbible Group we've rolled out blended working which means the majority of departments across the business (including London, Manchester and International offices) work in the office 4 days per week.

LADbible Group is an equal opportunities employer. We are determined to create a diverse group at all levels of our company and we welcome all members of the community to apply for openings with us. As the leading social youth publisher, we have a powerful global platform to better represent our audience and enable those that do not have equal opportunities to have their voices heard. As a business, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce, in an environment where everyone feels comfortable to be themselves.

title: Martech Builder (Freelance)
description:
About kaiko

Picture Laura, 58, with a cough that will not clear. It takes four specialists and a year to find her lung cancer, though the signs were in her file from the start, spread across scans, lab results and reports. No doctor had the whole picture, or the time to weigh it.

kaiko is named after a deep-sea vessel that went 10,911 metres down, to the bottom of the ocean, and came back with what was there. Our clinical AI does the same with a patient’s record and the medical evidence, so doctors have the whole picture when they decide. It is built on our own foundation models and used daily at leading European hospitals.

We are a well-funded team of more than a hundred people in Amsterdam and Zurich. Join us so the next patient like Laura is diagnosed months sooner, with a better chance of a long and healthy life.

About the role

As kaiko brings its clinical AI to clinicians, the decisions on where we invest depend on data we can trust. That data has to follow each user from a first visit to our website, through sign-up and first use, to the colleagues they bring in.

There is no marketing technology stack for this yet, so you design and build it from the ground up: tracking and consent, the connection between product and marketing data, event-triggered email next to our CRM, and the data layer the team reports from. Working closely with product, engineering, data and security, you keep clinical data out of every marketing tool by design. You document what you build and hand it over to the growth team in working order, ready for new European markets.

We’re looking for someone who has built a measurement and messaging stack from nothing for a product-led company, and who is as comfortable writing an event specification with engineers as setting up a CRM integration or modelling data in a warehouse.

This is a freelance engagement until mid-2027, starting as soon as possible.

Some areas of responsibility

  • Design and build our marketing measurement from the ground up: the tracking plan, consent and server-side tracking, attribution, and the definitions the team reports on.

  • Connect product and marketing data with product engineers: event specifications, one event pipeline, and one view of each user across website, product and CRM.

  • Set up event-triggered lifecycle email next to our CRM, with reliable deliverability and clear rules for which tool reaches whom.

  • Build the data layer and dashboards the growth team decides from, then document the stack and hand it over in working order.

About you

  • 4 to 8 years in marketing operations, growth engineering, analytics engineering, or martech consulting, including building a stack from scratch for a self-serve or product-led company.

  • You have set up an event-triggered messaging tool such as , Braze, or Iterable next to a CRM such as HubSpot, and connected both to a product.

  • You set up and model a data warehouse with SQL and a tool such as dbt.

  • Privacy by design: you build tracking under GDPR and ePrivacy and keep sensitive data out of marketing tools.

  • A hands-on builder who works as one team with product and engineering. You document your work so others can run it.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or another regulated sector.

  • Experience measuring referral loops, or setting up tracking across countries and languages.

  • Working knowledge of Dutch.

Why kaiko

At kaiko, we believe the best ideas come from collaboration, ownership and ambition. We’ve built a team of international experts where your work has a direct impact. Here’s what we value:

  • Ownership: You’ll have the autonomy to set your own goals, make critical decisions, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Collaboration: You’ll have to approach disagreement with curiosity, build on common ground, and create solutions together.

  • Ambition: You’ll be surrounded by people who set high standards for themselves and others, who see obstacles as opportunities, and who are relentless in their work to create better outcomes for patients.

Our interview process

Our interview process is designed to assess mutual fit across skills, motivation, and values. It typically includes the following steps:

  • Screening call: A short conversation to align on your motivation, professional goals, and initial fit for the role.

  • Technical interview: A deep dive into your problem-solving approach through a technical challenge, case study, or role-specific scenario.

  • Onsite meeting (optional): You’ll meet team members across functions to explore collaboration dynamics, team fit, and day-to-day context.

title: Business Director
description:
LADbible Group is one of the world’s most engaged digital entertainment businesses, reaching over a billion people globally and amassing more than 13.9 billion social views each month. With a powerhouse portfolio across general lifestyle, entertainment, sport, gaming, and tech, our brands: - including LADbible, UNILAD, GAMINGbible, and UNILAD Tech, are some of the most recognised and culturally relevant on the internet.

About the Role

This is a senior, dual-facing role at the heart of our award-winning Client Solutions team. You will drive revenue growth across our full range of solutions, including branded content, display, influencer marketing, immersive camera marketing and sponsorships, with a focus on retention and long-term partnership. The aim is to make LADbible Group a trusted tier 1 partner to our agencies and their business-critical clients.

The role has two equally weighted mandates:

  1. Agency partnership-Publicis: You will be one of our senior day-to-day partners across the Publicis Groupe agencies, primarily Zenith and Starcom. You will bring established, trusted relationships and use them to build a robust, qualified pipeline of briefs, pitches and always-on business for LADbible Group.

  2. Client-direct lead on flagship growth clients: You will also own the direct day-to-day relationship with a small number of our priority Publicis Groupe clients, acting as their senior partner and the linchpin between agency and client, and ensuring best-in-class planning, creativity and client management from end to end.

What the opportunity looks like

  • Craft market-leading, integrated proposals that answer the client or agency brief precisely. Most will be full funnel, so a strong understanding of both brand and direct response activity is critical.

  • Act as the connector between our internal teams, including Creative, Strategy, Category specialists and Display, to create and deliver pitches that win new and repeat business.

  • Pitch with confidence, both proactively and in response to briefs.

  • Hit and exceed personal revenue targets and KPIs for the accounts you lead.

  • Create and deliver sharp category, product and audience insights, whether in standalone client workshops or as part of ongoing proposals.

  • Immerse yourself in your key clients’ businesses so that your proactive ideas and proposals show a deep understanding of their challenges.

  • Craft standout case studies and award entries that delight your agencies and clients and raise LADbible Group’s profile across the industry.

  • Deliver robust post-campaign analysis to drive revenue retention and growth.

  • Use your client and category knowledge to recommend new commercial products and support their development.

  • Represent LADbible Group at relevant conferences and industry events.

Skills and experience we’d like you to have

  • Expertise in interpreting a brief and developing the right integrated response, with confidence in full-funnel planning.

  • The ability to build clear, compelling pitch presentations.

  • Tenacity and provocative, creative thinking.

  • Proven experience presenting and selling exciting solutions to clients at all levels of seniority.

  • A strong understanding of digital and social channels, including Facebook, Instagram, Snapchat, TikTok and X. Knowledge of sponsorship, influencer and immersive camera marketing is a plus.

  • Established, senior relationships across Publicis Groupe, ideally within Zenith and Starcom.

  • An aptitude for learning quickly in a fast-moving digital and social space with complex products.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset: if a client needs a format or capability we don’t yet offer, you are comfortable proposing new ideas to the business.

  • Resilience and drive, with the ability to perform under pressure and to tight deadlines.

  • A genuine passion for great work, strong client outcomes and LADbible Group’s future.

  • A proven track record of meeting and exceeding revenue targets in a commercial role at a media owner, publisher or agency.

  • A collaborative, energetic approach that adds value across the business.

At LADbible Group we've rolled out blended working which means the majority of departments across the business (including London, Manchester and International offices) work in the office 4 days per week.

LADbible Group is an equal opportunities employer. We are determined to create a diverse group at all levels of our company and we welcome all members of the community to apply for openings with us. As the leading social youth publisher, we have a powerful global platform to better represent our audience and enable those that do not have equal opportunities to have their voices heard. As a business, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce, in an environment where everyone feels comfortable to be themselves.

title: Resepsjonist - tilkallingsvikar
description:
Vår hotelldrift på pasienthotellene i Oslo skiller seg fra det tradisjonelle hotellmiljøet – her møter vi daglig gjester som ofte er pasienter eller ledsagere med tilknytning til sykehusene i området. Hos oss er det menneskemøtene som står i sentrum, og vi strekker oss langt for å gjøre hverdagen litt enklere og varmere for dem vi tar imot.

Teamet vårt er stolt av å levere tjenester av høy kvalitet. Vi legger vår stolthet i å møte hver enkelt gjest med varme, respekt og tålmodighet for deres situasjon – og i å skape gode dager for både gjester, samarbeidspartnere og kolleger.

Arbeidssted vil være ved våre hoteller tilknyttet Oslo Universitetssykehus. Stillingen(e) er ikke knyttet til ett spesifikt hotell, og man må kunne arbeide på tvers av lokasjoner ved behov.

Tilkallingsvikarer

Tilkallingsvikarer vil arbeide ved behov på dag, kveld og natt – både ukedager og helg. Dette passer godt for deg som ønsker en fleksibel stilling og kan stille opp på kort varsel. Oppstart i disse stillinger er så raskt som mulig.

For å lykkes i rollen tror vi at du

  • Er genuint opptatt av mennesker, og møter hver gjest med forståelse og ydmykhet

  • Har erfaring fra hotell, resepsjon eller annen type service

  • Yter service med hjerte og har øye for detaljer

  • Er selvstendig, strukturert og løsningsorientert

  • Er sosial, positiv og handlekraftig

  • Er komfortabel i hektiske situasjoner

  • Kommuniserer godt på både norsk og engelsk

  • Har god IT- og systemforståelse

Dine viktigste arbeidsoppgaver vil være

  • Bemanne resepsjonen innenfor avtalte åpningstider

  • Ta imot og veilede gjester, ansatte og leverandører

  • Betjene sentralbord og besøkssystem

  • Håndtere alarmer etter gjeldende rutiner

  • Mersalg i kiosk og bar

  • Sikre etterlevelse av interne HMS-rutiner

Vi tilbyr

  • En meningsfull og variert arbeidshverdag i et viktig samfunnsoppdrag

  • Et godt og profesjonelt arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte kolleger

  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter internt i Compass Group

  • Kursing og kompetanseheving gjennom Compass Academy

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser

  • Gunstige rabatter og fordelsprogram for ansatte

Er du opptatt av kvalitet i alle ledd og genuint interessert i å yte omsorgsfull og minnerik service? Da håper vi å høre fra deg! Søknader behandles fortløpende og oppstart er etter avtale.

Slik søker du – intervju med Hubert

Når du klikker «Søk nå», starter intervjuet med en gang med Hubert – vår digitale kollega som stiller deg noen spørsmål i chatformat. Det tar vanligvis 15–20 minutter. Du svarer skriftlig i ditt eget tempo, og kan ta pauser og fortsette når det passer deg. Du kan også avbryte prosessen når som helst.

Svarene dine blir oppsummert og gjennomgått av rekrutterende leder. Hubert erstatter ikke et intervju med rekrutterende leder, og det er alltid et menneske som tar beslutningen om hvem som blir invitert videre i prosessen. Tips: Finn et rolig sted, svar gjerne med egne eksempler fra jobb eller hverdagsliv, og ta det like seriøst som et vanlig intervju.

Spørsmål, eller trenger du tilrettelegging for denne delen av prosessen? Ta kontakt på rekruttering@compass-group.no

title: Skiftledere VITO Restaurant

Stedet er inspirert av det italienske kjøkkenet, med vår egen kreative vri på klassiske retter som pizza, bakverk og småretter. Vi vil tilby et variert, men presist utvalg av mat og drikke som fenger et bredt spekter av gjester, med hovedvekt på ferske og håndlagde produkter.

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Har erfaring og interesse for kaffe og baristafaget.

  • Har kunnskap om alkoholfrie drikkevarer og smakskombinasjoner.

  • Har sans for presentasjon, detaljer og estetikk.

  • Er strukturert, ansvarsbevisst og god på planlegging.

  • Trives med opplæring, veiledning og utvikling av medarbeidere.

  • Følger opp rutiner, kasseoppgjør og sjekklister på en systematisk måte.

Vi søker en engasjert og serviceorientert skiftleder for kveldstid som ønsker å skape minneverdige gjesteopplevelser gjennom godt vertskap, fagkunnskap og tydelig ledelse. Stillingen har hovedfokus på restaurant- og selskapsdrift, der du leder teamet på gulvet og sikrer høy kvalitet på service, atmosfære og drift.

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Har god kunnskap om vin, drinker og alkoholfrie drikkevarer.

  • Har sans for presentasjon, detaljer og vertskapsrollen.

  • Er strukturert, ansvarsbevisst og god på planlegging.

  • Trives med opplæring, veiledning og utvikling av medarbeidere.

  • Følger opp kasse, sjekklister og rutiner på en systematisk måte.

I søknadsskjemaet kan du velge om du er mest interessert i skiftlederstillingen på dagtid, kveldstid, eller begge deler.

title: SPORTbible - Talent Network
description:
Founded in 2012, LADbible Group is redefining entertainment and news for a social generation. Our global community engages with our content – spanning editorial, video, documentary and live – we reach 1 billion people each and every month. Our mission is to give the youth generation a voice by building communities that laugh, think and act. Using all major platforms, we've rapidly risen to become one of the world's largest publishers.

Editorial Opportunities at SPORTbible

Due to continued growth, SPORTbible is always looking to connect with top-tier editorial talent across all levels. Whether you're a Social Editor looking to expand your editorial credentials, a Journalist passionate about social-first storytelling, or a hybrid Social Journalist keen to own the full publishing journey – we want to hear from you!

About the Opportunity

SPORTbible is one of the world's biggest sports communities, built on passion, personality and the moments that matter most to fans. We're on an exciting growth trajectory, evolving beyond breaking news to build a sustainable, multi-sport, multi-platform destination for a young, global audience.

Our Editorial Team is the powerhouse behind the content that informs, entertains and sparks conversation across football, F1, boxing, MMA, tennis, golf and beyond. You'll be sourcing, writing, publishing and optimising engaging sport content that connects with our audience – whether that's through long-form journalism, breaking news, social-first formats or exclusive original angles.

The team thrives in a fast-paced, newsroom environment where no two days are the same. You'll work across a seven-day editorial rota supporting live sport and breaking news coverage. There's constant opportunity for pitching original ideas, developing repeatable formats, collaborating with social and video teams, and leading on major editorial moments. Your impact is measurable – from driving traffic and engagement through smart packaging, to building new audience habits across underserved sports.

What We're Looking For

Experience & Background

● Experience working as a Journalist, Social Editor, Social Journalist, Content Creator or in a fast-paced digital newsroom / media environment

● A university degree and/or equivalent to Journalism, Broadcast or Media (or proven equivalent experience)

● Bonus points if you're NCTJ or Media Law trained!

● Experience working across social media platforms and digital publishing

Sports & Audience Knowledge

● Excellent sports knowledge, particularly football, with strong interest across wider sport (F1, boxing, MMA, tennis, golf, darts, athletics, NBA, NFL and major global events)

● A sharp instinct for what sports fans care about – from breaking news and viral moments to fan debates, personalities and cultural moments

● Strong understanding of how your audience consumes content across different platforms and formats

Content & Storytelling

● Proven ability to source, pitch and develop strong story ideas, including original angles, exclusive lines, interviews and behind-the-scenes features

● Excellent writing skills and editorial judgement, with the ability to write quickly and accurately across breaking news, trending content and features

● Strong headline, caption and visual packaging skills – ability to optimise imagery and presentation to drive performance

● Experience in developing engaging formats such as rankings, debates, explainers, timelines and evergreen guides

Platforms & Data

● Strong understanding of Facebook, Instagram and X/Twitter, with awareness of TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, WhatsApp and emerging platforms

● Confidence using data, analytics and audience insights to inform decisions and improve performance

● Understanding of SEO, Google Trends and search audience behaviour (or willingness to develop these skills quickly)

● Experience using design software to optimise imagery and CTRs (desirable)

Mindset & Approach

● A proactive, creative and collaborative mindset with a brand-first, audience-first mentality

● The ability to remain calm, organised and decisive during live sport and breaking news

● Sound editorial judgement – creating content that is engaging, accurate, legally sound and adds value

● Flexibility to work across a seven-day rota, including evenings and weekends when required

● Curiosity and willingness to learn new platforms, tools, formats and emerging audience opportunities

Why Join SPORTbible?

● Be part of a team redefining the future of SPORTbible and sports content for a young, global audience

● Work on a brand with huge global reach and untapped potential

● Opportunity to shape new formats, coverage areas and audience strategies across multiple sports

● Fast-paced, creative environment with real ownership and impact

● Continuous opportunity for development and pitching original ideas

Working at LADbible Group

📍 Location: Manchester (Hybrid)

🕒 Pattern: Full-time, seven-day editorial rota including evenings, weekends and live sport coverage

🏢 Working Model: Blended working – colleagues work in the office 4 days per week (Monday-Thursday)

Our Commitment

LADbible Group is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce where everyone feels comfortable being themselves and where different voices and perspectives are represented at every level of the business. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to creating a team that reflects the audiences we serve. We welcome all members of the community to apply.

title: Journalist
description:
LADbible Group is the most engaged publisher on social media, globally. With over 520 million followers, 13.9 billion monthly social views, and a growing network of brands reaching every corner of youth culture, we’ve become the voice of a generation. Our mission is to inform, entertain and empower through content that drives thought, laughter, action and change. From LADbible’s proudly mainstream, feel-good stories to UNILAD’s bold, people-first journalism our brands shape the digital experiences of Millennials and Gen Z at scale.

About the Role

As a Journalist within LADbible Group, you will use your editorial talent to produce high-quality and thought-provoking articles – covering breaking news, features, interviews, reviews and more. You will help enhance the brand image by maintaining a strong online presence as well as developing and improving the quality of written articles.

What the opportunity looks like

  • Write accurate, engaging, and informative content in line with tone of brand.

  • Produce trending articles at speed while maintaining impeccable grammar, ensuring all deadlines and quotas are met.

  • Pitching original ideas and follow-up angles for the biggest stories across our brands.

  • Growing and utilising contacts for leads.

  • Researching and seeking the latest news, trends, and reports ahead of competitors.

  • Tracking article success with sessions and engage time, using this to pitch follow-ups and and improve your writing.

Skills and experience we'd like you to have

  • Have a journalistic background with 1+ years experience in a newsroom/similar role.

  • NCTJ Qualified

  • You are target driven and understand the necessity for tight turnaround times.

  • You have a proven ability to think, imagine and produce new and original ideas.

  • You are an experienced user of Microsoft Office.

  • A degree within a relevant field is desirable but not essential.

At LADbible Group we've rolled out blended working which means the majority of departments across the business (including London, Manchester and International offices) work in the office 4 days per week.

LADbible Group is an equal opportunities employer. We are determined to create a diverse group at all levels of our company and we welcome all members of the community to apply for openings with us. As the leading social youth publisher, we have a powerful global platform to better represent our audience and enable those that do not have equal opportunities to have their voices heard. As a business, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce, in an environment where everyone feels comfortable to be themselves.

title: Instructional Assistant - Pre-Kindergarten (Title 1)
description:
Overview

POSITION TITLE (Oracle title)

INSTRUCTIONAL ASSISTANT-PRE-K (General Education, Special Education, or Title I)

WORKING TITLE

Instructional Assistant-Pre-K Blended (Assignment could be divided and be in a Pre-K General Education classroom, Pre-K Special Education assignment, and/or Pre-K Title I school site assignment)

SCHOOL/DEPARTMENT

Office of Early Learning (OEL)

LOCATION

School Site

PAY GRADE

Noncertified Grade 20 or 21 (Dependent upon assignment(s))

FLSA STATUS

Nonexempt

ELIGIBILITY FOR EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT

No

WORK WEEK SCHEDULE

Monday-Friday (occasional evenings and weekends)

POSITION PURPOSE:

Performs instructional support work assisting classroom teachers in classroom activities as well as general administrative support tasks. Implements goals and objectives established by licensed teachers and works directly with students. Assists in the instruction of individual students or groups of students in all curricular areas as directed by teachers or administrators. Plans and collaborates with teachers in devising special strategies related to childcare licensure requirements, if applicable. Position can be utilized in more than one assignment (blended).

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES (KSAs)

  • Considerable knowledge of Microsoft Office, specifically Microsoft Word, Excel, and Power Point; Google Apps;

  • Working knowledge of successful instructional delivery methods;

  • Working knowledge of the core subjects at the grade level to which employment assignment is made;

  • Ability to recognize and support students of diverse backgrounds, learning abilities, and learning styles;

  • Ability to protect the confidentiality of personally identifiable information in accordance with the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act of 1974 (FERPA) and other applicable federal and state laws, policies, and regulations;

  • Ability to work in a team environment and effectively collaborate with others;

  • Ability to motivate students;

  • Ability to constantly supervise the safety and well-being of students;

  • Ability to work with a diverse student population and recognize variations in student backgrounds, abilities, and learning styles;

  • Ability to communicate clearly and concisely both in oral and written form using a variety of communication techniques and tools to ensure the appropriate flow of information, collaborative efforts, and feedback;

  • Ability to implement academic and behavioral interventions, as needed;

  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with school system staff, students, parents, businesses, community agencies, and the public.

EDUCATION, TRAINING, AND EXPERIENCE FOR NC PRE-K PROGRAMS (can include Blended and/or Title I)

  • High school diploma or GED and shall hold or be working towards, an Associate’s degree in birth-through- kindergarten, child development, early childhood education, or an early childhood education related field or a Child Development Associate (CDA) credential. Instructional assistants working toward the minimum of an associate degree shall make progress by completing a minimum of six documented semester hours per year; AND

  • For Title I schools, meet the employment requirements outlined by the Every Student Succeeds Act (ESSA), Public Law 114-95.

EDUCATION, TRAINING, AND EXPERIENCE FOR NON NC PRE-K PROGRAMS (can include Preschool Special Education/Self-Contained, Blended, and/or Title I)

  • High school diploma or equivalent; AND

  • For Title I schools, meet the employment requirements outlined by the Every Student Succeeds Act (ESSA), Public Law 114-95.

CERTIFICATION AND LICENSE REQUIREMENTS

  • Maintain a Crisis Prevention and Intervention (CPI) certification (specific program to be determined based off position; maintain that certification through the proper renewal process; adhering to all timelines; CPI training will be provided through WCPSS, if needed.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • CPR and First Aid certification.

  • For Pre-K Special Education and Blended programs, experience working with or assisting individuals with special needs (an individual with one or more difficulties such as, a physical, emotional, behavioral, or learning disability or impairment that causes an individual to require additional or specialized services or accommodations).

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

All Pre-K Programs:

  • Provides assistance with activities and duties that implement the total school program, assists teachers in instructional activities, and assists teachers in ensuring an encouraging, caring, safe and healthy environment for all students.

  • Aids teachers with planning and organizing, evaluating instructional activities, developing classroom licensure procedures, and preparing necessary materials; ensures materials for students are readily available according to the needs of the lesson plan.

  • Demonstrates professional and technical skills necessary to function effectively in the classroom and to support the school program.

  • Works with an individual student and/or specific groups of students in different pre-k licensed classrooms and/or area of the school, as needed.

  • Participates in the district staff development program and continued professional growth in the area of assignment.

  • Maintains a positive disposition, exercises good judgement, and remains calm when dealing with students at all times.

  • Compiles, maintains, and files reports, records, and other required documents, maintaining confidentiality.

  • Coordinates and assists students with special health care needs, which could include:

  • Personal hygiene, restroom functions, diapering, etc.;

  • Mobility assistance including lifting, positioning or transferring student(s);

  • Behavioral assistance and CPI skills.

  • Performs other related duties, as assigned.

Preschool Special Education/Blended Programs:

  • Provides support and assistance to teachers in coordinating instructional programs for special education students, including familiarity with student’s IEP; ensures an encouraging, caring, safe, and healthful environment for all students.

  • Assists teachers with strategies related to the implementation of students’ behavioral intervention plans.

  • Assists teachers with implementation of low- and high-tech assistive technology and augmentative communication devices in the classroom to meet both class-wide and individual student needs.

  • Performs other related duties, as assigned.

WORK ENVIRONMENT/PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This job operates in a classroom environment and requires sitting and standing throughout the day. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, scanners, and copiers. The position, at times, must be able to come into direct contact with school system staff, staff members of external funding agencies, and the community. Work is considered medium physical work, requiring the exertion of up to 50 pounds force occasionally, and/or up to 25 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects. School can contact the school’s Physical Therapist for assistance, if needed, with proper lifting techniques.

EFFECTIVE DATE: 6/2026

DISCLAIMER: The above statements are intended to describe the general purpose and responsibilities assigned to this position. They are not intended to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required by the employees assigned to this position. This description may be revised by HR and approved at any time.

title: Slot Floor Supervisor (Swing Shift) - Lincoln
description:
Summary

Slot Floor Supervisor

WarHorse Gaming Lincoln, LLC, a division of Ho-Chunk, Inc.Location: Lincoln, NEJob Type: Full-time | Swing Shift; Schedule varies based on business needs

Compensation & Benefits

  • Federal Employees Medical Coverage

  • 401K with Immediate Vesting & Company Match

  • Quarterly Incentive Program

  • Vacation, Holiday & Sick Days

About Ho-Chunk, Inc. & WarHorse Gaming

Ho-Chunk, Inc. is the award-winning economic development corporation of the Winnebago Tribe of Nebraska. Its mission is to drive long-term economic growth and create meaningful employment opportunities for Tribal members. Through a diverse portfolio of businesses, Ho-Chunk, Inc. supports community development while preserving culture and strengthening sovereignty.

WarHorse Gaming is a gaming and entertainment division of Ho-Chunk, Inc., developed in partnership with the Nebraska Horsemen’s Benevolent and Protective Association (HBPA). The company is responsible for managing the expansion of casino gaming at Nebraska’s historic horse racing venues, with properties in Lincoln, Omaha, and South Sioux City. WarHorse Gaming blends state-of-the-art casino operations with local economic development and community impact. Rooted in Tribal values and driven by guest experience, WarHorse aims to create premier destinations that elevate entertainment in the region.

Our work is guided by our core NATIVE values:

  • Native American Owned & Proud – Serving the Winnebago Tribe of Nebraska.

  • Accountable – To always do what’s right.

  • Team-Focused – For inclusive progress.

  • Innovative – In creating solutions.

  • Visionary – In our purpose and direction.

  • Excellence – Through learning and performance.

Position Summary

The Slot Floor Supervisor oversees daily Slot Operations activities during an assigned shift, ensuring compliance with internal controls, gaming regulations, and company policies. This role supports exceptional guest service, supervises slot floor operations, and assists with team leadership, scheduling, and operational oversight in a fast-paced casino environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily slot floor operations in accordance with company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements

  • Support and reinforce exceptional guest service standards across the Slot Operations team

  • Assist with developing and implementing customer service strategies for Slot Operations

  • Pay and/or verify jackpots over predetermined thresholds in accordance with Internal Controls

  • Create and manage daily and weekly staff schedules based on operational needs

  • Ensure compliance with federal currency transaction reporting requirements

  • Respond to guest concerns professionally, demonstrating empathy, active listening, and follow-through

  • Maintain accountability for assigned keys, radios, handheld devices, and other company-issued equipment

  • Attend all required training sessions and operational meetings

  • Follow the Company Compulsive and Problem Gambling Plan, including regulations prohibiting service to minors or intoxicated guests

  • Maintain scheduling flexibility to support business demands

  • Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications & Experience

Required:

  • Must be 21 years of age or older

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent experience

  • Minimum of three (3) years of experience in a guest service or customer service–driven environment

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite or related software

  • Ability to use mobile devices, tablets, and touchscreen technology

Preferred:

  • Experience in a high-volume, complex resort or casino environment

  • Technical knowledge of slot machines and slot systems

  • Experience training or mentoring team members

  • Familiarity with player tracking systems and complimentary guidelines

Security Clearance

Not applicable

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

  • Exposure to secondhand smoke and standard casino environmental conditions

  • Prolonged standing and walking throughout the casino floor

  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds

  • Regular use of handheld devices and communication equipment

  • Requires visual acuity, hearing, and manual dexterity to perform operational tasks

Schedule

Due to the nature of the hospitality and entertainment industry, team members must be able to work varying schedules, including nights, weekends, holidays, and extended hours based on business needs.

Drug-Free Workplace

WarHorse Gaming Lincoln, LLC is a drug-free workplace. All new hires must successfully complete a pre-employment drug screening. Employees may be subject to random drug screenings during employment.

Why Join This Team?

  • A mission-driven culture dedicated to economic advancement and community impact

  • Guided by strong NATIVE values and tribal-owned purpose

  • Career stability and opportunities across diverse industries

  • A collaborative work environment that encourages innovation and professional growth

Our Commitment to Diversity

Ho-Chunk, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. Preference may be extended to persons of Indian descent in accordance with applicable laws.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

title: Video Editor
description:
Founded in 2012, LADbible Group is redefining entertainment and news for a social generation. Our global community engages with our content–spanning editorial, video, documentary and live – we reach 1 billion people each and every month. Our mission is to give the youth generation a voice by building communities that laugh, think and act. Using all major platforms, we’ve rapidly risen to become one of the world's largest publishers.

About the Role

We are looking for a talented and creative Video Editor to join the LADbible Originals team!

You’ll play a key role in editing a variety of original series including Snack Wars, Agree to Disagree, The Eleven, Minutes With, Honesty Box, Do You Even Know Me? among others. You'll have a sharp editorial eye, a strong understanding of social-first video, and a passion for creating content that resonates with a youth audience.

You’ll work across the full production cycle, from editing engaging short-form and mid-form video to managing media, and ensuring all edits meet brand and platform standards.

What the opportunity looks like

Creative Responsibilities

  • Edit engaging social-first content for LADbible Originals across Factual, Entertainment and Sport, with a high level of creativity, speed, and attention to detail.

  • Collaborate closely with producers, editors, and production teams to deliver edits that reflect LADbible’s unique voice and editorial tone.

  • Deliver to multiple social platforms including YouTube, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok.

  • Undertake colour correction, sound mixing, and mastering across all edits.

  • Support occasional animation or motion graphics tasks in After Effects.

  • Stay up to date with social and video trends, applying learnings to your work.

Organisational Responsibilities

  • Manage media and archiving of your edits, maintaining clean project workflows and backups.

  • Take direction from Lead and Senior Editors, while confidently managing your own projects and deadlines.

  • Guide and support junior editors in best practices and technical standards.

  • Maintain high standards across every edit, ensuring content is on brand, on message, and on deadline.

Skills and experience we'd like you to have

  • 3+ years of professional video editing experience in a production company, publisher, agency, or branded content team.

  • Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro, with strong skills in After Effects and Photoshop.

  • Confident in colour grading and sound mixing to social and broadcast standards.

  • Experience editing both editorial content and branded partnerships is a plus.

  • A passion for youth culture, storytelling, and creating highly shareable social content.

  • Proven ability to work quickly and efficiently under pressure while maintaining high creative standards.

  • A natural problem solver with excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills.

  • Calm under pressure, with the flexibility to adapt to fast-changing priorities.

At LADbible Group we've rolled out blended working which means the majority of departments across the business (including London, Manchester and International offices) work in the office 4 days per week.

LADbible Group is an equal opportunities employer. We are determined to create a diverse group at all levels of our company and we welcome all members of the community to apply for openings with us. As the leading social youth publisher, we have a powerful global platform to better represent our audience and enable those that do not have equal opportunities to have their voices heard. As a business, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce, in an environment where everyone feels comfortable to be themselves.

title: Traveling Construction Engineer Student Intern & Co-Op
description:
Overview

At JP Cullen, an internship or co-op means getting off the sidelines and into the action. As a Traveling Construction Site Engineer Intern/Co-op, you'll become part of a project team and gain firsthand experience with what it takes to build complex projects in the field. You'll learn from experienced construction professionals, take on real project responsibilities, solve problems alongside the team, and see the impact of your work firsthand. And because this position travels, your experience isn't limited to one location. You'll have the opportunity to work on projects in different areas, meet new teams, and experience the variety that comes with a career in construction. We want you to finish your internship or co-op having accomplished something you're proud of, with a much stronger understanding of the industry and where you could see yourself growing within JP Cullen.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities for any intern and co-op position will depend on the actual assignment, but will include:

  • Field Assignments and Assistant Project Management Assignments: If your assignment is with a Project Manager or on a jobsite with a Superintendent, we will give you as much responsibility as you can show us you will handle. Work in this position varies depending on the specific needs of whomever you are working for but will expose you to almost all aspects of work in the field. Specific work assignments may include:
  • Shop Drawings – You may be assigned to expedite, review, and coordinate shop drawings and submittals for projects under construction.
  • Drawing Updates - You will incorporate revisions to contract documents as necessary to keep jobsite or office copies “up to date”. This will involve “posting” of construction change bulletins on blueprints and in specifications.
  • Change Orders – You may assist in organizing and estimating change order work for projects under construction. This will include contacting subcontractors to get their pricing, estimating quantities for Cullen’s work, comparing changed work to original takeoff, and helping the Project Manager put together a complete cost proposal.
  • RFIs (Requests for Information) – You may be asked to evaluate problems in the field, or discrepancies and problems with the drawings. You would determine the cause of the problem, document it, produce sketches for clarification, and submit RFI’s to the designer. Then you would follow through to make sure the issue is resolved, and the answer gets to the field to not delay construction.
  • Scheduling – Using Primavera’s P6 scheduling program (or similar), you may be assigned to update, print, and distribute schedules for project. This would involve direct conversation with the responsible superintendent and with subcontractors for data input.
  • Drawings - You will produce miscellaneous sketches and drawings as requested by the Project Manager or Superintendent. These may include formwork, embed locations, miscellaneous metal items, site layouts, etc. Drawings are usually done for the field and are intended to translate difficult drawing information into something the field can use to build. May be done with paper and pencil or with a CAD program.
  • Project Closeout - You will prepare project closeout documents, which will include updating “asbuilt” information on the contract drawings and organization of record documents and warranties. You will expedite warranty and O&M manual submissions from subcontractors.h) Coordination Meetings – The Superintendent may want you to prepare an agenda for and participate in weekly jobsite meetings where schedule is discussed in detail and subcontractors coordinate their work. You would produce minutes from those meetings and follow up that subcontractors meet their commitments
  • Monitoring Subcontractors - You may work with subcontractors to monitor their work, ensure they will make their schedules, monitor their manpower, and monitor/inspect the quality of their work and compliance with specifications and drawings.
  • Deliveries – You may be procuring materials for the project. With direction from the Project Manager or Superintendent, you would set up a log, prepare a delivery schedule, find problems, visit suppliers, track shipments, check materials, and make sure they are labeled and stored properly.
  • Backcharge Tickets and Extra Work Tickets – You may prepare summaries of labor and material costs for backcharge or extra work, provide appropriate explanations and get agreements and signatures from subcontractors and owners.

Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architectural Engineering, or related field
  • Strong communication and teamwork abilities
  • Attention to detail
  • Willingness to learn

Why JP Cullen?

JP Cullen is a fifth-generation, family-owned, full-service construction management firm that specializes in budgeting, planning and constructing the tough jobs. Our clients recognize JP Cullen as experts at working within active construction sites where safety is of the utmost importance, discovering solutions for something that was said could not be done, and delivering projects on time, on budget, the right way, the first time. By tackling the toughest projects JP Cullen has created an expertise that is unrivaled.While many things have changed over the course of 130+ years, the JP Cullen values, which guide our decision making and create a sense of community, have not. We believe that our team and values are the greatest assets to our company culture. Our company is powered by individuals whose personal values drive to make a difference. The company has offices in Janesville, Milwaukee and Madison areas.

Compensation & Benefits

This is a paid internship. Interns will receive hourly compensation, PPE, and professional development opportunities.

EEO

JP Cullen is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action (EEO/AA) Employer. We promote diversity by proactively recruiting, hiring, and promoting women, minorities, disabled individuals, and veterans. JP Cullen provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to workin the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

title: Maintenance Data Analyst
description:
Overview/ Job Responsibilities

Join Entarian as a Maintenance Data Analyst!

Entarian is seeking a highly skilled Maintenance Data Analyst to support our meshONE-T program by analyzing maintenance data, identifying trends, and providing actionable insights. This position plays a critical role in optimizing maintenance processes, improving system reliability, and supporting decision-making through data-driven analysis. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the design, implementation, and operation of the broader meshONE capability, supporting the United States Air Force, United States Space Force, and their mission partners.

If you thrive in dynamic settings and excel at balancing competing priorities, we invite you to be part of our innovative team.

Job Overview

As a Maintenance Data Analyst, you will:

  • Collect, clean, and analyze maintenance data to identify patterns and trends.
  • Develop reports, dashboards, and visualizations to present findings to stakeholders.
  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to maintenance effectiveness and efficiency.
  • Collaborate with maintenance and operations teams to improve asset management and preventive maintenance strategies.
  • Conduct root cause analysis of maintenance issues and recommend corrective actions.
  • Support the development and implementation of predictive maintenance strategies.
  • Ensure data integrity and accuracy in maintenance management systems.
  • Assist in optimizing maintenance workflows and resource allocation based on data analysis.

Job Responsibilities

Data Collection & Analysis

  • Gather, clean, and preprocess maintenance-related data from various sources.
  • Identify trends, anomalies, and insights within maintenance data to improve performance.

Reporting & Visualization

  • Create interactive dashboards and reports to communicate maintenance performance and trends.
  • Present findings to leadership and stakeholders to support decision-making.

Collaboration & Process Improvement

  • Work closely with maintenance teams to refine maintenance strategies and operational processes.
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and efficiency improvements.

Predictive & Preventive Maintenance Support

  • Develop models for predictive maintenance to anticipate equipment failures.
  • Assist in implementing preventive maintenance measures to reduce downtime and increase asset lifespan.

Compliance & Data Integrity

  • Ensure data accuracy and compliance with industry regulations and organizational policies.
  • Maintain and enhance data governance practices within maintenance management systems.

Compliance and Safety

  • Ensure all maintenance activities adhere to safety protocols and regulatory requirements.

Continuous Improvement

  • Gather feedback from stakeholders to enhance collaboration and effectiveness.
  • Track and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) related to maintenance activities.

Position Details

  • Job Type: Full-Time, Monday through Friday. May require work outside regular business hours to address urgent priorities.
  • Work Environment: In-office position directly supporting improvement and maintenance activities.
  • Location: Colorado Springs, Colorado, Denver, Colorado, or El Segundo, California
  • Travel: Some travel between locations in Colorado and California.

  • Security Clearance: Top Secret/SCI Eligible.

  • Salary Range: $110 – 120k

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in maintenance data analysis, operational data analysis, reliability, logistics, or a related field.
  • Proficiency in data analysis tools such as Python, R, SQL, Excel, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with maintenance management systems (CMMS, EAM, REMIS, or similar).
  • Experience developing reports, dashboards, and data visualizations using tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • Ability to translate data findings into actionable recommendations for operational and maintenance improvements.
  • Familiarity with predictive maintenance methodologies, reliability engineering principles, and asset lifecycle management.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and customer-facing skills.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience working in a maintenance, logistics, or operations environment.
  • Knowledge of machine learning techniques for predictive maintenance.
  • Understanding of reliability engineering principles.
  • Experience with business intelligence (BI) tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • Extensive knowledge of Department of Defense service activities and operations.
  • Experience with working in new and with emerging technologies

About Us

CompensationEntarian considers several factors when extending an offer of employment, including the location, scope, and associated responsibilities of the specific position, as well as a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills.

BenefitsAll full-time employees are eligible to participate in our flexible benefits package, which includes:

  • Medical, Rx, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company-matching
  • 11 Paid Federal Government Holidays
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts

Formed through the strategic union of Sev1Tech and ERT, Entarian is a premier provider of mission-critical engineering and technology solutions. Founded on a legacy of excellence dating back to 1993, Entarian is a product of an evolved and fully diversified engineering and federal technology leader. From deep space to defense and civilian missions, Entarian delivers secure, mission-aligned digital solutions that drive national resilience and operational effectiveness. Skills and experience we'd like you to have

  • Proven experience in data analytics or digital/media analytics, ideally within YouTube, social media, or digital publishing environments.

  • Experience analysing YouTube performance metrics, including watch time, audience retention, CTR, subscriber growth, RPM/CPM, and viewer behaviour.

title: Media Center Coordinator
description:
Overview

POSITION PURPOSE:

Plans and provides for appropriate classroom learning experiences for students. Provides an atmosphere and environment conducive to the intellectual, physical, social and emotional development of individuals to ensure success for every student. Responsible for supervising students in a variety of school related settings; monitoring and evaluating student outcomes; and communicating/interacting with students, parents, staff and the community. Additionally, is responsible for maintaining appropriate records and following required procedures and practices as well as monitoring the appropriate use and care of equipment, materials and facilities.

EDUCATION, TRAINING, AND EXPERIENCE

title: Projektledare Samhällskommunikation
description:
Cancerfonden arbetar för nästa framsteg i kampen mot cancer. Våra framgångar bygger på vår förmåga att sprida kunskap, påverka samhällsutvecklingen och få fler att bidra till svensk cancerforskning. Nu söker vi en projektledare för ett vikariat som vill stärka Cancerfondens röst i media och samhällsdebatten.

Om rollen

Som Projektledare Samhällskommunikation på Cancerfonden jobbar du nära dina kolleger i enheten Samhällskommunikation. Tillsammans utvecklar ni under din ledning kommunikationsstrategier för hur Cancerfonden bör ta sig an olika frågor, utmaningar och möjligheter i olika budskap och koncept. Jobbet innebär att du löpande bidrar till att utveckla och skapa opinion för Cancerfondens prioriterade påverkansfrågor. Du ska också bidra till att Cancerfonden finns där människor finns samt att vi är och upplevs som ett Cancerfonden för alla.

Du är en person som bevakar din omvärld och löpande fördjupar organisationens kunskap om viktiga målgrupper, aktörer och trender.

I korthet handlar jobbet om att:

  • Projektleda kommunikationsaktiviteter.

  • Skapa synlighet för Cancerfonden och våra frågor.

  • Bidra till en livaktig internkommunikation genom att löpande dela uppdateringar och kunskap.

  • Vid behov beställa externt stöd och underhålla sådana relationer (till exempel i samband med fakturering, avtal mm).

  • Vid behov stötta i framtagandet av pressmeddelanden, budskapsunderlag mm.

  • Vid behov pressjour med övriga kolleger på enheten för Samhällskommunikation.


Din bakgrund

Vi söker dig som har:

  • Relevant universitetsexamen inom journalistik, PR eller liknande

  • Minst två års erfarenhet av att jobba både operativ och strategisk med liknande arbetsuppgifter.

Arbetsrelaterade färdigheter

  • Är en god och anpassningsbar skribent som kan få olika kanaler att samverka.

  • Förmåga att föra fram och tydliggöra det kommunikativa perspektivet i olika projekt.

  • Kreativ och kommunikativ bredd

  • Det är mediterande att du är en god projektledare - strukturerad, noggrann och målmedveten.

Personliga färdigheter

  • Trivs med att jobba i team, samarbetar väl samt har förmåga att bygga och underhålla relationer, både internt och externt.

  • Uppskattar ett processinriktat och metodiskt arbetssätt.

  • Tycker om kommunikativa utmaningar

  • Driven

  • Noggrann

  • Uthållig, grundlig och målmedveten

  • Självständig och initiativrik

Vem är du

Du är en driven och nyfiken kommunikatör med ett stort intresse för samhällsfrågor, medier och opinionsbildning. Du har förmågan att snabbt sätta dig in i komplexa frågor, identifiera kommunikativa möjligheter i omvärlden och omsätta idéer till konkreta insatser som gör skillnad. Du är både strategisk och operativ och har lätt för att skapa relationer och samarbeta med andra. Framför allt har du ett starkt engagemang för att använda kommunikation som verktyg för att påverka och skapa förändring.

Att arbeta på Cancerfonden
På Cancerfonden är medarbetarna engagerade, nytänkande och tar tillsammans ansvar för att snabbare nå visionen att besegra cancer. Cancerfonden erbjuder träningsmöjligheter på arbetstid, möjligheten till promenadmöten, förmånliga friskvårdserbjudanden och kunskapshöjande aktiviteter. Cancerfonden värderar en balans mellan arbete och fritid och tillämpar målstyrd arbetstid. Cancerfonden är en rökfri arbetsplats.

Tjänsten är ett föräldravikariat (100 %) på ett år med möjlighet till tillsvidareanställning med placering på Cancerfondens huvudkontor i Stockholm. Tillträde snarast. Urvalsprocessen sker löpande och du är varmt välkommen med din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Vi strävar efter en arbetsplats som präglas av mångfald, jämställdhet och inkludering. Vi välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter och ser gärna en jämnare könsfördelning i vår verksamhet

Vid frågor kontakt Louise Wileen Bjarke, enhetschef louise.wileenbjarke@cancerfonden.se

Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Regulatory Compliance Specialist
description:
Location: 2 Summit Court, Fishkill, NY 12524 — In Person
Employment Type: Part-Time
Compensation: $21–$24 per hour, based on experience and qualifications
Reports To: CEO


About Healthy Kids

Healthy Kids Extended Day Programs is a rapidly growing childcare organization providing before- and after-school programs, summer programs, Early Learning Centers, and Universal Pre-Kindergarten programs to children and families across approximately 15 states.


Our core values are Growth with Quality, Results with Heart and Integrity, and Prosperity with Purpose. As a Certified Benefit Corporation, we believe we have a responsibility to the children, families, schools, and communities we serve.


We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Regulatory Compliance Specialist to support compliance activities across our multi-state organization.


Position Overview

The Regulatory Compliance Specialist will provide administrative and compliance support across Healthy Kids' programs in approximately 15 states.


Working directly with the CEO and in coordination with Operations, Registration, HR, and other departments, this position will help ensure that required documentation, licensing information, and compliance records are accurate, organized, and up to date.


A primary focus of the role will be tracking children's required medical and health documentation, identifying missing or expiring records, and coordinating follow-up to help ensure requirements are met.


This is a hands-on position for someone who enjoys organization, documentation, tracking, follow-up, and problem-solving.


Key Responsibilities

Children's Medical & Health Documentation

  • Track required medical and health documentation for children across multiple states.
  • Review records for missing, incomplete, or expired documentation.
  • Maintain accurate spreadsheets, databases, and tracking systems.
  • Monitor expiration dates and send reminders regarding required updates.
  • Follow up with appropriate teams regarding outstanding documentation.
  • Help ensure documentation is collected and maintained according to applicable requirements.
  • Identify issues and bring them to the attention of the CEO or appropriate department.

Multi-State Compliance Support

  • Maintain organized information regarding childcare requirements across approximately 15 states.
  • Assist with tracking state-specific licensing and documentation requirements.
  • Monitor regulatory deadlines, renewals, and expiration dates.
  • Assist with keeping internal compliance information current when requirements change.
  • Help organize information and documentation for licensing reviews, inspections, and audits.
  • Track outstanding compliance items and follow up through completion.

Administrative & Reporting Support

  • Prepare routine compliance reports, spreadsheets, checklists, and tracking documents.
  • Maintain accurate compliance databases.
  • Provide the CEO with updates regarding outstanding documentation and compliance items.
  • Communicate with internal teams to obtain missing information and resolve documentation issues.
  • Assist with compliance audits and administrative projects.
  • Maintain confidentiality when handling children's, family, and employee information.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

title: Deputy Editor - UNILAD
description:
Founded in 2012, LADbible Group is redefining entertainment and news for a social generation. Our global community engages with our content–spanning editorial, video, documentary and live – we reach 1 billion people each and every month. Our mission is to give the youth generation a voice by building communities that laugh, think and act. Using all major platforms, we’ve rapidly risen to become one of the world's largest publishers.

The Deputy Brand Editor will work closely with the Brand Editor across both editorial and social to help shape and deliver LADbible’s daily content agenda.

Sitting at the heart of the LADbible newsroom, they will manage the day-to-day publishing of content and set content priorities across breaking news, original journalism, search and culturally relevant stories alongside the brand editor.

The Deputy Brand Editor will take a hands-on role in commissioning, editing and publishing content, ensuring it meets LADbible’s standards for accuracy, quality, tone and legal compliance. They will use performance data, audience insights and platform trends to inform editorial decisions.

They will also deputise for the Brand Editor when required.

Key responsibilities

  • Work closely with the Brand Editor across editorial and social to agree daily priorities, coordinate coverage and ensure a consistent brand voice across platforms.

  • Deputise for the Brand Editor when required, providing editorial leadership and making confident publishing decisions.

  • Commission, edit and publish news content, including breaking news, trending stories, original journalism and search-led articles.

  • Work closely with the audience team to identify opportunities to inform commissioning and forward planning.

  • Head up planning and tracking of original journalism and exclusive stories

  • Maintain high standards of editorial judgement, storytelling, accuracy, sourcing and media-law compliance.

  • Identify potential legal, regulatory and reputational risks before publication, escalating sensitive or complex matters to the Head of Editorial when appropriate.

  • Use audience insights, search trends and platform behaviour to inform daily publishing decisions and longer-term content planning.

  • Monitor performance through tools including Aperture, Chartbeat, Google Analytics and Mission Control, using findings to optimise coverage.

  • Work with the Brand Editor to deliver monthly targets for overall sessions, search traffic and revenue, as set by the Head of Editorial.

  • Agree individual reporter KPIs with the Head of Editorial and hold regular performance and development meetings.

  • Champion LADbible’s editorial voice, tone and standards across all output.

  • Ensure content is culturally relevant, distinctive and aligned with audience interests.

  • Manage and participate in the team rota, ensuring appropriate staffing for evenings, weekends, major events and periods of increased news activity.

Required skills and experience

  • Significant experience in digital publishing, preferably within a fast-paced newsroom and in an editorial leadership role.

  • Proven experience managing, motivating and developing a team of journalists.

  • Strong commissioning and news-editing experience, with the ability to improve copy, headlines, structure and story framing.

  • A strong working knowledge of media law, editorial compliance and the legal risks associated with digital publishing.

  • Confidence handling legally sensitive stories and knowing when further legal or senior editorial guidance is required.

  • Experience using performance data to inform commissioning, publishing and content-planning decisions.

  • Experience setting objectives, managing performance and providing actionable feedback.

  • Strong communication, organisation and team-coordination skills.

Peel Region consists of the cities of Brampton and Mississauga, and the town of Caledon. Peel Region delivers essential services to more than 1.5 million residents and approximately 200,000 businesses.

We’re working to create a community that is safe, inclusive, and accessible. A place where everyone feels they belong and can access the services they need to thrive throughout each stage of life.

Recognized by Canada's Healthy Workplace Month® with the Great Employer Award presented by Excellence Canada, Peel Region is a place where everyone feels they belong. We strive to develop a workplace that values and respects diversity, practices inclusion, recognizes the unique contributions and abilities of all people and facilitates innovative thinking. At Peel Region, people come first. Each employee has an important role within our community and when we work together, it’s impactful. We encourage you to join us in delivering essential services and programs to our diverse community. You won't find a better opportunity than Peel Region.

description:
Overview

POSITION TITLE (Oracle title)

INSTRUCTIONAL ASSISTANT

WORKING TITLE

Elementary, Middle, or High School

School Site

No

Monday-Friday (occasional evenings and weekends/Workday must not exceed more than 40 hours per week and begins at least 30 minutes prior to the instructional day for students.)

POSITION PURPOSE:

Performs instructional support work assisting classroom teachers in classroom activities as well as general administrative support tasks. Implements goals and objectives established by licensed teachers and works directly with students. Assists in the instruction of individual students or groups of students in all curricular areas as directed by teachers or administrators. Plans and collaborates with teachers in devising special strategies for reinforcing skills and concepts based on the understanding of individual students.
