  • Considerable knowledge of Microsoft Office, specifically Microsoft Word, Excel, and Power Point; Google Apps;

  • Working knowledge of successful instructional delivery methods;

  • Working knowledge of the core subjects at the grade level to which employment assignment is made;

  • Ability to recognize and support students of diverse backgrounds, learning abilities, and learning styles;

  • Ability to protect the confidentiality of personally identifiable information in accordance with the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act of 1974 (FERPA) and other applicable federal and state laws, policies, and regulations;

  • Ability to work in a team environment and effectively collaborate with others;

  • Ability to motivate students;

  • Ability to constantly supervise the safety and well-being of students;

  • Ability to work with a diverse student population and recognize variations in student backgrounds, abilities, and learning styles;

  • Ability to communicate clearly and concisely both in oral and written form using a variety of communication techniques and tools to ensure the appropriate flow of information, collaborative efforts, and feedback;

  • Ability to implement academic and behavioral interventions, as needed;

  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with school system staff, students, parents, businesses, community agencies, and the public.

EDUCATION, TRAINING, AND EXPERIENCE ALL SCHOOLS

  • High school diploma or GED.

EDUCATION, TRAINING, AND EXPERIENCE IF TITLE I SCHOOL

  • Meet the employment requirements outlined by the Every Student Succeeds Act (ESSA), Pub.L.114-95, AND have one of the following:

    • Six documented semester hours of coursework in childhood education, OR

    • Two years of work experience in a childhood setting.

CERTIFICATION AND LICENSE REQUIREMENTS

  • Dependent upon the need of the school and the student population, hold and maintain a Crisis Prevention and Intervention (CPI) certification (Principal will determine if the position requires; CPI training will be provided through WCPSS).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • CPR and First Aid certification.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides assistance with activities and duties that implement the total school program, assists teachers in instructional activities, and assists teachers in ensuring an encouraging, caring, safe and healthy environment for all students.

  • Aids teachers with planning and organizing, evaluating instructional activities, developing classroom procedures, and preparing necessary materials; ensures materials for students are readily available according to the needs of the lesson plan.

  • Demonstrates professional and technical skills necessary to function effectively in the classroom and to support the school program.

  • Works with an individual student and/or specific groups of students in a different classroom and/or area of the school, as needed.

  • Participates in the district staff development program and continued professional growth in the area of assignment.

  • Maintains a positive disposition, exercises good judgement, and remains calm when dealing with students at all times.

  • May perform vision and hearing screenings; enters results into the Electronic Access Student Information System (EASi, student’s electronic records system.) Initial training and recertification will be provided through WCPSS, if needed.

  • Performs other related duties, as assigned.

WORK ENVIRONMENT/PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This job operates in a classroom environment and requires sitting and standing throughout the day. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, scanners, and copiers. The position, at times, must be able to come into direct contact with school system staff, staff members of external funding agencies, and the community. Work is considered medium physical work, requiring the exertion of up to 50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 25 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects. School can contact the school’s Physical Therapist for assistance, if needed, with proper lifting techniques.

They are not intended to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required by the employees assigned to this position. title: Flight Control Systems Engineer
description:
Company Overview

Imagine an air taxi that takes-off vertically and quietly, carries you and your fellow passengers across the city streets below, bringing you to the people and places you want to spend time with via the uncongested electric sky. Since 2009, our team has worked steadily to make this dream a reality. We’ve designed and tested many generations of prototype aircraft capable of serving in the urban environment. We’re looking for talented, committed individuals to join our team as we push toward certifying the Joby aircraft, scaling our manufacturing, and launching our initial commercial service.

Overview

As a Flight Control Systems Engineer, you will be implementing and improving the flight control algorithm, running simulations and analysis to validate control law design, drafting tests to verify system level behavior in labs and on-aircraft. You will work alongside the system test team to debug and verify system performance and failure handling. You will help certification engineers draft and manage requirements and review test cases and procedures. You will work with the modeling team to create simulations and analysis frameworks for collecting and presenting critical design data. You will collaborate with the Aircraft, Safety, Avionics, Loads, Performance, and Rotor Dynamics teams to identify deficiencies and refine the aircraft design. You will work with test pilots to define desirable handling and flying characteristics, participate in mission planning, scenario simulations, and provide in-person support during envelope expansion flight testing. You will work with software engineers to ensure relevant tests are run and relevant artifacts are produced, stored, and linked.

Responsibilities

  • Simulation and analysis of aircraft responses
  • Development and implementation of flight control features
  • Data review from flight test and other testing platforms
  • Test case authorship
  • Tool development and continuous integration improvement
  • Requirement authorship and management
  • Authorship and management of artifacts used for compliance-showing

Required

  • B.S. + 3 years of experience, or M.S. in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, aerospace engineering, computer science, or a related field
  • Knowledge in classical controls, modern state-space controls, and numerical optimization
  • Knowledge in multi-body dynamics, aerodynamics, and electrical powertrain
  • Knowledge in digital signal processing and real-time embedded systems
  • Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink, C/C++, and Python
  • Proficiency with continuous integration pipelines, virtual environments, and Linux operating systems

Desired

  • Passion about flying machines

Compensation at Joby is a combination of base pay and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). The target base pay for this position is $115,200 - $198,200/yr. The compensation package will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Joby also offers a comprehensive benefits package, including paid time off, healthcare benefits, a 401(k) plan with a company match, an employee stock purchase plan (ESPP), short-term and long-term disability coverage, life insurance, and more.

title: Mediterranean Market Manager
description:
MEDITERRANEAN MARKET MANAGER

Spain · Portugal · Italy

Remote (Spain) | Full-time

About Triptease

Triptease is on a mission to level the playing field for hotels. In a world dominated by OTAs (Online Travel Agents), we're giving power back to hoteliers – helping them drive more direct bookings, improve margins, and own their guest relationships.

Our platform combines proprietary hotel data, AI-driven marketing tools, and advanced pricing intelligence to give hoteliers an edge. With over £1 billion in direct revenue driven for clients annually and a global presence – this is your chance to be part of something big.

The Role

We are looking for a Mediterranean Market Manager to own and grow Triptease's commercial presence across Spain, Portugal, and Italy — three of the highest-density hotel markets in Europe and collectively one of the largest opportunities in our EMEA portfolio.

This is a full-market ownership role — you are responsible for new business, existing clients, and regional partner relationships across all three territories. There is no dedicated market owner across this cluster today, which means you will be building from a strong but under-served base with real scope to make your mark.

We are looking for a seasoned professional who is a hunter by nature and a consultant by trade. You will focus on high-velocity growth across SMB and Mid-Market segments while developing the partner ecosystem and local brand presence that compounds over time.

You will be remote-based in Spain, alongside the EMEA sales team. This is a field-first role — your markets are built through in-person presence, and travel across the region is expected and budgeted for.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own the full commercial strategy across Spain, Portugal, and Italy — from prospecting through negotiation and close
  • Build and manage a healthy territory pipeline across SMB, SMB+, and Mid-Market hotel segments — independents, boutique groups, and multi-property chains
  • Prioritise and sequence market coverage across three territories, balancing existing client base with greenfield opportunity
  • Represent Triptease at hospitality events, trade shows, and industry forums across the region — including Fitur, BTL, and key Italian hospitality forums
  • Develop and maintain a regional partner network — CRM and RMS providers, management consultancies, and hospitality associations
  • Work closely with Marketing, Customer Success, and Product teams to share market intelligence and shape regional positioning
  • Turn early client wins into reference relationships that generate further pipeline across the cluster

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

  • Fluent in at least two of the three market languages: Spanish, Portuguese, and Italian — you will write executive correspondence, present at industry events, and negotiate in-language
  • Fluent English, written and spoken
  • 5+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, ideally in hotel tech, travel tech, or adjacent hospitality technology
  • Demonstrated track record closing both high-velocity SMB deals and complex Mid-Market cycles
  • Strong depth in one or two of the target markets: Spain, Portugal, or Italy
  • Existing network within the Spanish, Portuguese, or Italian hospitality markets — Revenue Managers, e-Commerce Directors, General Managers, or hotel group executives
  • Strong outbound discipline — comfortable building pipeline from scratch without relying on inbound lead flow
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly across all three markets; a visible, in-market presence is core to success in this region

Bonus Points

  • Direct experience with hospitality buyers in more than one of the three markets
  • Existing relationships within the hotel tech ecosystem — PMS, RMS, channel managers, or regional consultancies
  • Familiarity with metasearch, Google Hotel Ads, or hotel PPC
  • Experience with SPIN, Challenger, and/or MEDDICC selling methodologies
  • Proficiency with Salesforce, Gong, or similar revenue tooling

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary of 65000-75000 EUR/year with uncapped commission - (€110K OTE)
  • Remote-first in Spain
  • Travel budget structured around in-market cadence across Spain, Portugal, and Italy
  • Share options in a profitable, fast-growth SaaS business
  • Health and wellness budget, learning budget, and enhanced parental leave

title: Social Editor - Freelance
description:
LBG Media plc is one of the world’s fastest-growing and most influential digital media companies. Our brands, including LADbible, reach over 1 billion people globally and generate more than 13.9 billion social views every month. With a following of over 520 million, we are the world’s most engaged publisher on social and shape the way Millennials and Gen Z consume content — across the UK, the US, and beyond.

At LADbible, we’re not just reporting the news — we’re defining culture. Our team moves fast, embraces trends, and creates content that resonates with millions of people every day.

The Role

We’re looking for a Social Editor to be at the heart of LADbible’s audience growth strategy. You’ll be responsible for distributing trending and breaking news to our global audience, ensuring our journalism reaches the right people, on the right platforms, at the right time.

You’ll work closely with journalists and editors to shape a daily publishing schedule, using editorial judgement and data insight to maximise reach and engagement across social platforms and beyond.

This is a fast-paced, social-led editorial role with real impact on brand performance.

What You’ll Do

  • Stay ahead of competitors by proactively researching trending news, stories, and viral videos

  • Identify and champion content that audiences will want to read, watch, or share

  • Take a 360° approach to sourcing and distributing content across multiple platforms and referrers

  • Collaborate with social editors, writers, and journalists to develop ideas and improve content performance

  • Schedule and post content, primarily across Facebook and X (Twitter)

  • Package articles by writing compelling headlines, captions, and selecting attention-grabbing thumbnails

  • Monitor performance using social and audience analytics tools, optimising content to maximise reach

  • Explore and adopt new methods for audience growth across search and other referrers

  • Bring creativity, initiative, and fresh ideas to the team, contributing to ongoing improvements

  • Work across a seven-day rota and cover live events as they happen

Who You Are

  • At least 2 years’ experience in a newsroom, digital publisher, or newspaper environment

  • Experience working for a social publisher or digital newsroom is essential

  • Strong knowledge of social media platforms and Google Search

  • Interest in the UK and US news agenda, including pop culture, trends, and viral stories

  • Degree in Journalism, Broadcasting, Media, or equivalent experience (or strong relevant experience)

  • Experience selecting content and writing headlines for a digital audience

  • Understanding of trending news and how to turn it into engaging, audience-led stories

  • Working knowledge of analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Trends, Chartbeat, or NewsWhip is desirable

  • Proven ability to work collaboratively within editorial teams; mentoring experience is a plus but not required

  • Strong examples of content, posts, or articles that have driven audience growth

  • Strong proofreading skills and understanding of journalism law and ethics

At LADbible Group we've rolled out blended working which means the majority of departments across the business (including London, Manchester and International offices) work in the office 3 days per week.

LADbible Group is an equal opportunities employer. We are determined to create a diverse group at all levels of our company and we welcome all members of the community to apply for openings with us. As the leading social youth publisher, we have a powerful global platform to better represent our audience and enable those that do not have equal opportunities to have their voices heard. As a business, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce, in an environment where everyone feels comfortable to be themselves.

title: Power Systems Studies Engineer II
description:
Overview

As a NETA accredited independent electrical testing & engineering organization, we set the standard for technical expertise and uncompromising safety within the renewable energy, data centers, and industrial industries.

At Electric Power Systems, we specialize in electrical acceptance testing, commissioning, and maintenance testing for a wide range of clients including Utility, Generation, Renewables, Industrial, Transit, Data Centers, and Commercial Facilities throughout North America. We are committed to providing a culture of safety and technical expertise as a way of setting the standard of excellence in the power industry.

We care about our employees and offer a generous benefits package including:

  • Competitive pay
  • Nashville Training Academy & Comprehensive Training Resources
  • Career Path Planning
  • Incentives for Professional Certifications
  • Competitive Per Diem
  • Referral Bonuses
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Medical, vision, and dental benefits
  • 401k with company match

Job Purpose:

The Power Systems Studies Engineer II works on project teams to deliver high-quality power system analysis and engineering solutions for utility, industrial, commercial, and renewable energy facilities. This position performs electrical studies, develops protective device settings, conducts field investigations, and supports project execution from data collection through final deliverables. The engineer works closely with clients, project teams, and field personnel to evaluate electrical system performance, ensure compliance with applicable codes and standards, and provide solutions that enhance the safety, reliability, and efficiency of electrical power systems.

Responsibilities

  • Perform power system studies including short circuit, coordination, arc flash, load flow, harmonic analysis, and motor starting studies for low- and medium-voltage electrical systems.
  • Conduct engineering calculations and analyses, including cable ampacity, equipment sizing and evaluation, voltage drop, and protective device selection.
  • Develop and validate protective device settings for low-voltage breakers and protective relays, including overcurrent, differential, and recloser applications.
  • Review electrical drawings, one-line diagrams, vendor submittals, and technical specifications to ensure compliance with project requirements and applicable codes and standards.
  • Conduct field investigations, data collection, testing support, and point-to-point verification activities as required.
  • Research and interpret applicable industry standards, codes, regulations, and client specifications.
  • Develop project schedules, labor estimates, and engineering deliverables for assigned projects.
  • Perform quality assurance and peer reviews of engineering studies and technical documentation.
  • Collaborate with project managers, clients, field personnel, and other engineering disciplines to support project execution.
  • Promote a strong safety culture through active participation in safety meetings, training, and company safety initiatives.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years of electrical engineering experience; consulting, power systems, utility, or industrial experience preferred.
  • Engineer-in-Training (EIT) certification or successful completion of the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) exam preferred.
  • Experience performing electrical power system analyses, including short circuit, coordination, arc flash, load flow, harmonic, and motor starting studies.
  • Knowledge of electrical equipment and power system components, including breakers, transformers, relays, capacitors, reactors, rectifiers, and inverters.
  • Working knowledge of protective relaying principles and control circuits.
  • Ability to read, interpret, and develop one-line diagrams, schematics, and technical drawings.
  • Working knowledge of the National Electrical Code (NEC) and applicable industry standards.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills with the ability to perform engineering calculations and technical evaluations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical information effectively to clients, colleagues, and stakeholders.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and engineering software such as SKM, ETAP, EasyPower, or similar platforms preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a collaborative team environment.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 10% as required.

EPS is an equal opportunity employer and gives consideration for employment to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, disability, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), political affiliation, military service, national origin, age, or any other characteristics protected by state or federal laws.

EPS does not work with individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies, and will not recognize claims to any unsolicited resumes or candidate information.

description:
Overview

POSITION TITLE (Oracle title)

INSTRUCTIONAL ASSISTANT-SPECIAL EDUCATION

WORKING TITLE

Special Education Instructional Assistant-Adapted Curriculum

Special Assignment Instructional Assistant (SAIA)

POSITION PURPOSE:

Provides support and assists in coordinating instructional programs relating to special education students and their Individual Education Plans (IEP). Monitors programs with students with disabilities, maintains confidentiality, and complies with all federal, state, and local laws, regulations, guidelines, and procedures as they relate to the special education program throughout the district. Maintains an environment conducive to learning.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

(See Education and Training for requirements for TITLE I schools)

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES (KSAs)

  • Considerable knowledge of Microsoft Office, specifically Microsoft Word, Excel, and Power Point; Google Apps;

  • Working knowledge of successful instructional delivery methods;

  • Working knowledge of general classroom activities and routines;

  • Ability to protect the confidentiality of personally identifiable information in accordance with the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act of 1974 (FERPA) and other applicable federal and state laws, policies, and regulations;

  • Ability to work in a team environment and effectively collaborate with others;

  • Ability to motivate students;

  • Ability to constantly monitor and supervise the safety and well-being of students;

  • Ability to recognize and support students with a variety of backgrounds, abilities, exceptionalities, behavioral needs, and learning styles;

  • Ability to communicate clearly and concisely both in oral and written form using a variety of communication techniques and tools to ensure the appropriate flow of information, collaborative efforts, and feedback;

  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with school system staff, students, parents, businesses, community agencies, and the public.

EDUCATION, TRAINING, AND EXPERIENCE ALL SCHOOLS

  • High school diploma or GED.

EDUCATION, TRAINING, AND EXPERIENCE IF TITLE I SCHOOL

  • Meet the employment requirements outlined by the Every Student Succeeds Act (ESSA), Pub.L. 114-95, AND have one of the following:

    • Six documented semester hours of coursework in early childhood education, OR

    • Two years of work experience in an early childhood setting.

CERTIFICATION AND LICENSE REQUIREMENTS

  • Maintain a Crisis Prevention and Intervention (CPI) certification and maintain that certification through the proper renewal process, adhering to all timelines; CPI training will be provided through Wake County Public School System (WCPSS), if needed.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • CPR and First Aid certification;

  • Experience working with or assisting individuals with special needs (an individual with one or more difficulties such as, a physical, emotional, behavioral, or learning disability or impairment that causes an individual to require additional or specialized services or accommodations).

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides support and assistance to teachers in coordinating instructional programs for special education students, including familiarity with student’s IEP; ensures an encouraging, caring, safe, and healthful environment for all students.

  • Assists teachers with strategies related to the implementation of students’ behavioral intervention plans.

  • Aids teachers with planning and organizing, evaluating instructional activities, developing classroom procedures, and preparing necessary materials; ensures materials for students are readily available according to the needs of the lesson plan.

  • Demonstrates professional and technical skills necessary to function effectively in the classroom and to support student achievement and the school program.

  • Maintains a positive disposition, exercises good judgement, and remains calm when dealing with students at all times.

  • Provides in-class support while promoting progress towards independence and self-determination for all students.

  • Assists teachers with implementation of low- and high-tech assistive technology and augmentative communication devices in the classroom to meet both class-wide and individual student needs.

  • Compiles, maintains, and files reports, records, and other required documents, maintaining confidentiality.

  • Participates in the district staff development program and continued professional growth in the area of assignment.

  • Coordinates, assists, and facilitates student transitions between classes; assists students by providing for special health care needs, which could include:

  • Personal hygiene, restroom functions, diapering, etc.;

  • Mobility assistance including lifting, positioning or transferring student;

  • Activities related to seizure control;

  • Feeding needs;

  • Adaptive equipment needs such as wheelchairs, crutches, prosthetic devices, orthotic devices, hearing aids, braille, assistive listening devices (ADL), and augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) devices;

  • Behavioral assistance and CPI skills.

  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

ADDITIONAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES-SATA Only:

  • Assigned to be a one-on-one instructional assistant to a student who has severe to profound learning disabilities.

  • Attends and successfully completes specialized training, as determined by student’s IEP.

WORK ENVIRONMENT/PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This job operates in a classroom environment and requires sitting and standing throughout the day. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, scanners, and copiers. The position, at times, must be able to come into direct contact with school system staff, staff members of external funding agencies, and the community. Work is considered medium physical work, requiring the exertion of up to 50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 25 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects. School can contact the school’s Physical Therapist for assistance, if needed, for proper lifting techniques.

EFFECTIVE DATE: 3/2025

title: Medewerker Facturatie
description:
Hoe jij het verschil maakt

Als Medewerker Facturatie maak je deel uit van ons Customer Operations-team. Binnen dit team ligt jouw focus op facturatie en in het bijzonder op het analyseren en verwerken van correcties. Je zorgt ervoor dat onze klanten een juiste en begrijpelijke factuur ontvangen en helpt hen wanneer daar vragen over zijn.

Je voert operationele en ad-hocwerkzaamheden uit volgens duidelijke werkwijzen, procedures en richtlijnen. Dankzij jouw financiële inzicht en kennis van onze processen doorgrond je vragen snel, herken je knelpunten en kom je tot een praktische oplossing. Daarbij stel je zelfstandig prioriteiten en zorg je ervoor dat alle informatie in onze systemen volledig, overzichtelijk en correct is.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je controleert en analyseert facturen en onderliggende gegevens.

  • Je onderzoekt afwijkingen en voert factuurcorrecties zorgvuldig door.

  • Je beantwoordt vragen van klanten over facturen en correcties en geeft duidelijke uitleg.

  • Je voert operationele en ad-hocwerkzaamheden uit rondom facturatie.

  • Je bewaakt deadlines, stelt prioriteiten en zorgt dat correcties en uitvalmeldingen tijdig worden verwerkt.

  • Je registreert alle relevante informatie volledig en correct in onze systemen.

  • Je maakt afwijkingen inzichtelijk en zorgt dat collega’s tijdig over de juiste informatie beschikken.

  • Je schakelt met collega’s uit aangrenzende processen en, waar nodig, met externe betrokkenen.

  • Je signaleert terugkerende fouten en denkt mee over praktische verbeteringen in onze processen.

Je komt terecht in een betrokken Customer Operations-team waarin vertrouwen, samenwerking en ontwikkeling centraal staan. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat onze klanten kunnen rekenen op een correcte factuur en een goede oplossing wanneer een correctie nodig is.

Hier laad jij van op!

Bij NieuweStroom geloven we dat werk en welzijn hand in hand gaan. Daarom bieden we:

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris tussen € 2.800,- en € 3.500,- bruto per maand (bij fulltime), afhankelijk van je profiel;

  • Daarnaast betalen wij ook jouw deel van de pensioenpremie;

  • Ruimte om te genieten van andere dingen met in totaal 34 verlof- en ADV dagen op fulltime basis;

  • Korting op je energierekening als klant bij NieuweStroom;

  • Een persoonlijk vitaliteitsbudget van bruto € 1.100,- per jaar.

De energie die je meebrengt!

Je bent financieel onderlegd, werkt nauwkeurig en krijgt er energie van om vragen en afwijkingen tot op de bodem uit te zoeken. Je luistert goed, achterhaalt wat de werkelijke vraag is en legt jouw antwoord helder en begrijpelijk uit. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:

  • Je hebt een financiële achtergrond door een relevante opleiding en/of werkervaring.

  • Je beschikt bij voorkeur over hbo-werk- en -denkniveau.

  • Je hebt oog voor detail en werkt zorgvuldig met verschillende digitale systemen.

  • Je bent analytisch en doorgrondt complexe facturen en correcties snel.

  • Je werkt pragmatisch en denkt in praktische oplossingen.

  • Je kunt zelfstandig prioriteiten stellen en blijft rustig onder tijdsdruk.

  • Je bent georganiseerd en houdt overzicht, ook wanneer er onverwachte werkzaamheden tussendoor komen.

  • Je communiceert helder met klanten, collega’s en andere betrokkenen.

  • Je stelt het gezamenlijke resultaat voorop en zoekt actief de samenwerking met collega’s.

  • Je bent minimaal 32 uur per week beschikbaar.

We’re looking for a Freelance Journalist to join SPORTbible and help drive the next phase of growth.

You’ll play a key role in delivering a higher-quality, more diverse editorial output, helping us expand beyond our core strengths and build authority across multiple sports and platforms.

Be part of a team redefining the future of SPORTbible and work on a brand with huge global reach and untapped potential. Shape new formats, coverage areas and audience strategies in a creative environment with real ownership and impact.


What the opportunity looks like

  • Writing, packaging and publishing high-quality sport content across SPORTbible platforms

  • Creating original, value-add journalism including explainers, features, interviews and opinion-led pieces

  • Collaborating with social, video and commercial teams to maximise performance across platforms

  • Supporting forward planning around major sporting events and tentpole moments

  • Contributing ideas that work across multiple platforms, not just a single channel

title: Instructional Assistant - Kindergarten , General Education
description:
Overview

POSITION TITLE (Oracle title)

INSTRUCTIONAL ASSISTANT-PRE-K (General Education, Special Education, or Title I)

WORKING TITLE

Instructional Assistant-Pre-K Blended (Assignment could be divided and be in a Pre-K General Education classroom, Pre-K Special Education assignment, and/or Pre-K Title I school site assignment)

SCHOOL/DEPARTMENT

Office of Early Learning (OEL)

LOCATION

School Site

PAY GRADE

Noncertified Grade 20 or 21 (Dependent upon assignment(s))

FLSA STATUS

Nonexempt

ELIGIBILITY FOR EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT

No

WORK WEEK SCHEDULE

Monday-Friday (occasional evenings and weekends)

POSITION PURPOSE:

Performs instructional support work assisting classroom teachers in classroom activities as well as general administrative support tasks. Implements goals and objectives established by licensed teachers and works directly with students. Assists in the instruction of individual students or groups of students in all curricular areas as directed by teachers or administrators. Plans and collaborates with teachers in devising special strategies related to childcare licensure requirements, if applicable. Position can be utilized in more than one assignment (blended).

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES (KSAs)

  • Considerable knowledge of Microsoft Office, specifically Microsoft Word, Excel, and Power Point; Google Apps;

  • Working knowledge of successful instructional delivery methods;

  • Working knowledge of the core subjects at the grade level to which employment assignment is made;

  • Ability to recognize and support students of diverse backgrounds, learning abilities, and learning styles;

  • Ability to protect the confidentiality of personally identifiable information in accordance with the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act of 1974 (FERPA) and other applicable federal and state laws, policies, and regulations;

  • Ability to work in a team environment and effectively collaborate with others;

  • Ability to motivate students;

  • Ability to constantly supervise the safety and well-being of students;

  • Ability to work with a diverse student population and recognize variations in student backgrounds, abilities, and learning styles;

  • Ability to communicate clearly and concisely both in oral and written form using a variety of communication techniques and tools to ensure the appropriate flow of information, collaborative efforts, and feedback;

  • Ability to implement academic and behavioral interventions, as needed;

  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with school system staff, students, parents, businesses, community agencies, and the public.

EDUCATION, TRAINING, AND EXPERIENCE FOR NC PRE-K PROGRAMS (can include Blended and/or Title I)

  • High school diploma or GED and shall hold or be working towards, an Associate’s degree in birth-through- kindergarten, child development, early childhood education, or an early childhood education related field or a Child Development Associate (CDA) credential. Instructional assistants working toward the minimum of an associate degree shall make progress by completing a minimum of six documented semester hours per year; AND

  • For Title I schools, meet the employment requirements outlined by the Every Student Succeeds Act (ESSA), Public Law 114-95.

EDUCATION, TRAINING, AND EXPERIENCE FOR NON NC PRE-K PROGRAMS (can include Preschool Special Education/Self-Contained, Blended, and/or Title I)

  • High school diploma or equivalent; AND

  • For Title I schools, meet the employment requirements outlined by the Every Student Succeeds Act (ESSA), Public Law 114-95.

CERTIFICATION AND LICENSE REQUIREMENTS

  • Maintain a Crisis Prevention and Intervention (CPI) certification (specific program to be determined based off position; maintain that certification through the proper renewal process; adhering to all timelines; CPI training will be provided through WCPSS, if needed.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • CPR and First Aid certification.

  • For Pre-K Special Education and Blended programs, experience working with or assisting individuals with special needs (an individual with one or more difficulties such as, a physical, emotional, behavioral, or learning disability or impairment that causes an individual to require additional or specialized services or accommodations).

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

All Pre-K Programs:

  • Provides assistance with activities and duties that implement the total school program, assists teachers in instructional activities, and assists teachers in ensuring an encouraging, caring, safe and healthy environment for all students.

  • Aids teachers with planning and organizing, evaluating instructional activities, developing classroom licensure procedures, and preparing necessary materials; ensures materials for students are readily available according to the needs of the lesson plan.

  • Demonstrates professional and technical skills necessary to function effectively in the classroom and to support the school program.

  • Works with an individual student and/or specific groups of students in different pre-k licensed classrooms and/or area of the school, as needed.

  • Participates in the district staff development program and continued professional growth in the area of assignment.

  • Maintains a positive disposition, exercises good judgement, and remains calm when dealing with students at all times.

  • Compiles, maintains, and files reports, records, and other required documents, maintaining confidentiality.

  • Coordinates and assists students with special health care needs, which could include:

  • Personal hygiene, restroom functions, diapering, etc.;

  • Mobility assistance including lifting, positioning or transferring student(s);

  • Behavioral assistance and CPI skills.

  • Performs other related duties, as assigned.

Preschool Special Education/Blended Programs:

  • Provides support and assistance to teachers in coordinating instructional programs for special education students, including familiarity with student’s IEP; ensures an encouraging, caring, safe, and healthful environment for all students.

  • Assists teachers with strategies related to the implementation of students’ behavioral intervention plans.

  • Assists teachers with implementation of low- and high-tech assistive technology and augmentative communication devices in the classroom to meet both class-wide and individual student needs.

  • Performs other related duties, as assigned.

WORK ENVIRONMENT/PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This job operates in a classroom environment and requires sitting and standing throughout the day. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, scanners, and copiers. The position, at times, must be able to come into direct contact with school system staff, staff members of external funding agencies, and the community. Work is considered medium physical work, requiring the exertion of up to 50 pounds force occasionally, and/or up to 25 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects. School can contact the school’s Physical Therapist for assistance, if needed, with proper lifting techniques.

EFFECTIVE DATE: 6/2026

DISCLAIMER: The above statements are intended to describe the general purpose and responsibilities assigned to this position. They are not intended to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required by the employees assigned to this position. This description may be revised by HR and approved at any time.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Key Responsibilities:
Business Analysis & Requirements Management:
  • Engage stakeholders to understand business goals, pain points, operational challenges, and policy requirements.
  • Elicit, analyze, document, and validate business and functional requirements.
  • Translate business needs into user stories, process flows, functional specifications, and acceptance criteria.
  • Facilitate workshops and requirement-gathering sessions with stakeholders.
Process Improvement & Solution Design:
  • Analyze current business processes and identify opportunities for process optimization and automation.
  • Assess the impact of proposed changes on business operations, systems, users, and policies.
  • Collaborate with solution architects and technical teams to design practical and scalable solutions.
  • Recommend improvements that enhance operational efficiency, user experience, and service outcomes.
Product & Delivery Support:
  • Work closely with Product Managers and delivery teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Support Agile delivery by managing and refining product backlogs and requirements.
  • Clarify business requirements during development and assist teams in resolving requirement-related issues.
  • Ensure delivered solutions meet business objectives and user needs.
Testing & Quality Assurance:
  • Develop and review test scenarios, test cases, and acceptance criteria.
  • Coordinate and support System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
  • Validate that system functionality meets agreed business requirements.
  • Support defect triage and resolution activities.
Change Management & Stakeholder Engagement:
  • Build strong relationships with business, operations, and technology stakeholders.
  • Support implementation planning, business readiness, training, and adoption activities.
  • Communicate project progress, issues, risks, and recommendations effectively to stakeholders.
  • Facilitate discussions to achieve alignment across multiple stakeholder groups.
Post-Implementation & Continuous Improvement:
  • Monitor solution performance and user feedback after implementation.
  • Identify enhancement opportunities and support continuous product improvement.
  • Work with support and operations teams to investigate and address production issues.
  • Contribute to lessons learnt and best practices across projects.
Requirements:
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Relevant certifications in Business Analysis, Agile, Scrum, Product Management, or Process Improvement will be advantageous.
Experience:

title: Head of Institutional Business (EAM & B2B Solutions)
description:
Moomoo Singapore is a holistic wealth-tech platform building an intelligent investing ecosystem across its digital platform, physical experience stores and investor education community. Through the moomoo app, it provides everyday investors and professional clients with access to global markets, diverse investment products, advanced trading tools and AI-powered insights.

Since launching in March 2021, Moomoo Singapore has evolved beyond an investing platform into a popular financial literacy resource and full-spectrum wealth platform, supporting investors from their first trade to managing sophisticated portfolios. It surpassed two million customers in Singapore in June 2026, with users spanning retail investors to private wealth and institutional clients.

Moomoo Financial Singapore Pte. Ltd. is a subsidiary of Nasdaq-listed Futu Holdings Limited (Nasdaq: FUTU). The firm is regulated by the Monetary Authority of Singapore and holds a Capital Markets Services Licence (CMS101000) and Major Payment Institution Licence (PS20200617). It also has exempt financial adviser status and is authorised to provide Digital Payment Token services. Moomoo Trustee (Singapore) Pte. Ltd. is a licensed trust company, while Moomoo Singapore is a DP Clearing Member, SGX-ST Trading Member, and SGX-DT Trading and Clearing Member of Singapore Exchange.

Head of Institutional Business (EAM & B2B Solutions)

The Head of Institutional Business will lead institutional business strategy, client acquisition, revenue growth and strategic partnerships. The role will drive the development of technology-enabled brokerage, custody, investment and B2B platform solutions, translating institutional client needs into scalable business opportunities.

The successful candidate will combine strong institutional relationships and commercial execution with a sound understanding of brokerage operations, investment workflows, product development and Singapore's regulatory environment.

Responsibilities

1. Business Strategy & Growth

  • Develop and execute the institutional business strategy, driving client acquisition, AUC, trading volume and revenue growth.
  • Build relationships with EAMs, MFOs, family offices, fund managers, asset managers, brokers and other institutional clients.
  • Develop commercial propositions covering brokerage, custody, financing, investment products and B2B platform services.
  • Establish business KPIs, client coverage models and sales strategies to support scalable growth.

2. Institutional Solutions & Product Development

  • Identify institutional client needs and work with Product, Engineering and Operations to develop competitive brokerage, trading, custody and wealth technology solutions.
  • Drive the onboarding of institutional clients, funds and strategic partners, including appropriate VCC sub-funds and Actively Managed Certificates (AMCs).
  • Support the development of B2B capabilities such as multi-tier account structures, block trading and order allocation, portfolio management, reporting, API connectivity and white-label solutions.
  • Collaborate with external fund administrators, custodians, issuing banks and technology providers to deliver institutional solutions.

3. Brokerage, Operations & Governance

  • Enhance institutional execution, market access, liquidity connectivity, custody and post-trade workflows.
  • Work with Dealing, Technology, Operations and Risk teams to establish efficient onboarding, asset transfer, reconciliation, clearing and settlement processes.
  • Partner with Compliance and Legal to ensure appropriate governance, AML/CFT controls and compliance with applicable MAS requirements, licensing obligations, market conduct rules and cross-border restrictions.

4. Strategic Partnerships & Market Development

  • Develop partnerships that expand client reach, generate new assets and revenue, and strengthen Moomoo's institutional ecosystem.
  • Monitor industry developments and competitor offerings to identify new business and product opportunities.
  • Represent Moomoo at institutional events and industry forums, strengthening its market positioning.

5. Leadership & Execution

  • Build and lead a high-performing institutional business development and relationship management team.
  • Establish clear revenue and acquisition targets, performance metrics and accountability.
  • Drive cross-functional execution across Product, Engineering, Dealing, Custody, Operations, Compliance, Legal, Risk and Marketing.

Requirements

  • 10–15+ years of relevant experience in institutional sales, brokerage, EAM business development, asset management, private banking, wealth management or B2B fintech.
  • Proven track record in institutional client acquisition, business development and revenue growth.
  • Strong relationships across the EAM, family office, fund management, brokerage or institutional investment ecosystem.
  • Good understanding of institutional brokerage, execution, custody, account structures and investment workflows.
  • Ability to translate client requirements into commercially viable products, partnerships and technology solutions.
  • Familiarity with institutional platform capabilities, APIs/FIX connectivity, fund structures and relevant Singapore regulatory requirements.
  • Experience launching or onboarding funds and investment products, including VCCs or AMCs, is an advantage.
  • Strong commercial acumen, leadership, negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with an entrepreneurial mindset.
  • Degree in Finance, Business, or a related discipline. CFA, CMFAS or relevant professional qualifications are advantageous.

Please note that only short-listed candidates will be contacted.

Benefits

Working at Moomoo, you will get

  • Be a part of the world’s leading digital brokerage firm where growth and career development opportunities are endless.
  • Enjoy a competitive total compensation package that truly values your skills and contributions.
  • Comprehensive insurance coverage for employees and dependents to provide you a peace of mind
  • Fun loving and diverse work environment that hosts various team-bonding programs and company events
  • Business casual work attire everyday
  • And Much More!: Discover even more perks and benefits as we take you through the hiring process!

title: Specimen Collector - 1909
description:
Part Time Specimen Collector

Location: Augusta, ME

Schedule: Part-Time | Monday to Friday 9:00am - 2:00pm

Help make a positive impact in your community!

Millennium Health LLC is an accredited specialty laboratory with more than a decade of experience in medication monitoring and drug testing services, helping clinicians monitor use of prescription medications and illicit drugs supporting improved clinical decision-making as part of treatment for millions of Americans with chronic pain, mental illness, and substance use disorders.

The Specimen Collector is a key role at Millennium Health. As our representative, this position provides exemplary care and exceptional customer service to patients, clinicians, and our laboratory.

As a Specimen Collector:

  • Collect patient urine and/or oral fluid (saliva) specimens
  • Process and package collections for shipping
  • Serve as an intermediary between the practice / clinic and the laboratory
  • Record patient information, physician order details, and pertinent laboratory information
  • Resolve specimen concerns with billing or patient information in ordering portal
  • Order and maintain collection supplies inventory onsite
  • Observe collection for Millennium Health specimens (when applicable)
  • Driving from/to multiple facilities may be required

Requirements

Ideal Candidate:

  • 6+ months of experience as a specimen collector or 1+ years of experience in the medical field, directly supporting patients preferred
  • 2+ years of customer service experience can be considered in place of medical experience
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate a smart phone and computer required
  • Valid driver’s license required; reliable transportation
  • Medical insurance/billing and/or familiarity with medications/diagnostic codes is a plus
  • Ability to ensure HIPAA, HiTrust, Confidentiality and Compliance policy, procedures, and standards are always adhered to.
  • Ability to ensure administrative, physical and technical cyber security controls are always adhered to
  • High School diploma or equivalent required
  • Physical requirements: sitting 60%, walking 20%, standing 20%, lifting up to 20 lbs.

Millennium Health is a CLIA Certified and CAP Accredited specialty laboratory. We partner with a trusted and accredited background screening provider, to conduct pre-employment background checks. As part of our screening process, we will review the following:

• National, federal, and county criminal history

• Global watchlist search

• Social Security Number (SSN) trace

• FACIS (Fraud and Abuse Control Information System) Level 3 search

• SAM (System for Award Management) and OIG (Office of Inspector General) exclusions

• Education verification

• Driving record (Motor Vehicle Report)

• 5-panel urine drug screening

All employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of this background check. Offers may be rescinded if the results do not meet the standards established for the position.

Benefits

Benefits Offered:

  • 401k with Company Match
  • Paid Time off and Holidays
  • Tuition Assistance
  • Behavioral and Health Care Resources

  • Salary Range: $21-23/hr.

Please note this job posting is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Millennium Health is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and E-Verify participant. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, sex, national origin, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation or protected veteran status.

title: Journalists - Talent Network
description:
Journalists - Talent Network

Manchester - Shift Pattern for up to Senior-Level Candidates

Founded in 2012, LADbible Group is redefining entertainment and news for a social generation. Our global community engages with our content–spanning editorial, video, documentary and live – we reach 1 billion people each and every month. Our mission is to give the youth generation a voice by building communities that laugh, think and act. Using all major platforms, we’ve rapidly risen to become one of the world's largest publishers.

About the Opportunity

With the ongoing growth of our Editorial Team - we're expanding our Journalist Network. We’re looking for talent across ALL levels, Junior to Senior and beyond, we want to hear from you.

You'll write fast turnaround articles across our brands (LADbible, UNILAD, SPORTbible, Tyla, GAMINGbible), covering breaking news, viral moments and pop culture for a global youth audience. You'll take sourcing and story leads (often flagged by Social Editors) and turn them into accurate, on-brand copy at speed

It's a fast-paced newsroom environment where no two days are the same, with constant opportunity to develop, pitch original ideas and lead on major editorial moments.

What we typically look for:

• Write accurate, engaging and informative content in line with tone of the brand

• Producing trending articles at speed and pitching original ideas and follow-up angles for the biggest stories across our brands

• Remaining proactive by researching and seeking the latest news, trends, and reports ahead of competitors.

We're proud of the talent we've built at LADbible Group - and we're intentional about keeping that bar high. We hire people who are exceptional at their craft, hungry to grow, and raise the standard of everyone around them. Whatever the role, we look for the same core qualities:

• Pace - you move quickly, make decisions and learn from what happens next

• Audience obsession - you instinctively think about what our community wants

LADbible Group is an equal opportunities employer. We are determined to create a diverse group at all levels of our company and we welcome all members of the community to apply for openings with us. title: Power Systems Studies Engineer I
description:
Overview

As a NETA accredited independent electrical testing & engineering organization, we set the standard for technical expertise and uncompromising safety within the renewable energy, data centers, and industrial industries.

At Electric Power Systems, we specialize in electrical acceptance testing, commissioning, and maintenance testing for a wide range of clients including Utility, Generation, Renewables, Industrial, Transit, Data Centers, and Commercial Facilities throughout North America. We are committed to providing a culture of safety and technical expertise as a way of setting the standard of excellence in the power industry.

We care about our employees and offer a generous benefits package including:

  • Competitive pay
  • Nashville Training Academy & Comprehensive Training Resources
  • Career Path Planning
  • Incentives for Professional Certifications
  • Competitive Per Diem
  • Referral Bonuses
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Medical, vision, and dental benefits
  • 401k with company match

Job Purpose:

The Power Systems Studies Engineer I supports the analysis, evaluation, and design of electrical power systems for utility, industrial, commercial, and institutional facilities. Working under the guidance of senior engineers and as part of a multidisciplinary project team, this role assists with power system studies, engineering calculations, field data collection, and technical documentation. The engineer applies fundamental engineering principles and industry standards to support the delivery of safe, reliable, and effective solutions while gaining experience in power system analysis, protection, and electrical system performance.

Responsibilities

  • Assist in performing electrical power system studies, including short-circuit, coordination, and arc flash analyses for low-voltage systems.
  • Perform engineering calculations and analyses, including cable ampacity, voltage drop, equipment evaluation, and protective device sizing.
  • Support the development of settings for low-voltage circuit breakers and simple overcurrent relays under the guidance of senior engineers.
  • Review electrical drawings, one-line diagrams, vendor submittals, and technical specifications for accuracy and compliance with project requirements.
  • Assist with field investigations, data collection, and point-to-point verification activities.
  • Research and apply applicable codes, standards, regulations, and client specifications.
  • Prepare technical reports, calculations, and project documentation.
  • Collaborate with engineers, project managers, and field personnel to support project execution and deliverables.
  • Participate in quality reviews and incorporate feedback from senior engineers.
  • Promote a strong safety culture through active participation in safety meetings, training, and company safety initiatives.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, or a related field.
  • 0-3 years of electrical engineering experience. Internship, co-op, consulting, utility, industrial, or power systems experience is a plus.
  • Successful completion of the FE exam or EIT certification preferred.
  • Fundamental understanding of electrical power systems and distribution equipment.
  • Familiarity with electrical equipment including breakers, transformers, relays, motors, capacitors, and other power system components.
  • Basic knowledge of protective relaying principles and control circuits.
  • Ability to read and interpret one-line diagrams, schematics, technical drawings, and specifications.
  • Working knowledge of the National Electrical Code (NEC).
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office; experience with SKM, ETAP, EasyPower, or similar engineering software is preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% as required.

EPS is an equal opportunity employer and gives consideration for employment to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, disability, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), political affiliation, military service, national origin, age, or any other characteristics protected by state or federal laws.

EPS does not work with individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies, and will not recognize claims to any unsolicited resumes or candidate information.

title: Kokk - vikar
description:
Ved Campus Kristiansund bygger vi opp en gruppe kokker som kan hoppe inn når kjøkkenet trenger litt ekstra hjelp, og vi i Compass Group vil gjerne ha deg med på laget.

Hverdagen på campus er livlig. Noen dager går alt sin vante gang, andre dager er det mer å gjøre enn vanlig, og av og til trenger vi en som kan stille opp med kort varsel. Derfor ønsker vi oss flere dyktige folk vi kan ringe til. Du får en forespørsel når vi trenger deg, og du bestemmer selv om du har anledning. Vaktene varierer, så det er ingen faste tider å forholde seg til.

Dette er et godt alternativ hvis du:

  • studerer og vil ha en jobb som lar seg kombinere med skolehverdagen

  • jobber i turnus, for eksempel offshore eller til sjøs, og vil fylle friperiodene med noe meningsfullt

  • har en annen jobb eller en fleksibel hverdag og ønsker en ekstra inntekt

  • Lage god mat til lunsj, middag og arrangementer

  • Jobbe etter konseptene våre og bidra til en høy standard på kjøkkenet

  • Ta imot og holde orden på varer og lager

  • Følge våre rutiner for HMS og internkontroll

  • Holde kjøkken og serveringsområde rent og ryddig

Hvem vi tror du er
Du har fagbrev som kokk eller god erfaring fra kjøkken, og du føler deg trygg i en travel hverdag. Du snakker og forstår norsk, er blid og imøtekommende mot både gjester og kolleger, og er noen vi kan stole på når det gjelder. Førerkort er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Hos oss får du

  • Fleksibilitet og frihet til å takke ja eller nei

  • Opplæring og gode kolleger som tar deg godt imot

  • Varierte dager på en spennende arbeidsplass

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser

Vi behandler søknader fortløpende, og oppstart avtales etter dine ønsker. Send oss en søknad, så tar vi en prat!

title: Associate Creative Director - Women's Lifestyle
description:
LADbible Group is one of the world’s most engaged digital entertainment businesses, reaching over a billion people globally and amassing more than 13.9 billion social views each month. With a powerhouse portfolio across general lifestyle, entertainment, sport, gaming, and tech, our brands: - including LADbible, UNILAD, GAMINGbible, and UNILAD Tech, are some of the most recognised and culturally relevant on the internet.

LADbible’s Commercial Team, LAD360, is a powerhouse of creativity, strategy, and innovation - partnering with the world’s most iconic brands, from Google and Nike to Disney and Tesco. With a headcount of 150 and growing, LAD360 has rapidly become one of the most formidable forces in media, delivering culture-shaping campaigns. Our work has earned us top industry accolades, including Commercial Team of the Year at the 2025 Campaign UK Awards and Media Brand of the Year at the 2024 MediaWeek Awards. At the heart of it all is a relentless drive to push boundaries, tell bold stories, and connect brands to youth culture like no one else can.

About the Role

Our commercial team is looking for an Associate Creative Director who understands what makes young women laugh, gets them talking, and matters to them. With a focus on Betches UK, this is an opportunity to shape bold, funny, culturally relevant content that connects with a Gen Z audience.

We’re looking for someone with a passion for women’s issues and lifestyle, a sharp sense of humour, and the ability to turn audience insights into standout, social-first branded content. You’ll define what great looks like across both partnership campaigns and platform output, guiding the team from initial spark through to delivery.

You’ll lead creative ideation across short-form video, memes, reactive content and talent-led formats, creating work that feels native, entertaining and true to Betches UK’s voice. From dating and friendships to careers, pop culture and the issues shaping women’s lives, you’ll know how to find the relatable truth and turn it into something worth sharing.

This role sits at the heart of the team, leading and inspiring a multidisciplinary group of creative producers, editors, creators, and talent partners to deliver work that earns attention and drives real impact.

What the opportunity looks like

  • Lead the creative development of women’s lifestyle branded content, with a focus on BETCHES UK, ensuring ideas feel native to the platform and true to the brand’s voice.

  • Apply and evolve successful content formats into partnership work, while developing new formats that connect with young women.

  • Oversee creative output across owned social channels, ensuring consistency, quality and platform relevance.

  • Own the end-to-end creative output, maintaining a high standard across both always-on content and campaign moments.

  • Shape and manage the idea pipeline, balancing reactive content with bigger, format-led executions.

  • Champion humour and an authentic female perspective, finding fresh ways to reflect the experiences, interests and issues that matter to our audience.

  • Lead, mentor and inspire the wider creative team, providing clear direction and elevating the quality of ideas and execution.

  • Act as the senior creative voice in client conversations, turning briefs into strong, simple ideas and presenting them clearly and confidently.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure ideas are both ambitious and deliverable within fast-paced production timelines.

  • Stay tapped into Gen Z culture, platform trends and audience behaviour, ensuring all output feels current and relevant.

Skills and experience we'd like you to have

  • Significant experience within a social-first creative, editorial or advertising environment, operating at a senior or leadership level.

  • A proven track record of developing standout branded content that feels native to the platform, with a portfolio that demonstrates a strong instinct for humour.

  • A passion for women’s issues and lifestyle, with an understanding of the different perspectives and experiences within a young female audience.

  • Deep Gen Z cultural fluency, from creators and internet humour to the conversations shaping young women’s lives.

  • Strong leadership skills, with experience guiding multidisciplinary teams and improving creative output.

  • Experience working with established content formats and evolving them for different brands or audiences.

  • Ability to think strategically while maintaining a strong grasp of execution, including comic timing, tone of voice and storytelling.

  • Confidence working with and influencing senior stakeholders, both internally and client-side.

  • Deep understanding of content performance and what drives engagement across key social platforms.

  • Excellent writing and pitching skills, with the ability to shape and sell ideas clearly and convincingly.

  • Comfortable balancing long-term creative direction with rapid, reactive content cycles.

Vi håper du motiveres av å sette retning, skape engasjement og oppnå gode resultater gjennom utvikling av medarbeidere, fagmiljø og arbeidsprosesser.

Sammen med teamet ditt skal du bidra til langsiktig utvikling av anleggene våre gjennom solid fagkompetanse, myndighetsoppfølging, konseptutvikling og kontinuerlig forbedringsarbeid. Avdelingen bidrar også inn i spennende prosjekter, blant annet karbonfangstprosjektet på Klemetsrud.

Du blir en del av ledergruppen i teknisk utvikling. Ledergruppen består av to ledere og tre medarbeidere med ansvar for ulike tekniske fagområder og strategisk vedlikehold. Sammen arbeider vi for en trygg, effektiv og langsiktig forvaltning og utvikling av både eksisterende og nye anlegg.


Hva vil du jobbe med hos oss?

  • Lede og utvikle medarbeidere, samt sikre systematisk kompetansebygging og erfaringsoverføring

  • Sette retning for fagområdene prosess og ytre miljø, og sikre helhetlig prioritering av avdelingens oppgaver og ressurser

  • Ivareta rollen som prosjekteier for tidligfaseprosjekter ved eksisterende kjelpark, med ansvar for tydelige mandater, mål og beslutninger

  • Eie, utvikle og forvalte kravspesifikasjoner, faglige styringsdokumenter og verktøy innen prosess og prosessikkerhet

  • Samarbeide tett med relevante fagmiljøer og interessenter for å utvikle robuste, trygge og bærekraftige løsninger


Du vil bli en del av et team som..

samarbeider og deler erfaringer: Vi har bred kompetanse og erfaring i avdelingen, og er opptatt av å lære av hverandre. Det er viktig for oss å støtte og løfte hverandre frem.

tar ansvar og driver arbeidet fremover: Hos oss får du stor grad av frihet under ansvar. Vi planlegger egen arbeidshverdag, tar eierskap til ansvarsområdene våre og følger opp leveranser.

elsker jobben vår: Vi tror på å ha det gøy på jobb! Vi er stolte av det vi gjør, er motiverte, og mener selv vi har utviklet en positiv og inspirerende arbeidskultur der vi har det morsomt sammen.


Hvem er du?

Du deler vår lidenskap for bærekraftig energi, og har interesse for karbonfangst, termisk energi og forbrenningsprosesser. Du skaper retning og fremdrift, og evner å prioritere og ta beslutninger i en kompleks arbeidshverdag.

Vi ser etter en analytisk, strukturert og tydelig leder med høy integritet og en bred forståelse for etikk og HMS. Du bygger tillit, involverer medarbeidere og skaper resultater gjennom andre. Samtidig verdsetter du ulike perspektiver og bidrar til et inkluderende og utviklende arbeidsmiljø. Vi ser også for oss at du har:

  • Relevant høyere utdanning og minimum seks års erfaring fra prosessindustri

  • Erfaring innen prosessteknikk, prosjektgjennomføring og prosessikkehet

  • God kjennskap til relevant regelverk, myndighetskrav og standarder

  • Erfaring med å motivere og lede andre mot felles mål, enten gjennom personal- eller faglig ledelse

  • God IT-kompetanse og evne til å se hvordan digitale muligheter kan forbedre arbeidsprosesser og skape verdi

  • Meget god muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk og engelsk, samt evne til å samarbeide på tvers av fagområder og organisasjonsnivåer

Det viktigste er ikke hva du har gjort tidligere, men hvem du er. Ikke nøl med å søke selv om du ikke treffer på alle punkter, det gjør ikke vi heller.

Du lurer kanskje på hva vi kan tilby deg?

  • Talent- og lederprogrammer med både faglig og personlig utvikling i fokus

  • Fleksibel arbeidstid og -sted

  • Lunsjordning med en kantine som gjør at du gleder deg til lunsj hver dag

  • Tilgang til treningsfasiliteter og bedriftsidrettslag (yoga, fotball, klatring, turgruppe m.m.). Her finnes det noe for enhver smak!

  • Gode pensjonsordninger (6% av lønn inntil 7,1G – 18% av lønn mellom 7,1G og 12G)

  • God person- og reiseforsikring, samt behandlingsforsikring


Hvis dette høres ut som noe for deg, ber vi deg legge ved CV og vitnemål, og svare på et par spørsmål i søknadsskjemaet.

Hafslund forvalter kritisk infrastruktur og følger retningslinjer og lovpålagte sikkerhetskrav fra norske myndigheter i våre rekrutteringsprosesser. Derfor vil vi gjennomføre en bakgrunnssjekk og personkontroll i henhold til kraftberedskapsforskriften og våre interne rutiner og retningslinjer. I visse rekrutteringsprosesser gjennomfører vi også kredittsjekk. Du må være forberedt på å oppgi opplysninger om deg selv i denne prosessen.
