title: Clinical Writer, German and English (Freelance)
description:
About kaiko

Clinicians and nurses work under heavier pressure than ever. More patients, more data, more decisions to make. kaiko gives them back the focus, time, and headspace they need to give patients the best possible care.

kaiko is a European clinical AI lab, and one of the only companies working across the full stack. Our approach spans three layers: our own frontier models, a clinical AI workspace built for complex hospital needs and workflows ranging from preparation and decision support to diagnostics and interpretation.

Our product is in daily use at leading European hospitals, reducing preparation time and cognitive workload for clinical teams. The next decade of European healthcare will be shaped by AI. We're here to shape it in the best way possible. kaiko is a well-funded company with a growing international team, operating from Amsterdam and Zurich.

About the role

We are looking for a writer who works in German and English at the same standard.

Our readers are clinical and Tech. CMIOs, oncologists, pathologists and hospital IT leads, in German and English speaking markets. Writing for them takes precision, a working grasp of clinical vocabulary, and the discipline to say only what the evidence supports.

You do two things. You write kaiko's German-language material as original writing rather than translation. And you build our library of customer stories, interviewing the clinicians who use our product and writing the pieces yourself.

You work directly with the Head of Marketing.

This is a freelance engagement, retained, with an initial scope of six months and the intention to extend. You work remotely from the German-speaking region or the Netherlands, with occasional days in Zurich and Amsterdam.

Some areas of responsibility

  • Customer stories. You run the interviews with clinicians who use our product, write the articles, and carry them through hospital communications approval.

  • German-language writing across our website, campaign and event material. Written for a German-speaking clinical reader rather than translated. Around half your output is English originals.

  • Write up our roundtables, panels and webinars with hospital leaders as published articles, worth reading by people who were not in the room.

  • Copy for conferences and partner events in German and English, from session and booth text to invitations and follow-ups.

  • A German terminology and tone standard. Swiss and German clinical vocabulary, our register, and the words we do not use, in a document the team can hold to.

About you

  • German writing at publication quality for a clinical audience.

  • Professional English writing, half of what you write will be English originals.

  • Five to ten years of professional writing, at least two of them in health, medtech, pharma or hospital communications.

  • You interview well. You get a specific, usable answer out of a clinician in a short slot, and you hear when the interesting story is not the one on your question list. You have interview-based published work to show for it.

  • A self-starter who operates with limited direction. You set your own brief, chase your own approvals, and ship without waiting for a perfect spec.

Nice to have:

  • A clinical, hospital or diagnostics background, in any specialty.

  • Experience working through a hospital communications department, and the habit of planning timelines around approval rather than around the interview.

  • Experience supporting executive thought leadership or founder content.

  • We are excited to gather a broad range of perspectives in our team, as we believe it will help us build better products to support a broader set of people. If you're excited about us but don't fit every single qualification, we still encourage you to apply: we've had incredible team members join us who didn't check every box!

Why kaiko

At kaiko, we believe the best ideas come from collaboration, ownership and ambition. We've built a team of international experts where your work has a direct impact. Here's what we value:

  • Ownership: You'll have the autonomy to set your own goals, make critical decisions, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Collaboration: You'll have to approach disagreement with curiosity, build on common ground, and create solutions together.

  • Ambition: You'll be surrounded by people who set high standards for themselves and others, who see obstacles as opportunities, and who are relentless in their work to create better outcomes for patients.

Our interview process

Our process is designed to assess mutual fit across craft, motivation and values. It typically includes the following steps:

  • Screening call: a short conversation with the Head of Marketing on your motivation, your practice, and initial fit for the scope.

  • Portfolio review: we want two German samples, noting which started from a German brief rather than a source text, one English sample, and one piece based on an interview you conducted.

  • Paid exercise: more information will be provided during the interview process.

title: Development Producer - Originals - 12 Month FTC
description:
Founded in 2012, LADbible Group is redefining entertainment and news for a social generation. Our global community engages with our content–spanning editorial, video, documentary and live – we reach 1 billion people each and every month. Our mission is to give the youth generation a voice by building communities that laugh, think and act. Using all major platforms, we’ve rapidly risen to become one of the world's largest publishers.

About the Role

We are looking for a Development Producer to join our Originals team for a 12-month FTC.

The Originals team creates quality, long-form content for YouTube, broadcast and podcast platforms, designed to be shareable across LADbible Group’s social channels. We’re the team behind popular shows like Snack Wars, Minutes With, Honesty Box and Agree To Disagree.

We’re looking for someone with fresh formats, proven credits, and a fantastic knowledge of what content works for YouTube and socials. You’ll be working across three genres - entertainment, sport and factual - so experience in these areas is key.

You’ll be turning your creative ideas into new shows, so we’re looking for a multi-functional producer who can work with the wider team to manage the production of pilot series.

What the opportunity looks like

  • Creating original, returnable format ideas for our YouTube channels - LADbible Entertainment, LADbible Stories and SPORTbible.

  • Pitching new ideas to the Development Lead and channel teams.

  • Managing the production process of pilot series from start to finish.

  • Co-producing shoots and edits, working alongside a dedicated Creative Producer.

  • Developing topline ideas from the team into fleshed-out formats.

  • Planning office run-throughs and gameplay demos to test your ideas.

  • Building attention-grabbing decks and presenting to key stakeholders.

  • Working with our LAD360 commercial team to integrate partners into original content and co-developing new AFP ideas with brands.

  • Utilising research and data alongside the Channel Manager to analyse performance of formats, identify gaps in our slate, and the viability of new ideas.

  • You can demonstrate superb planning skills, managing several projects at one time.

  • An interest or experience in how AI may be used in idea development is a bonus.

  • Developing and scaling existing formats, creating new content ecosystems.

  • Liaising with Marketing to ensure new launches are fully supported.

  • Identifying and nurturing on-screen talent for new formats, alongside Talent Managers.

  • Independently developing a slate of larger-scale ‘blue sky’ productions.

Skills and experience we'd like you to have

  • You have substantial experience as a producer and a track record of developing ideas from concept to delivery or that have been commissioned by others.

  • You’ll have a thorough knowledge of and passion for YouTube and social media.

  • You know how to generate repeatable formats with clear beats, story and pacing.

  • You can translate your ideas into persuasive decks and compelling pitches.

  • You have varied interests and experience to work across three distinct genres.

  • You’ll be comfortable developing a range of formats - from gameshows to podcasts, sport debate shows to hard-hitting documentaries.

  • You have a good eye for design - from a pitch deck to a studio set, you know what pops.

  • You’ll know how graphics, music and sound design can set the tone for a format.

  • You’re enterprising and able to work independently developing new ideas.

  • You’re locked in to what young audiences are interested in and spot emerging trends.

At LADbible Group we've rolled out blended working which means the majority of departments across the business (including London, Manchester and International offices) work in the office 4 days per week.

LADbible Group is an equal opportunities employer. We are determined to create a diverse group at all levels of our company and we welcome all members of the community to apply for openings with us. As the leading social youth publisher, we have a powerful global platform to better represent our audience and enable those that do not have equal opportunities to have their voices heard. As a business, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce, in an environment where everyone feels comfortable to be themselves.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

At Kivra, we are building services that connect 6 million people, by providing a safe and accessible digital infrastructure that everyone in Sweden can trust and use. At the same time, we are saving trees - reducing the paper that is printed and transported - by providing a better digital alternative to physical paper communication.

Why are we looking for a Data Engineer?

We have a modern, cloud-based data platform, which you will build upon and improve with other engineers in the team. As part of the vision of the Data Platform Team at Kivra, we are developing an internal platform for analysts and engineers to improve the ease and experience of working with data across the organization. We connect internal and external data sources to make data available for AI, and as part of that vision, we are building a platform where Kivra can work with agents in a better, faster and safer way.

What you’ll do

  • Build and maintain an internal development platform for data tools, services, and workflows

    • Standardize configurations and workflows

    • Automate redundant tasks

    • Ensure compliance (e.g. GDPR) and security across all golden paths

  • Contribute to, build, and maintain an internal development platform making data available for ai and enabling autonomous agents to work efficiently and securely on a shared infrastructure

  • Adopt a “platform as a product” approach, treating analysts and engineers as our customers; aim to improve the analyst and engineering experience working with agents, data tools and services, and remove complexity and cognitive load of our customers

  • Use your knowledge and expertise to work with stakeholders to make data easily accessible and available to product and functional teams in Kivra (this data is used for, amongst others, business intelligence, business development, analytics, reporting and billing). We are responsible for a number of data products and services which we provide to the rest of the organization (e.g. APIs and data integrations)

  • Build, improve and maintain a resilient and scalable data foundation and infrastructure

  • As a team, we have full ownership and autonomy over what and how we build our solutions - from idea and design, to implementation and operations. We are responsible for our solutions end-to-end. We believe in and work according to everything-as-code.

Who you are

You want to join a fun, diverse and friendly team. You are a team player who wants to build good relationships with your colleagues to understand their problems and challenges. You embrace “platform thinking” in your work - and strive to enable and support your colleagues, not block them. You are proactive, entrepreneurial and want to shape this role based on the opportunities you discover. You are curious, collaborative and like solving problems.

Furthermore we think that you:

  • Are easy-going, open, curious and bring positive energy to your work and colleagues

  • Are a team-player, solution oriented and takes ownership of your outcome and tasks

  • Thrive in a DevOps environment where we take full accountability for our systems.

  • Have at least 4 years of full-time software engineering development, and an interest in AI, data engineering and platform engineering

  • Have experience working with automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), version control, containerization, and CI/CD (we use Terraform, GitHub, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions)

  • Have experience working in a cloud platform - GCP, Azure, or AWS (we use GCP)

  • Are comfortable with Python and SQL

  • Are already familiar with, or want to work in the data engineering space (and associated tooling, e.g. Airflow and DBT)

And it would be a bonus if you:

  • Are familiar with Google Cloud Platform and the tooling there

  • Have experience with data engineering and data tooling - e.g. Airflow, DBT, cloud data warehouses (we use BigQuery)

Additional information

This role is full-time and our offices are based in Stockholm. You will be part of the Data Platform Team and report to the Head of Data. Fluency in English is required and fluency in Swedish is a plus but not required. Unfortunately, we are not able to sponsor new work permits, but are able to sponsor/renew existing work permits!

We offer

Kivra offers a role in a caring and committed team, in a company that is growing and continuously innovating. You’ll join a warm and friendly culture that thrives on collaboration and teamwork. You will be involved in shaping and influencing a product currently used by more than half of Sweden’s population.

We offer competitive remuneration and great benefits. We offer a hybrid way of working where working from home is of course accepted, however you are always welcome to join us in our vibrant office located in central Stockholm.

How to apply

The application deadline is October 31st, but we will review applications on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait - submit your application today! If you have any questions regarding the role or the recruitment process don’t hesitate to contact Sarah Ohlsson, Talent Acquisition Partner at sarah.ohlsson@kivra.com.

title: Senior Administrator - Special Education Programming
description:
Overview

POSITION TITLE (Oracle title)

SENIOR ADMINISTRATOR

WORKING TITLE

Senior Administrator-Special Education Programming

SCHOOL/DEPARTMENT

Special Education Services

LOCATION

Crossroads II, Cary, NC

PAY GRADE

Senior Administrator-Band 3

FLSA STATUS

Exempt

ELIGIBILITY FOR EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT

Yes

WORK WEEK SCHEDULE

Monday-Friday (occasional evenings and weekends) Position is available for hybrid telework workweek

POSITION PURPOSE:

Provides leadership at district and school level in the development, coordination, and implementation of special education and related services to identified exceptional children. Serves as the liaison between the central office and schools and promotes the development and improvement of programs for all exceptional children.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES (KSAs)

  • Extensive knowledge of state and federal regulations and school laws and policies related to special education;

  • Extensive knowledge of curriculum and curriculum design including practices for differentiation;

  • Considerable knowledge in facilitative leadership skills;

  • Considerable knowledge of Microsoft Office specifically, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint; Google Apps;

  • Knowledge of transition education and transition services;

  • Knowledge of community agencies;

  • Effective time management skills;

  • Ability to design and deliver professional development to adult learners;

  • Ability to evaluate trainings and professional development to ensure topics and information are being implemented;

  • Ability to work in a team environment;

  • Ability to work independently and without close supervision;

  • Ability to communicate clearly and concisely both in oral and written form using a variety of communication techniques and tools to ensure the appropriate flow of information, collaborative efforts, and feedback;

  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with school system staff, students, external agencies, and the community.

EDUCATION, TRAINING, AND EXPERIENCE

  • Master's degree from a regionally accredited college or university in Educational Administration, or directly related field;

  • Five years of successful teaching experience or related school–based professional experience;

  • Leadership experience in assessing student needs;

  • Experience planning, developing and implementing programs; evaluating program effectiveness; designing and conducting staff professional development.

CERTIFICATION AND LICENSE REQUIREMENTS

  • Hold or be qualified to hold a North Carolina Professional Educator’s License in one of the license areas for Exceptional Children;

  • Hold or be qualified to hold a North Carolina Professional Educator’s License for School Administrator-Principal or Exceptional Children’s Program Administrator;

  • Leadership experience in assessing student needs;

  • Experience planning, developing and implementing programs; evaluating program effectiveness; designing and conducting staff professional development.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Leadership or supervisory experience.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Leads the district work group in the development and implementation of special education programming.

  • Works collaboratively with administrators of district teams in the development and implementation of special education programming.

  • Collaborates with administrators to develop a process for collection of data to measure the effectiveness of student progress.

title: Compliance Business Partner
description:
About the role

We are looking for a Compliance Business Partner to join our Risk and Compliance function here at Superscript.

This role is based in our newly formed Glasgow office, working closely with colleagues across the wider Compliance function based in London. You’ll be an important part of building out our compliance capability in Glasgow, whilst working collaboratively with teams and senior stakeholders across the wider business.

You will play a key role in supporting the business to maintain strong regulatory standards while enabling sustainable commercial growth. You will work closely with senior stakeholders across broking, underwriting, partnerships, product, and operations, providing clear, pragmatic regulatory advice and ensuring that compliance frameworks are effectively embedded across the organisation.

Reporting directly into the Fractional Compliance Leader, this role is suited to someone with between 3–6 years experience in a compliance, risk, or regulatory role within a regulated financial services environment, ideally within an insurance broker.

This is a hands-on second line role, requiring strong technical knowledge of Financial Conduct Authority requirements and the ability to influence and partner with the business in a fast-paced, digital insurance environment.

  • Monitor regulatory developments (e.g. FCA publications, thematic reviews, enforcement activity) and assess their impact on the business.

title: Consumer Reporter
description:
Founded in 2012, LADbible Group is redefining entertainment and news for a social generation. Our global community engages with our content–spanning editorial, video, documentary and live – we reach 1 billion people each and every month. Our mission is to give the youth generation a voice by building communities that laugh, think and act. Using all major platforms, we’ve rapidly risen to become one of the world's largest publishers.

About LADwallet

LADwallet is LADbible’s money and consumer proposition: the money manual nobody gave you. We help our audience navigate the things that genuinely affect their lives — from bills, banking and borrowing to scams, renting, refunds, tax, pay and the cost of everyday life — explained clearly, usefully and without jargon.

This is not traditional personal-finance coverage. LADwallet takes complex, often frustrating consumer issues and tells readers what they mean for them, what they could gain or lose, and what they should do next.

About the role

We’re looking for a sharp, fast and audience-obsessed Consumer Reporter to make LADwallet a recognisable, trusted and genuinely useful destination for money and consumer journalism.

You will lead on a consistent pipeline of timely, practical and engaging stories, covering breaking consumer news, original reporting, explainers, service journalism and follow-ups. You’ll be expected to develop strong contacts across consumer organisations, regulators, brands and expert communities; spot stories before competitors; and turn complicated information into simple, compelling copy in LADbible’s voice.

While consumer and money journalism will be your specialism, you’ll also support the wider LADbible newsroom with general news coverage when needed.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead LADwallet’s daily consumer-news agenda, identifying the stories that matter most to our audience.

  • Cover breaking developments across banking, borrowing, savings, bills, energy, broadband, subscriptions, shopping, housing, renting, mortgages, tax, benefits, pay, student money, motoring, travel compensation, scams and consumer rights.

  • Produce high-quality reactive stories, explainers, guides, comparisons, checklists, refunds/rights pieces and “what this means for your wallet” coverage.

  • Generate original reporting through Freedom of Information requests, reader case studies, expert commentary, data, public records and strong source relationships.

  • Build and maintain a proactive contacts book across consumer bodies, regulators, charities, campaign groups, brands and qualified experts.

  • Monitor news, policy changes, official announcements, online communities and social conversation to find fresh, useful and distinctive angles.

  • Translate complex consumer issues into clear, accessible journalism: who is affected, how much is at stake, when it changes and what readers should do now.

  • Pitch original ideas and follow-up angles, prioritising meaningful audience value over commodity rewrites.

  • Write accurate, engaging copy at pace, ensuring every story meets LADbible’s editorial, legal and accuracy standards.

  • Work closely with LADbible’s Editorial, SEO, Audience, Social, Video, Commercial and Affiliate teams to package stories effectively across platforms.

  • Use performance data — including sessions, engagement and search/discovery trends — to improve commissioning, headlines, formats and follow-up coverage.

  • Contribute to LADwallet’s repeatable editorial formats and help test new ways to build loyalty, trust and repeat readership.

  • Support general LADbible news coverage as required, including on weekends and during major breaking-news moments.

What we’re looking for

  • Proven experience as a digital journalist or reporter, ideally with experience in consumer, money, business, personal finance, news or service journalism.

  • A strong news instinct and the ability to identify the practical human consequence behind a policy, product, price change or consumer issue.

  • Demonstrable experience of sourcing, pitching and writing fast-turnaround digital stories.

  • Confidence working with primary sources, official data, regulatory announcements, reports and expert commentary.

  • A track record of finding original angles, building contacts and developing exclusive or distinctive stories.

  • Excellent writing, headline-writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to make complicated subjects feel straightforward and relevant.

  • Strong understanding of SEO, search trends and digital-news performance, alongside a willingness to learn from data.

  • Sound editorial judgement, rigorous attention to accuracy and an understanding of legal and compliance considerations in consumer and financial content.

  • An understanding of LADbible’s tone, audience and social-first approach to storytelling.

  • A collaborative, curious and proactive approach, with comfort working at pace in a busy newsroom.

  • Interest in new formats, platforms, AI tools and changing audience habits.

The bar we set

We hire people who are exceptional at their craft, hungry to grow and raise the standard of everyone around them. For this role, that means:

  • Ownership: You take responsibility for finding and delivering stories that genuinely help our audience.

  • Pace: You move quickly, make sound editorial decisions and learn from what performs.

  • Audience obsession: You instinctively ask: why does this matter to our readers, and what do they need to know or do?

  • Collaboration: You work openly across the newsroom and make the wider team better.

  • Curiosity: You stay ahead of the news, consumer trends, platforms and tools shaping how people find and use information.

At LADbible Group we've rolled out blended working which means the majority of departments across the business (including London, Manchester and International offices) work in the office 4 days per week.

LADbible Group is an equal opportunities employer. We are determined to create a diverse group at all levels of our company and we welcome all members of the community to apply for openings with us. As the leading social youth publisher, we have a powerful global platform to better represent our audience and enable those that do not have equal opportunities to have their voices heard. As a business, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce, in an environment where everyone feels comfortable to be themselves.

title: Mistr - Vedoucí týmu montáže
description:
V našem provozu v Horních Počernicích vznikají trakční měnírny – technicky náročná zařízení, která jsou klíčovou součástí železniční a energetické infrastruktury. Každá zakázka je trochu jiná a vyžaduje spolupráci, technické uvažování a dobrý přehled o tom, co se ve výrobě právě děje.

Do našeho týmu právě hledáme vedoucího montážního úseku / mistra, který chce být v samotném jádru dění. Většinu času strávíte přímo ve výrobě – s lidmi, u rozpracovaných zakázek, při řešení toho, co je zrovna potřeba. Zároveň ale budete mít přehled o plánu, datech a návaznostech, bez kterých by výroba nefungovala. Nejde o kancelářskou pozici, ale o práci, kde se pořád něco děje a kde je vidět výsledek.

Technické, ideálně elektro, uvažování je výhodou, důležitější je však chuť porozumět tomu, co lidé na výrobě skutečně dělají. Tato role sedne těm, kteří chtějí být aktivní, pracovat s lidmi a mít možnost věci reálně ovlivňovat a posouvat dál.

Co bude náplní vaší práce?

  • Každodenní vedení a koordinace svěřeného týmu
  • Aktivní práce s lidmi – podpora kolegů a řešení běžných i složitějších situací
  • Dohled nad plynulostí výroby a dodržováním termínů

title: Director, Fleet Electrical Engineering
description:
Overview

Company Overview

Pattern Energy is a leading renewable energy company that develops, constructs, owns, and operates high-quality wind and solar generation, transmission, and energy storage facilities. Our mission is to transition the world to renewable energy through the sustainable development and responsible operation of facilities with respect for the environment, communities, and cultures where we have a presence.

Our approach begins and ends with establishing trust, accountability, and transparency. Our company values of creative spirit, pride of ownership, follow-through, and a team-first attitude drive us to pursue our mission every day. Our culture supports our values by fostering innovative and critical thinking and a deep belief in living up to our promises. Headquartered in the United States, Pattern has a global portfolio of more than 30 power facilities and transmission assets, serving various customers that provide low-cost, clean energy to millions of consumers.

Responsibilities

Job PurposeThe purpose of the Director, Fleet Electrical Engineering is to provide technical leadership and engineering management for Pattern’s electrical infrastructure, including collection systems, substations, transformers, protection and control systems, revenue metering systems, and other high-voltage assets. This position serves as Pattern’s technical authority for fleet electrical systems and is responsible for establishing engineering standards, supporting operational reliability, reducing electrical risk, optimizing maintenance strategies, and providing technical leadership for compliance with applicable reliability standards and regulatory requirements.

This position is critical to assist Pattern in realizing our mission to Transition the World to Renewable Energy.

Key Accountabilities

The role is accountable for the following core areas:

  • Technical authority and standards: Serve as Pattern’s technical lead for fleet electrical systems, including collection systems, substations, transformers, switchgear, protection and control, metering, grounding, and balance-of-plant infrastructure; develop and govern related engineering standards, specifications, and technical practices.
  • Operational reliability and incident response: Provide technical leadership for troubleshooting, root cause investigations, equipment failures, forced outages, system disturbances, protection operations, major grid events, and other significant electrical incidents affecting Pattern assets.
  • Asset management and maintenance strategy: Establish fleet-wide strategies for electrical asset health, protection system maintenance and testing, transformer and substation equipment management, critical spares, equipment obsolescence, and long-term reliability improvement.
  • Compliance and stakeholder coordination: Support Reliability Compliance with technical ownership for applicable NERC standards and provide engineering support for utility interconnections, transmission coordination, facility ratings, disturbance investigations, and utility stakeholder engagement.
  • Project, consultant, and fleet support: Oversee external engineering consultants, testing contractors, relay specialists, and subject matter experts; support development, construction, commissioning, acquisitions, and asset transitions through technical review and electrical engineering expertise.
  • Continuous improvement and team development: Evaluate emerging technologies and industry best practices while mentoring electrical engineering resources and fostering technical excellence across the organization.

Qualifications

Qualifications

Education and Credentials

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or a related discipline
  • Master’s degree in electrical engineering or a related discipline preferred.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) designation strongly preferred.

Required Work Experience

Qualified applicants should demonstrate the following experience:

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in electrical engineering within electric utilities, power generation, transmission systems, consulting engineering, or related power system industries.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience with high-voltage electrical systems including substations, transformers, protection and control systems, transmission systems, and distribution systems.
  • Experience with utility interconnections, electrical asset management, and power system reliability programs.
  • Experience managing engineering consultants, contractors, and technical service providers.
  • Experience supporting NERC-regulated facilities or electric utility operations is strongly preferred.
  • Renewable energy industry experience desirable but not required.
  • Strong technical capabilities and a creative, curious, self-driven work ethic.
  • Strong leadership and team development skills.
  • Ability to work independently while leading cross-functional teams with limited supervision.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with executive leadership, operations personnel, regulators, utilities, consultants, and external stakeholders.
  • Balanced capabilities in technical expertise, business acumen, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to travel as required to operating facilities and field locations

Technical Skills

  • Computer skills: MS Office Suite, power system modeling software, electrical analysis tools, maintenance management systems, and engineering documentation platforms.
  • Engineering: Demonstrated expertise in power systems engineering, substation design and operation, transformer systems, protection and control systems, relay coordination, electrical asset management, grid interconnection requirements, and utility operations.
  • Strong understanding of NERC reliability standards, electrical maintenance practices, protection system testing programs, and electrical system reliability principles

The expected starting pay range for this role is $149,000 - $186,000 USD. This range is an estimate and base pay may be above or below the ranges based on several factors including but not limited to location, work experience, certifications, and education. In addition to base pay, Pattern’s compensation program includes a bonus structure for full-time employees of all levels. We also provide a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical, dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life insurance, voluntary benefits, family care benefits, employee assistance program, paid time off and bonding leave, paid holidays, 401(k)/RRSP retirement savings plan with employer contribution, and employee referral bonuses.

Pattern Energy Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Regional Legacy Officer, parental cover
description:
What we believe in

We are an equal opportunity employer with a longstanding commitment of providing a work environment that respects the dignity and worth of each individual. We value the benefits and strengths that diversity brings, and we thrive in an environment that encourages respect and trust. We promote equity, diversity and inclusion in our workplace and welcome applications from all sections of society.

About us

Greenpeace is a global network of campaigning organisations, working for a green and peaceful future. It comprises 26 independent national/regional Greenpeace organisations (NROs) in over 55 countries across Europe, Africa, the Americas, Asia and the Pacific, as well as a co-ordinating organisation, Greenpeace International. We expose global environmental problems and force positive changes through research, lobbying and non-violent direct action. For more information, please see .

About the role

We are living through a decisive chapter in human history. The polycrises are accelerating before our eyes, yet people continue to rise, resist, and reimagine what is possible. At Greenpeace Nordic, this moment demands more from us: more courage, more imagination, and more action. We are looking for someone who shares our belief that boldness is exactly what the world needs right now, and who can inspire our donors to build a better future with us. With the coming Great Wealth Transfer, you will play a critical role in securing greater legacy income, ensuring that the resources we need to protect our planet and power our campaigns are sustained for generations to come.

This full-time position based in Stockholm is to cover for a parental leave throughout 2027.

The Legacy Fundraiser is responsible for growing and maximising legacy income by ensuring donors are aware of, inspired by and engaged in the idea of Legacy giving across the region (Sweden, Finland, Denmark and Norway). The role’s responsibilities also include:

  • Proactive marketing and acquisition activities

  • Prospecting and developing donors within the legacy pipeline

  • Delivering high-quality donor experience and tailored stewardship

  • Managing inheritance distributions and estate inventories

  • Ensuring effective administration of legacies

  • Liaising with solicitors and families to ensure the value of bequests is maximised

In this role, you’ll be the central point for Legacy Giving, working closely with fundraising colleagues across the Nordic region to coordinate and support the local implementation of our legacy strategy.

The role is also responsible for managing the Middle Donor programme and subsequent donor event management related to legacy and middle donor engagement. Legacy fundraiser is supported by both Donor Care fundraisers and Fundraising Management, who will play an active role in delivering key activities locally.

Qualifications (Knowledge and skills needed in this position)

  • At least 3 years experience in working with Legacy giving or, alternatively, a proven track record in successfully managing high volume fundraising or direct mail programs

  • Fundraising or sales copywriting experience

  • Experience in donor/customer stewardship or relationship building

  • Knowledge of Data Analysis and Segmentation

  • Exemplary organizational skills, including the ability to set priorities, manage projects, track information, work to a timeline and achieve targeted goals.

  • Good communication skills across different channels and departments, including strong listening and negotiation skills

  • Preferably knowledge of the local legislation and regulations surrounding legacy giving

  • Capacity to prepare and present fundraising strategy and reports

  • Fluent in Swedish, excellent English, other Nordic languages is an advantage

  • Passion for the environment and a strong commitment to the aims and values of Greenpeace

We understand that no one ticks every box. If this role excites you and you have relevant or transferable skills, we encourage you to apply.

Additional information

Closing date for applications: November 1

Contract type: Fixed term, 12 months parental cover, January-December 2027

Location: Stockholm, Sweden

Start date: December 2026 - January 2027

Application information

To apply, click the Apply now button and submit the following information:

  • A CV of maximum two pages

  • A cover letter telling us why you want to work for Greenpeace and outlining what you can offer in this role

Please provide these in English.

If you have any questions, don't hesitate to get in touch with Marijan Todorovic (Deputy Fundraising Director, Greenpeace Nordic) at marijan.todorovic@greenpeace.org.

We have a collective agreement with Unionen. If you want to get in contact with the Union representatives please send an email to gpn.unionenklubben@gmail.com.

We look forward to receiving your application.

title: Land Acquisition Analyst
description:
About KB Home

KB Home is one of America's largest and most trusted homebuilders, with nearly 700,000 quality-homes built over our more than 65-year history. Operating across 21 divisions in 9 states, we don’t just build houses we create places where families can make a lifetime of memories. At KB Home, our foundation is our people. We foster genuine relationships with our customers throughout their homebuying journey, while our employees bring passion and purpose to work every day. Our shared culture of customer obsession drives our mission to make homeownership attainable for all.

The Opportunity

The Land Acquisition Analyst supports our Land Acquisition team by researching, analyzing, and managing land data to optimize the value of current and potential assets. This role plays a key part in identifying acquisition opportunities that align with our market strategy and business plan.

Join our dynamic team and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of real estate development. As a Land Acquisition Analyst, you'll have the opportunity to leverage your analytical skills and market insights to drive impactful decisions and contribute to the growth of our company. If you're passionate about real estate and eager to make a difference, this is the perfect opportunity for you!

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in preparing financial proformas to evaluate proposed land acquisitions.
  • Coordinate with the development team to establish budgets and schedules for proformas.
  • Collaborate across departments to assess home construction costs and buyer preferences.
  • Analyze due diligence information for potential investments.
  • Extract and interpret data from sources such as MLS, company databases, Metrostudy, LandVision, Census Bureau, and other websites.
  • Prepare pre-acquisition investment briefs and supporting materials.
  • Maintain financial proformas post-acquisition to track community performance and identify enhancements.
  • Develop detailed Land Packages with supporting data for submission to the Corporate Land Committee.
  • Prepare follow-up analysis and transaction forms to facilitate funds transfers for acquisitions.
  • Contribute to the annual Market Strategy report and support ad hoc projects as needed.

What You Bring

  • A Bachelor’s Degree (preferably in Accounting, Business, Finance, or Real Estate)
  • 1-3 years of experience in land acquisition, transactional work, or entitlement/forward planning in real estate development preferred.
  • Technical and analytical proficiency.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Competence in Microsoft Suite (at least intermediate level).
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritize.
  • A track record of meeting deadlines.
  • Market analysis experience is an advantage.
  • Experience with mapping software (ArcGIS, Google Earth, LandVision) is a plus.

Requirements

  • Full-time, 8-hour workdays with flexibility for overtime as needed.
  • The ideal candidate must be able to complete all physical requirements of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation.
  • Ability to stand or sit for extended periods.
  • Ability to move about work location.

  • Ability to walk up and down stairs.
  • Ability to observe details at close range and communicate information so others will understand.
  • Ability to transport and move up to 20 lbs and move as needed (for roles in Construction/Customer Service/IT/Land/Marketing/Sales/Studio).
  • Periodically works in outdoor weather conditions (for roles in Construction/Customer Service/Land/Sales).
  • On-site position at the KB Home Division Office. #LI-onsite

Compensation Details and Benefits

KB Home offers a competitive base pay. Other rewards may include bonuses or role-specific awards. KB Home provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, an employee wellness program, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays, sick time and vacation.

Base Pay Rate

EDUCATION, TRAINING, AND EXPERIENCE ALL SCHOOLS

  • High school diploma or GED.

EDUCATION, TRAINING, AND EXPERIENCE IF TITLE I SCHOOL

  • Meet the employment requirements outlined by the Every Student Succeeds Act (ESSA), Pub.L.114-95, AND have one of the following:

    • Six documented semester hours of coursework in childhood education, OR

    • Two years of work experience in a childhood setting.

CERTIFICATION AND LICENSE REQUIREMENTS

  • Dependent upon the need of the school and the student population, hold and maintain a Crisis Prevention and Intervention (CPI) certification (Principal will determine if the position requires; CPI training will be provided through WCPSS).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • CPR and First Aid certification.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides assistance with activities and duties that implement the total school program, assists teachers in instructional activities, and assists teachers in ensuring an encouraging, caring, safe and healthy environment for all students.

  • Aids teachers with planning and organizing, evaluating instructional activities, developing classroom procedures, and preparing necessary materials; ensures materials for students are readily available according to the needs of the lesson plan.

  • Demonstrates professional and technical skills necessary to function effectively in the classroom and to support the school program.

  • Works with an individual student and/or specific groups of students in a different classroom and/or area of the school, as needed.

  • Participates in the district staff development program and continued professional growth in the area of assignment.

  • Maintains a positive disposition, exercises good judgement, and remains calm when dealing with students at all times.

  • May perform vision and hearing screenings; enters results into the Electronic Access Student Information System (EASi, student’s electronic records system.) Initial training and recertification will be provided through WCPSS, if needed.

  • Performs other related duties, as assigned.

WORK ENVIRONMENT/PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This job operates in a classroom environment and requires sitting and standing throughout the day. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, scanners, and copiers. The position, at times, must be able to come into direct contact with school system staff, staff members of external funding agencies, and the community. Work is considered medium physical work, requiring the exertion of up to 50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 25 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects. School can contact the school’s Physical Therapist for assistance, if needed, with proper lifting techniques.

EFFECTIVE DATE: 3/2025

They are not intended to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required by the employees assigned to this position. This description may be revised by HR and approved at any time.

title: Sjuksköterska till Uppvaksavdelningen - Nordiska Kliniken Stockholm
description:
Nordiska Kliniken är en av Sveriges ledande och snabbast växande kliniker inom rekonstruktiv och estetisk plastikkirurgi, estetiska behandlingar och medicinsk hudvård. Hos oss kombineras medicinsk spetskompetens med en patientupplevelse utöver det vanliga. Kvalitet, säkerhet och de mest moderna behandlingsmetoderna är självklara delar av vår vardag, men det är vårt bemötande och vårt arbetssätt som gör oss unika. Nu söker vi en erfaren sjuksköterska som vill bli en del av vårt team i centrala Stockholm.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som är en serviceinriktad och professionell sjuksköterska som vill jobba som heltid.

Du brinner för att ge god omvårdnad och ett professionellt, personligt bemötande, och du har ett genuint intresse för patientarbete. Som sjuksköterska är du självständig och flexibel, med lätthet att arbeta både i team och på egen hand. Du tar egna initiativ, ser vad som behöver göras och har förmågan att anpassa dig till våra arbetssätt. Vi värdesätter också att du har ett intresse för plastikkirurgi och vill utvecklas vidare i din profession.

Du är positiv till utvecklings- och förändringsarbete och vill, tillsammans med kollegor och chef, vara med och ständigt förbättra våra arbetssätt och patientflöden. Tidigare erfarenhet från plastikkirurgi är meriterande – men inget krav.

Vi söker nu en legitimerad sjuksköterska med minst 1–2 års erfarenhet av yrket som vill arbeta tillsammans med vårt team på vår uppvaksavdelning i Stockholm.

Arbetsuppgifter

  • Omvårdnad av patienter, före, under och efter operation

  • Sedvanligt arbete på uppvaksavdelning, inklusive övervakning och uppföljning

  • Medicinering, information och stöd till patienter

  • Hantering av sjukskrivningar och dokumentation

  • Patientkontakt både före och efter operation

Vi söker dig som ser helheten i patientens vård och som vill ge varje patient det där lilla extra – både i form av hög service och en trygg, professionell upplevelse under deras vistelse hos oss.

Anställningsform

Vikariat, heltid

Omfattning

100%

Start för tjänsten

1/12-2026

Skicka in din ansökan omgående då platsen kan bli tillsatt innan sista ansökningsdag! Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig.

title: Tax Reviewer- Singapore Clients- Remote
description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate 3 business segments:

  1. Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations
  2. Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service
  3. FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

﻿

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 15,000 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 500 staff with an intact startup mindset.

﻿

We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia.

﻿

Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Singapore.

Requirements

We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Tax Reviewer to join our growing team. The ideal candidate is proactive, analytical, and committed to delivering high-quality tax compliance services. You should be eager to learn, possess strong attention to detail, and enjoy working in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment while supporting clients with their tax reporting and compliance obligations.

Mission
As a Tax Reviewer, you will be responsible for preparing and managing tax filings, tax returns, and compliance-related matters for clients at the start ensuring all work is completed accurately, on time, and in accordance with applicable tax regulations. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, maintain a high standard of client service, and contribute to the overall success of the business through accuracy and efficiency. For progression into a Reviewer role, you will first demonstrate consistent performance and strong technical competency in tax preparation and compliance before transitioning to reviewing and overseeing the work of other team members to ensure quality, accuracy, and compliance.

Outcomes

  • Prepare and submit corporate income tax filings accurately and within statutory deadlines.
  • Deliver high-quality tax compliance services while maintaining excellent client satisfaction.
  • Utilise tax technology and internal systems effectively to ensure efficient and accurate tax computations and filings.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of tax regulations and compliance requirements, minimising errors and ensuring quality deliverables.
  • For senior or reviewer-level responsibilities, demonstrate the ability to review work, provide guidance to team members, and ensure accuracy and compliance across the team.

To do this, you will have:

  • At least 1 year of experience in Singapore Corporate Income Tax compliance and filing.
  • Strong understanding of Singapore tax regulations and tax return preparation.
  • Experience reviewing tax work and ensuring accuracy and compliance is an advantage.
  • Previous experience managing, mentoring, or guiding team members is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail, organisational skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines effectively.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

Humility: There is so much we don’t know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.

Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you’re more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.

Data driven: We are a data rich business with ~15,000 small customers. Each decision we make can impact many more people than we realise - so it’s critical that we use sound data to support our strategies and review the success of our initiatives.

Can have tough conversations in a positive way: It’s not a matter of if, but when difficult interpersonal situations arise. Disagreement, conflict and disappointment are a given in a fast moving business where people care about their work. People that proactively have tough conversations with kindness build empathy, trust and great working relationships.

The interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the below interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

Whether the interviews are held over video call or in person will depend on your location and the role.

TA Screen

A 30-minute video call with a member of our HR team to discuss your application, explore your career background, and understand your expectations for the role.

Technical Round

A ~60 minute chat with the Hiring Manager. They’ll discuss your last 1-2 roles to understand your experience in more detail.

Soft Skills Assessment

A ~45 minute chat with a leadership team, where they will dive into some of your recent work situations to understand how you think and work.

Offer + reference interviews

We’ll make a non-binding offer verbally or over email, followed by a couple of short phone or video calls with references that you provide to us.

+++++

Requirement for background screening

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role.

This may include using external vendors to verify the below:

  • Your education
  • Any criminal history
  • Any political exposure
  • Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at sleek.com.

Benefits

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility: You will be required to work from the office at least 2–3 days per week if you are based in Singapore, UK, Hong Kong or Australia. For all other hiring locations, the role will be fully remote, with work from home five days a week. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don’t mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate.

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Additionally, you’ll be able to access our flexi benefits scheme for home office equipment or health and fitness expenditure. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: You’ll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you’ll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There’s also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We’re also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we’ve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we’ve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.
